The net share command is used to share folders on a network as well as stop sharing folders. (And net use will allow users to connect to them.) The proper syntax to share a folder is net share <share_name>=<drive_letter>:<path>. To stop sharing, use net share <share_name> /delete.

examQuestions.questionText: You have sent several print jobs to a networked printer and nothing has printed. You do not have printer administrator access. What can you do to see whether your Windows 7 computer is communicating properly with the printer?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If your printer isn’t spitting out print jobs, it may be a good idea to print a test page and see whether that works. The test page information is stored in the printer’s memory, so there’s no formatting or translating of jobs required. It’s simply a test to make sure that your printer hears your computer.

answers.textAnswer: Send the print job in RAW format.
Stop and restart the print spooler.
Print a blank document from Notepad.

examQuestions.questionText: You are troubleshooting a laptop with an integrated wireless networking card. The user reports that the laptop will not connect to the Internet. When you look at the network card, the connection and activity lights alternate blinking, in a steady pattern. What is the most likely cause of the problem?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Some wireless cards will have their connection and activity lights alternatively blink if there is no network connection. If the card had failed, there likely would be no lights on it at all.

answers.textAnswer: Unable to reach a DNS server

examQuestions.questionText: You are troubleshooting a laptop that has a poor battery life. It will work for only about 30 minutes on a full charge. Which two things should you try first? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
Small devices sometimes suffer from an extremely short battery life. If it’s a laptop, you can try to perform a battery calibration. For all mobile devices, you can try to drain the battery completely and then charge it fully before turning the device back on. If these options don’t work, then it’s likely that the battery needs to be replaced.

answers.textAnswer: Drain the battery completely and then charge it fully.
Open the Power Management app and set the laptop to run on low energy mode.

examQuestions.questionText: The name resolution server on your local network does not appear to be resolving host names properly. Which command will allow you to verify the entries on this server?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
nslookup is a command that enables you to verify entries on a DNS server.

examQuestions.questionText: You have installed a PCIe RAID controller and want to create a RAID 5 array with three disks. You plug the disks in and boot up the computer. The RAID array is not detected. Where should you go to set up or troubleshoot the RAID array?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Nearly all PCIe RAID controllers will have their own BIOS for setup, configuration, and troubleshooting. Some will have utilities available for use within an operating system as well.

examQuestions.questionText: A user complains of a loud whining noise coming from their computer. It occurs whenever the computer is on and is relatively constant. Which component is most likely to cause this problem?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The power supply is the only component listed with moving parts and therefore is the most likely component to cause a whining sound. It’s more than likely a fan. Either it needs to be cleaned (desperately) or replaced. Power supplies that are failing can also sound louder and quieter intermittently because a fan will run at alternating speeds.

examQuestions.questionText: You have just upgraded the RAM in a desktop computer. After powering on the computer, no video appears on the screen, and the computer produces a series of three long beeps. What does this indicate?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Every computer has a diagnostic program built into its basic input/output system (BIOS) called the power-on self-test (POST). When you turn on the computer, it executes this set of diagnostics. If the computer doesn’t perform the POST as it should, one way to determine the source of a problem is to listen for a beep code. This is a series of beeps from the computer’s speaker. A successful POST generally produces a single beep. If there’s more than one beep, the number, duration, and pattern of the beeps can sometimes tell you what component is causing the problem. Check the documentation to determine the specific issue.

answers.textAnswer: The system BIOS detected an error in the POST routine.
The system BIOS completed the POST routine normally.
The motherboard needs to be replaced.

examQuestions.questionText: You are troubleshooting a computer that will not boot up. When powering on, the power supply fan spins, but the computer does not POST. You look at the motherboard and see that a capacitor has swollen and looks ready to burst. What should you do?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Many motherboards have capacitors on them, which store electricity. They are short cylindrical tubes. Sometimes, when capacitors fail, they will bulge, and brownish-red electrolyte residue may seep out of the vents in the top. These are called distended capacitors. If a capacitor fails, the best option is to replace the motherboard.

answers.textAnswer: Drain the excess electrolyte from the capacitor.

examQuestions.questionText: You are troubleshooting a laser printer that keeps producing vertical black lines running down the page. Which component is most likely causing this problem?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A groove or scratch in the EP drum can cause the problem of vertical black lines running down all or part of the page. Because a scratch is lower than the surface, it doesn’t receive as much (if any) of a charge as the other areas. The result is that toner sticks to it as though it were discharged. The groove may go around the circumference of the drum, so the line may go all the way down the page.

examQuestions.questionText: A user reports that the screen on his tablet computer is very dim and hard to see. He’s adjusted it to the maximum brightness and it’s still dim. Which component is likely causing the problem?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Dim or flickering displays on mobile devices are usually caused by a faulty backlight in the display panel. A failing inverter can cause these problems too.

examQuestions.questionText: You have been troubleshooting a computer, and you believe the power supply has failed. Which of the following tools can you use to test the integrity of the power supply? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-4}.
If you’re curious as to the state of your power supply, you can buy hardware-based power supply testers or multimeters to test it.

examQuestions.questionText: A user is trying to display a presentation on a projector, but nothing appears on the external screen. They try toggling their LCD cutoff switch, and it doesn’t help. Another user had just presented on the projector, and it worked fine. Which component is most likely causing the problem?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If the laptop won’t output a screen image to an external monitor or projector, it means one of two things (assuming you know that the monitor or projector works): either the external VGA port is shot or the function keys aren’t working. In either case, you likely need to replace the motherboard if you want the display to appear on an external device.

examQuestions.questionText: A user calls to report that she can’t access the Internet or any other network resources. The IP address on her computer is 169.254.1.102. Which of the following is most likely to have caused this?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The address shown is one assigned by the Automatic Private IP Addressing (APIPA) service. It auto-configures your network card with an IP address if your computer is set to receive an IP address from the Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) server and that server doesn’t respond. You can always tell an APIPA address because it will be in the format of 169.254.x.x.

answers.textAnswer: Unable to reach a DNS server
Unable to reach a DHCP server
Unable to reach the default gateway
Unable to read the local host configuration file

examQuestions.questionText: The day after an electrical thunderstorm, you are troubleshooting a computer. After you power it up, it flashes information briefly on the screen and then reboots. It continuously reboots itself after this. Which components are most likely to cause this problem? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}, {answer-4}.
A failing motherboard or CPU may cause continuous reboots.

examQuestions.questionText: Within the last five minutes, several users in one part of the building have called in to report that they have lost their network connection. It had been working earlier in the day. What is most likely the cause of the problem?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
If the problem affects multiple users, chances are that it’s an issue with the central connectivity device. Suspect an issue with the hub or switch that the computers are plugged into.

examQuestions.questionText: All computers on your network are having intermittent Internet connectivity issues. Some websites work, while others do not. If you want to track the problem down by verifying the path to the problematic websites, which tool should you use?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
tracert (trace route) is a Windows-based command-line utility that enables you to verify the route to a remote host. Execute the command tracert hostname, where hostname is the computer name or IP address of the computer whose route you want to trace. Tracert returns the different IP addresses the packet was routed through to reach the final destination.

examQuestions.questionText: You support an old dot-matrix printer at work. When the printer prints, there is always a blank horizontal line in the middle of each line of output. What is the most likely cause of the problem?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If there is a consistent blank space, it likely means that a pin is not firing properly and the print head needs to be replaced. If the print ribbon were old, you would have consistently faded printing. If the ribbon were not advancing properly, you would get light and dark printing. If the wrong driver is installed, you will get garbage.

answers.textAnswer: The print ribbon is old and needs to be replaced.
The print ribbon is not advancing properly.
The print head needs to be replaced.
The wrong print driver is installed.

examQuestions.questionText: You are troubleshooting a computer that has been randomly rebooting, and now it refuses to boot properly. Upon boot, you receive one long beep and three short beeps, but no video on the screen. What tool should you use to troubleshoot the situation?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
This computer is giving you a beep code during the POST routine. One way to troubleshoot this is to use a POST card. This is a circuit board that fits into an expansion slot (PCI or PCIe) in the motherboard and reports numeric codes as the boot process progresses. Each of those codes corresponds to a particular component being checked. If the POST card stops at a certain number, you can look up that number in the manual for the card to determine the problem.

examQuestions.questionText: Your director’s network cable has failed, and he needs network connectivity immediately. You are unable to find a spare patch cable, but you have a spool of CAT5e cable and some RJ-45 connectors. Which tool do you need to create a new cable?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A crimper is a handy tool for helping you put connectors on the end of a cable. Most crimpers will be a combination tool that strips and snips wires as well as crimps the connector onto the end.

examQuestions.questionText: Multi-touch refers to which feature of a touch screen device?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Multi-touch simply means that the touch screen can accept multiple inputs from different parts of the screen at the same time. This allows for functionality such as pinch to zoom. It could mean that multiple people are using the touch screen at once, but it does not have to mean that.

answers.textAnswer: The ability to touch multiple parts of the screen at once to provide input.
The ability to touch the screen multiple times consecutively as part of the same input stream.
The ability for multiple people to use the touch screen device.
The ability to use a stylus or a finger as an input device.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is the most common input method for mobile devices?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Most mobile devices today use capacitive touch screens, which allow the user to use their finger as an input device.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is the operating system used by Apple Watch?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Apple created a new OS for its watch called WatchOS. It’s very similar to iOS 8.

examQuestions.questionText: The type of display that Google Glass presents to its users is called what?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Google Glass uses augmented reality (AR) technology, which is common on heads-up types of displays.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following devices was the first commercial tablet computer in the marketplace?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
GRiDPad was the first commercial tablet released, in 1989. None of the others were released until at least the year 2000.

examQuestions.questionText: With which iPhone version was the Lightning connector introduced?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The iPhone 5 was the first iPhone to use the Lightning connector. iPhone 6 uses it as well.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a mobile touch screen device with a screen size of 11&#8243;. What is the most likely classification of this device?
examQuestions.explanation: Tablets generally have a screen size between 7&#8243; and 12&#8243;. Phablets are between 5&#8243; and 7&#8243;, and smartphones are smaller than phablets. GPS touch screens are usually around the same size as the screens on smartphones.

examQuestions.questionText: Most smartphone Bluetooth accessories have a communication range of approximately how far?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Most mobile Bluetooth accessories are Class 2 devices, which have a maximum functional range of 10 meters.

examQuestions.questionText: Apps for Android-based smartphones and tablets can be downloaded from which store?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The app store for Android-based devices is Google Play. iOS devices download apps from the App Store.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the typical screen size for a phablet?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Phablets are larger than smartphones but smaller than tablets. Typically, a phablet will have a screen size of from 5" to 7".

examQuestions.questionText: Which wireless communication method has an operational range of about 1 meter?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Infrared has an operational range of about 1 meter. Near field communication (NFC) has a maximum range of about 10 centimeters. Wi-Fi depends on the standard, but it usually has a range of 30 meters or more. Bluetooth Class 2 devices can operate at about 10 meters.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are advantages of e-readers using E Ink over tablets? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2},{answer-3}.
e-Readers that use electrophoretic ink (E Ink) have a longer battery life than tablets and are easier to read in bright light conditions.

answers.textAnswer: Easier to read in bright light

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following best describes the concept of tethering?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Tethering is when a Wi-Fi enabled device attaches to a cellular device to get on the Internet. The cellular device is usually called a mobile hotspot.

answers.textAnswer: When a cellular device uses another device’s Wi-Fi connection to get on the Internet
When a Bluetooth device uses another device’s Wi-Fi connection to get on the Internet
When a Wi-Fi device uses another device’s Bluetooth connection to get on the Internet
When a Wi-Fi device uses another device’s cellular connection to get on the Internet

examQuestions.questionText: What is the number of active satellites used by GPS?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
GPS uses 24 satellites. There are 32 GPS satellites in space, but the extra 8 are backups.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the fastest data transfer speeds currently supported by NFC?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The three speeds supported by NFC are 106Kbps, 212Kbps, and 424Kbps.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is the name of the protocol used to transmit data in NFC peer-to-peer mode?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
NFC uses Simple NDEF Exchange Protocol (SNEP) in peer-to-peer mode. It’s based on LLCP.

examQuestions.questionText: Which GPS component is responsible for triangulation?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
It’s the receiver’s job to perform triangulation to determine its position based on data received from the satellites.

examQuestions.questionText: How much data can a micro SDXC memory card hold?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Micro SDXC cards can hold up to 2TB. SDHC cards can hold up to 32GB, and standard SD cards can hold up to 4GB.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the name of the Russian-managed GNSS?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
GLONASS is the Russian version of GPS. Galileo is European, BDS is Chinese, and IRNSS is Indian.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following wireless communication methods has the shortest operational range?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Near field communication (NFC) has a maximum range of about 10 centimeters. Wi-Fi depends on the standard, but it usually has a range of 30 meters or more. Bluetooth Class 2 devices can operate at about 10 meters, and infrared (IR) has a maximum range of about 1 meter.

examQuestions.questionText: You are manually configuring a TCP/IP host. Another administrator gives you the router’s IP address. What is the TCP/IP term for this?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The router is your doorway out into other networks, and it is known in TCP/IP terms as the default gateway. Without this configuration option, you will not be able to get to external networks.

examQuestions.questionText: The workstations on your network are configured to use a DHCP server. One of the workstations can’t communicate with other computers. Its IP address is 169.254.1.18. What could be the problem?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The address assigned to the computer is an APIPA address. Microsoft client computers (and others) will configure themselves with an address in this range if they are unable to reach a DHCP server.

answers.textAnswer: It has a private IP address.
It can’t reach the DHCP server.

examQuestions.questionText: You have just set up a network that will use the TCP/IP protocol, and you want client computers to obtain IP configuration information automatically. Which type of server do you need for this?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) server provides IP configuration information to hosts when they join the network. A Domain Name System (DNS) server resolves hostnames to IP addresses. A domain controller may provide login authentication, but it does not provide IP configuration information. There is no IP configuration server.

examQuestions.questionText: Which TCP/IP protocol uses port 80?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
HTTP uses port 80. HTTPS uses 443, Telnet 23, and POP3 110.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the maximum number of IPv6 addresses that can be assigned to one IPv6 interface?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
An IPv6 interface is not limited in the number of addresses that it can be assigned, although there could be limitations based upon practicality.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are valid examples of IPv6 addresses? (Choose all that apply.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-2},{answer-3}.
An IPv6 address contains 128 bits, written in eight 16-bit fields represented by four hexadecimal digits. Option {answer-1} contains all eight fields expressed in full. Option {answer-2} is an IPv4 address expressed in IPv6 form. Option {answer-3} is the same address as option {answer-1}, but written in accepted shorthand. Option {answer-4} is not valid because the double colons (::) can be used only once within an address.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following IP addresses would not be valid for a DNS server on the Internet?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
DNS servers resolve hostnames to IP addresses. On the Internet, a DNS server needs to have a public IP address. The address 10.25.11.33 is in a private address space, so that address would not be valid for a DNS server on the Internet.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following protocols is responsible for sending email?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) is responsible for sending email. IMAP4 and POP3 both receive email. SNMP is a network management protocol.

examQuestions.questionText: What port does the RDP protocol work on?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) works on port 3389. DNS works on port 53, IMAP4 works on 143, and LDAP works on 389.

examQuestions.questionText: Which two TCP/IP protocols work at the Host-to-Host layer of the DOD model? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3},{answer-4}.
The two protocols that work at the Host-to-Host layer are TCP and UDP. IP and ARP both work at the Internet layer.

examQuestions.questionText: What are two advantages that TCP has over UDP? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-4}.
TCP is a connection-oriented protocol that establishes virtual circuits and acknowledges delivery of packets. Because of these features, it has higher overhead than UDP and is a little slower.

examQuestions.questionText: Your friend is concerned about the security of making an online purchase. What should you tell her to look for in the address bar of the web browser?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The HTTP protocol is inherently unsecure, but the HTTPS protocol is secure. (SSH and SFTP are secure as well, but they are not protocols used to connect to websites.)

examQuestions.questionText: Your network is running IPv4. Which of the configuration options are mandatory for your host to communicate on the network? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-2}.
The only mandatory IPv4 configuration items are an IP address and a subnet mask. If you are not connecting to another network, you do not need a default gateway. DNS servers resolve hostnames to IP addresses, but they are not mandatory.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following protocols is used for secure delivery of email?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
IMAP4 and POP3 are the two protocols that are used for email delivery. Of the two, only IMAP4 provides security features. SMTP sends email. SNMP is a network management protocol.

examQuestions.questionText: Which protocol was developed to be a secure alternative to Telnet?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The Secure Shell (SSH) was developed as a secure alternative to Telnet. SMB is Server Message Block, which is a network file system. SNMP is for network management. SFTP is designed for secure file downloads. It’s a secure alternative to FTP, not a replacement for Telnet.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following protocols uses TCP port 23?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Telnet uses port 23. SSH uses port 22. FTP uses ports 21 and 20. DNS uses port 53.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is an IPv6 broadcast address?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-5}.
IPv6 does not have broadcasts. IPv6 does have multicasts, which are a bit like targeted broadcasts. FF00:: is the first part of a multicast address.

examQuestions.questionText: You are setting up a small network that will not connect to the Internet. You want computers to be able to locate each other by using hostnames. What service will do this?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
DNS is typically known as a name resolver on the Internet, but it will work on private networks as well. DNS resolves hostnames to IP addresses. DHCP automatically configures clients with IP address information. FTP is for file downloads. APIPA is a process used to assign clients a private IP address automatically when they can’t reach the DHCP server.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following protocols is responsible for resolving IP addresses to hardware addresses?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) resolves IP addresses to hardware (MAC) addresses. RARP does the reverse—it resolves MAC addresses to IP addresses. DNS resolves hostnames to IP addresses. DHCP automatically configures TCP/IP clients.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a computer with the IP address 171.226.18.1. What class is this address?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Class A addresses have a first octet between 1 and 126, Class B between 128 and 191, and Class C between 192 and 223. With a first octet of 171, this is a Class B address.

examQuestions.questionText: ____________________ is immune to electromagnetic or radio-frequency interference.
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Companies that want to ensure the safety and integrity of their data should use fiber-optic cable because it is not affected by electromagnetic or radio-frequency interference. Even though some copper cables have shielding, they are not immune to EMI or RFI. This eliminates twisted-pair and coaxial. CSMA/CD is an access method, not a cable type.

examQuestions.questionText: Which IEEE 802 standard defines a bus topology using coaxial baseband cable and is able to transmit at 10Mbps?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The IEEE 802.3 standard originally specified a bus topology that uses coaxial baseband cable, and it can transmit data up to 10Mbps.

examQuestions.questionText: ___________________ is the type of media access method used by NICs that listen to or sense the cable to check for traffic and send only when they hear that no one else is transmitting.
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Carrier Sense Multiple Access with Collision Detection (CSMA/CD) specifies that the NIC pause before transmitting a packet to ensure that the line is not being used. If no activity is detected, then it transmits the packet. If activity is detected, it waits until it is clear. In the case of two NICs transmitting at the same time (a collision), both NICs pause to detect and then retransmit the data.

examQuestions.questionText: What model is used to provide a common way to describe network protocols?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model is used to describe how network protocols should function. The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) designed the OSI model.

examQuestions.questionText: A physical star topology consists of several workstations that branch off a central device called a(n) ____________________ .
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A hub or a switch is at the center of a star topology. A NIC is a network card, which each computer must have to be on the network. Bridges and routers are higher-level connectivity devices that connect network segments or networks together.

examQuestions.questionText: Of all the network cabling options, ___________________ offers the longest possible segment length.
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Fiber-optic cable can span distances of several kilometers because it has much lower attenuation, crosstalk, and interference as compared to copper cables.

examQuestions.questionText: What devices transfer packets across multiple networks and use tables to store network addresses to determine the best destination?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Routers are designed to route (transfer) packets across networks. They are able to do this routing, determining the best path to take, based on the internal routing tables that they maintain.

examQuestions.questionText: In which network design do users access resources from other workstations rather than from a central location?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A peer-to-peer network has no servers, so all of the resources are shared from the various workstations on which they reside. This is the opposite of a client-server network, in which the majority of resources are located on servers that are dedicated to responding to client requests.

examQuestions.questionText: If you are going to run a network cable in the space above the drop ceiling in your office, which type of cable should you use?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
For areas where a cable must be fire retardant, such as in a drop ceiling, you must run plenum-grade cable. Plenum refers to the coating on the sleeve of the cable, not the copper or fiber within the cable itself. PVC is the other type of coating typically found on network cables, but it produces poisonous gas when burned.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following connector types is an MFF connector?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The local connector (LC) is a mini form factor (MFF) fiber-optic connector developed by Lucent Technologies. If it helps, think of LC as “Little Connector.”

examQuestions.questionText: You have been asked to configure a full mesh network with seven computers. How many connections will this require?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
In a mesh network, the number of connections is determined by the formula
\((x\times(x-1))\times2\). With seven computers, that amounts to 21 connections.

examQuestions.questionText: Which tool is used by technicians to connect an RJ-45 connector to the end of a cable?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A crimper can attach connectors to the end of a network cable. A punch-down tool will attach a cable to a wiring frame such as a 110 block. Cable testers will see if the cable works properly after you’ve created it. A loopback plug is for testing network cards.

examQuestions.questionText: What type of coaxial cable is recommended for digital television cable signals?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The two RG standards used for cable television are RG-6 and RG-59. Of the two, RG-6 is better and can handle digital signals. RG-59 is for analog signals only. RG-8 is thicknet coax, and RG-58 is thinnet coax.

examQuestions.questionText: Transmitting at 10Gbps, how far can signals on an MMF cable travel?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Multimode fiber (MMF) can transmit up to 550 meters, depending on the Ethernet specification. Other standards using MMF can transmit only up to 300 meters. If you need to transmit up to 40 kilometers, you will need to use single-mode fiber (SMF).

examQuestions.questionText: Which if the following is also called the drive geometry?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Cylinders, heads, and sectors (CHS) is also called the drive geometry, because together these three numbers determine how much data the disk can hold

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a standard adopted by many venders that requires the operating system to check the integrity of all system files before allowing the boot process to proceed?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Secure Boot is a standard adopted by many venders that requires the operating system to check the integrity of all system files before allowing the boot process to proceed. By doing so it protects against the alteration or corruption of these system files

examQuestions.questionText: Which if the following is a standard firmware interface for PCs, designed to replace BIOS.
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
UEFI (Unified Extensible Firmware Interface) is a standard firmware interface for PCs, designed to replace BIOS

examQuestions.questionText: Where do you change the boot sequence?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
This can be set by accessing the BIOS or UEFI settings.

examQuestions.questionText: Which if the following is memory that does not lose its content when power is lost to the machine.
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
NVRAM is memory that does not lose its content when power is lost to the machine.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the name for the set of diagnostic steps the computer undertakes when you first boot it up?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Every computer has a diagnostic program built into its BIOS called the power-on self-test (POST). When you turn on the computer, it executes this set of diagnostics.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following NOT an example of an optical drive?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Read only memory (ROM) is memory that cannot be written to and usually resides on a chip on the board

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following allows you to remotely locate, lock, and delete the data on a mobile device when it is stolen?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Lo-jack is a product made by Absolute Software that allows you to remotely locate, lock, and delete the data on a mobile device when it is stolen. It is a small piece of software that embeds itself on the computer and is difficult to detect.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the distance limitation of the FireWire 800 standard when implemented over fiber-optic cable?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
FireWire 800 can span 100 meters when implemented over fiber-optic cable. Over copper cable, it’s limited to 4.5 meters, like FireWire 400.

examQuestions.questionText: Which motherboard form factor measures 6.7" x 6.7"?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A mini-ITX motherboard is a 6.7" square. Nano-ITX motherboards are 4.7" square, pico-ITX motherboards are 3.9" x 2.8", and mobile-ITX motherboards are 2.4" square.

examQuestions.questionText: The DCPS within a laser printer converts AC power into what three voltages? (Choose three.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}, {answer-3}.
The DC power supply (DCPS) converts house current into three voltages: +5VDC and –5VDC for the logic circuitry and +24VDC for the paper-transport motors.

examQuestions.questionText: Which computer peripheral is most likely to use a mini-DIN 6 connector?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A mini-DIN 6 connector is a round connector often called a PS/2 connector. It’s historically used for a keyboard or a mouse. If you have only more modern USB peripherals, you can buy a PS/2 to USB adapter to plug them into one of these ports.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of storage device is composed of a conventional hard drive and a substantial amount of solid-state storage?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A hybrid hard drive is a combination of a conventional magnetic hard disk drive and solid-state storage. The goal is to increase access speed for commonly accessed data while still providing larger capacity similar to a conventional HDD.

examQuestions.questionText: An administrator ordered replacement printer paper that is a thicker caliper than recommended by the printer manufacturer. What is the biggest risk in using this paper?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Thicker paper can cause paper jams, especially in printers with curved paper paths. Paper that is too thin may not get picked up by the printer rollers at all.

examQuestions.questionText: Which one of the following connector types are you most likely to find on the end of a CAT6a cable?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A CAT6a cable is a network cable, and you are most likely to find an RJ-45 connector at the end of it. RJ-11 connectors are for phone lines. BNC connectors are network connectors but are typically used with coaxial cable. SATA connectors are hard drive connectors.

examQuestions.questionText: What type of printer technology will often use a roll of paper as opposed to individual sheets?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Thermal printers will often use a roll of paper as opposed to individual sheets. Fax machines may use thermal technology, but a fax machine in itself is not a printer technology.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following types of printers require the replacement of some sort of ink or toner? (Choose all that apply.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-3}, {answer-4}.
Laser printers need toner cartridges, impact printers need ink ribbons, and ink-jet printers use ink cartridges. Thermal printers heat up paper to produce images.

examQuestions.questionText: You are working on repairing a defective laser printer. Which of the following is a true statement regarding the imaging drum in a laser printer?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
An imaging drum is a photosensitive drum that can hold a charge if it’s not exposed to light. It is dark inside an EP printer, except when the laser scanning assembly shines on particular areas of the photosensitive drum.

answers.textAnswer: It can hold a charge only when it’s not exposed to light.
It can hold a charge only when it’s exposed to light.
It can hold a charge regardless of light exposure.
It is not required to hold a charge.

examQuestions.questionText: What are the dimensions of a micro-ATX motherboard?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A micro-ATX motherboard is a 9.6" square. ATX motherboards are 12" × 9.6", mini-ITX motherboards are 6.7" × 6.7", and pico-ITX motherboards are 3.9" × 2.8".

examQuestions.questionText: You have three hard disks, each 1TB in size. After installing them as a RAID 5 array in a computer, how much usable storage space will you have?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
In a RAID 5 array, each stripe places data on n–1 disks, and parity computed from the data is placed on the remaining disk. The parity is interleaved across all the drives in the array so that neighboring stripes have parity on different disks. Said differently, you lose the equivalent of one hard disk worth of storage to hold the parity information.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to enable clients to print to your networked printers, regardless of their location worldwide. Which service will best suit your needs?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Cloud printing allows for printing to a remote device, one that is not necessarily located on your local network. Essentially, you are using the Internet to send the print job from your device to the printer from which you want the output to come, and the printer can be located practically anywhere in the world.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following connectors transmit analog signals? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-3}.
VGA is an analog video connector, and RJ-11 connectors are used with modems. Modems receive a digital signal from the computer but then modulate that signal to analog to transmit over common phone lines.

examQuestions.questionText: During which step of the laser printer imaging process does a fluorescent lamp discharge the photosensitive drum?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
During the cleaning step, a rubber blade inside the toner cartridge scrapes any toner left on the drum into a used toner receptacle, and a fluorescent lamp discharges any remaining charge on the imaging drum. (Remember that the drum, being photosensitive, loses its charge when exposed to light.)

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of laptop monitor technology uses a current of electricity to stimulate a sealed panel of inert gas?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Plasma displays place electrodes in front of and behind sealed chambers full of inert gas (such as neon) and vaporized mercury. Current is run through the gas to ionize it and cause it to light up.

examQuestions.questionText: What type of front- or top-panel connector uses a standard 3.5mm jack to make connections?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The audio connector on the front or top panel will use a round, 3.5mm connector. You can plug speakers or headphones into it.

examQuestions.questionText: The motherboard in your desktop computer supports dual-channel memory. Which of the following statements regarding RAM is true?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
With most dual-channel motherboards, RAM will work just fine if one module is installed. However, you will get better performance if you fill the entire bank.

answers.textAnswer: The RAM will work only if it’s installed in pairs.
The RAM will work only if it’s installed in pairs or if one double-sided RAM module is used.
The RAM will work if only one module is installed, but only at half of its rated speed.
The RAM will work if only one module is installed.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician needs to replace a failed power supply in a desktop computer. When choosing a replacement power supply, which two specifications are most important to consider? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-4}.
When installing or replacing a power supply, always make sure that it has enough wattage to power the components in the computer. In addition, it should have enough connectors to connect to all the components that require their own power. Dual rail and dual voltage are optional features.

examQuestions.questionText: What is an advantage of using double-sided memory over single-sided memory?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Double-sided memory has chips on both sides of the RAM module instead of just on one side. It allows for doubling the amount of RAM on the module, so you get twice as much memory on one stick.

answers.textAnswer: It allows the memory to operate twice as fast.
It allows the CPU to access twice as much RAM at one time.
It’s required for use in dual-channel motherboards.
It allows for twice as much memory to be used in the same amount of space.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to replace the magnetic hard drive in your manager’s laptop. She wants a high-speed, high-capacity drive. What are the most common issues associated with her request? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}.
Faster hard drives transfer more data than slower hard drives, but there is no specific correlation between hard drive speed and its lifespan. The downsides to faster hard drives can be increased battery usage and heat production.

examQuestions.questionText: What are the two speeds at which PCI expansion buses can operate in desktop computers? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}.
PCI expansion buses operate at 33MHz or 66MHz (version 2.1) over a 32-bit (4-byte) channel, resulting in data rates of 133MBps and 266MBps, respectively, with 133MBps being the most common, server architectures excluded.

examQuestions.questionText: A designer from the corporate office is visiting your field office. He tries to print from his MacBook Pro to a networked printer, but it does not work. Local users in the office are able to print to the device using their Windows 8 computers. What would most likely solve the problem?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Print servers need to have the appropriate drivers for all operating systems that will be clients. It’s possible that this print server does not have the Mac driver installed.

answers.textAnswer: Select the Enable Mac Printing option in the print server configuration settings.
Select the Enable Bonjour option in the print server configuration settings.
Install a Mac printer driver on the print server.
Stop and restart the print spooler service.

examQuestions.questionText: You have an OLED monitor that you just plugged into a desktop computer. One of your co-workers changes the resolution from 1920×1080 to 1920×1200, but then the image looks highly distorted. What is the most likely cause of this?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Most digital monitors have a native resolution, which is a single, fixed resolution that they support. Attempting to change the resolution may result in distorted images, or the image may not display at all.

answers.textAnswer: The video driver does not support 1920×1200 resolution.
The monitor has a native resolution of 1920×1080.
The video adapter has a native resolution of 1920×1080.
The monitor is plugged into the wrong monitor interface to support the new resolution.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are advantages of using a CPU liquid cooling system over an air-based system? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
Liquid cooling systems are generally quieter than air-based systems that use fans, and they are more efficient at cooling the processor. However, they are more complex to install, and if the liquid were to leak out, that could cause damage to internal components.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to perform preventive maintenance on an impact printer. What are two areas you should examine that you would not need to on most inkjet printers? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}, {answer-4}.
Impact printers create images by impacting the paper, which can wear down the print head. Always check that. Also, impact printers most often use tractor feed mechanisms to load the paper, and they can wear down as well.

examQuestions.questionText: Which expansion bus technology uses lanes, which are switched point-to-point signal paths between two components?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
PCIe uses lanes. Each lane between any two intercommunicating devices comprises a separate pair of wires for both directions of traffic, which dramatically increases speed.

examQuestions.questionText: You are installing new computers in a machine shop. The computers on the shop floor don’t need to run local applications or have their own hard drives, but they do need to connect to the shop’s server. What type of custom configuration should you recommend?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A thin client is any machine that divests itself of all or most local storage and varying levels of RAM and processing power without necessarily giving up all ability to process instructions and data.

examQuestions.questionText: Which PC component reboots the computer from a cold startup point without removing power from the components?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The reset button, usually located on the front or top panel, allows a user to reboot the computer from a cold startup point without removing power from the components. This can be particularly helpful for dealing with software lockups.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of LCD panel is considered to have the best color representation at wider angles of viewing?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The two most popular methods of manufacturing LCD panels are twisted nematic (TN) and in-plane switching (IPS). Of the two, IPS is regarded as having the best color representation in all angles, while TN is faster and less expensive. LED and plasma are not types of LCD panels.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a user who needs recommendations for installing a home server PC. She wants her family to be able to share files and videos on their home network. She also wants her data to be protected in the event of a hard drive failure. Which two components do you recommend she include?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
A home server PC should be able to handle media streaming, as well as file and printer sharing. A dedicated print server is not likely needed, though, as the operating system can function as a print server. A gigabit NIC will be helpful to manage the network traffic, and a RAID array can help protect against hard drive failure.

examQuestions.questionText: Which system component enables the use of Secure Boot technology?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Secure Boot is an option enabled in system firmware. BIOS is not technically advanced enough to manage Secure Boot, but its successor UEFI is.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of DIMM has 184 pins?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
DDR has 184 pins, DDR2 and DDR 3 have 240 pins, and SODIMMs can have 72, 100, 144, 200, or 204 pins.

examQuestions.questionText: Which CPU technology allows for the assignment of two logical cores for every physical core present?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Hyperthreading-capable processors appear to the operating system to be two processors. As a result, the operating system can schedule two processes at the same time on the same physical core.

examQuestions.questionText: On what type of printer are you most likely to use tractor feed paper?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Dot-matrix printers are impact printers and typically require paper that always feeds at a consistent rate. To achieve this, the paper will have holes on the outside edges, which is fed into the printer using a tractor feed mechanism.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of flash memory is capable of being embedded on the circuit board of mobile devices?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Embedded MultiMediaCard (eMMC) can be permanently embedded on the circuit board of a cheaper or smaller mobile device. All of the other flash memory standards, such as CompactFlash, xD, miniMMC, and microMMC are designed to be removable.

examQuestions.questionText: Which motherboard form factor is common in desktop computers and measures 12" × 9.6"?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
ATX motherboards are common in desktop computers and measure 12" × 9.6". They are the largest motherboards commonly used in personal computers today.

examQuestions.questionText: What two components within an inkjet printer are responsible for moving the print head into proper position?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The motor that makes the print head carriage move is also often called the carriage motor or carriage stepper motor. It has a belt attached to it, the carriage belt, which moves the print head carriage back and forth.

examQuestions.questionText: Your company just hired a video producer to create exciting videos for the sales team. For her custom computer, which two upgrades are the most useful? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-4}.
For an audio/video editing workstation, you should maximize the audio and video capabilities, including having at least two large monitors. Videos also take a lot of disk space, so significant storage space is required.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to enable virtualization support for one of your Windows 8-based desktop computers using an Intel Core i5 CPU. Which two of the following must be true? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-4}.
Intel’s Virtualization Technology (Intel VT) is needed to support virtualization. It’s enabled in the BIOS, not the operating system.

answers.textAnswer: The CPU must have Intel VT.
The CPU must have Intel VR.
You need to enable virtualization in Windows 8.
You need to enable virtualization in the BIOS.

examQuestions.questionText: Your business employs four graphic designers who need new computers. These designers create graphical content such as advertisements, posters, and full-color brochures. Which of the following components is the least important to enhance in their custom-configured machines?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Graphic design (or CAD/CAM) workstations require solid CPU power, RAM, and a high-end video card. Hard drive storage is the least important upgrade for these types of users.

examQuestions.questionText: An analog LCD monitor is most likely to have what type of connector?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The most common analog video connector is a VGA connector.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the name of the measure that specifies how many times an image can be redrawn on a computer screen, in one second?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Refresh rate defines the vertical scan frequency of a monitor and determines how many times, in one second, an image can be redrawn on the screen. Many LCD monitors have a fixed refresh rate.

examQuestions.questionText: Which PC peripheral connection type operates at 20Gbps bandwidth, with a port that provides 18V and 9.9W of power?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Thunderbolt v1 and v2 both provide 20Gbps of data bandwidth. In addition, Thunderbolt ports power the attached peripherals with 18V and 9.9W of power.

examQuestions.questionText: In the laser printer printing process, which step immediately follows the exposing step?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The order of steps is processing, charging, exposing, developing, transferring, fusing, and cleaning.

examQuestions.questionText: What are the two power requirements that a PCI expansion bus may have in a desktop computer? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
PCI slots and adapters are manufactured in 3.3V and 5V versions. Adapters are keyed to fit in a slot based on their voltage requirements. Universal adapters are keyed to fit in slots based on either of the two voltages.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a standard for a secure cryptoprocessor that can secure hardware (and the system boot process) using cryptographic keys?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Trusted Platform Module (TPM) is an international standard for a dedicated security coprocessor, or cryptoprocessor. Coupled with a BIOS, it can be configured to boot the system only after authenticating the boot device.

examQuestions.questionText: In a laser printer, what is the function of the transfer corona assembly?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The transfer corona assembly is given a high-voltage charge, which is transferred to the paper, which in turn pulls the toner from the photosensitive imaging drum.

answers.textAnswer: It transfers a high-voltage charge to the paper.
It transfers a high-voltage charge to the imaging drum.
It transfers the toner from the imaging drum to the paper.
It transfers the image from the laser to the imaging drum.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician has installed a printer driver on a Windows 8 client computer. What is the best next step the technician can take to ensure that the printer is installed properly?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
After installing a new printer, it’s good practice to print a test page to ensure functionality.

answers.textAnswer: Check the printer status and ensure it says “Ready.”
Stop and restart the spooler service.

examQuestions.questionText: You are connecting a laptop to a printer on the network using Wi-Fi. The user will need to use the printer frequently when they are in the office. What type of wireless connection will you establish with the printer?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Wi-Fi (802.11a, b, g, n, or ac) and Bluetooth can be used to connect a printer temporarily to a single computer (or mobile device), and the connection does not have permanent status. This type of configuration is known as an ad hoc network connection. When Wi-Fi is used to connect printers to a network on a more permanent basis, it is known as infrastructure mode.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the name of the boot routine that verifies the size and integrity of the system memory?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The power-on-self-test (POST) is a series of system checks performed by the system BIOS. Checking the system memory is part of the POST routine.

examQuestions.questionText: You have been asked to install and configure a RAID 10 storage array for a computer. What is the minimum number of hard disks required for this configuration?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
RAID 10 (also known as RAID 1+0) provides fault tolerance to RAID 0 through the RAID 1 mirroring of each disk in the RAID 0 striped set. It requires four hard disks.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician is recommending that his company use removable memory cards. Which of the following should he tell his manager?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
MiniSD and microSD cards are smaller than standard SD memory cards. Adapters are available to allow them to work in standard SD slots.

answers.textAnswer: MiniSD and microSD cards work in a standard SD card slot.
MiniSD cards work in a standard SD slot, but microSD cards do not.
MicroSD cards work in a standard SD slot, but miniSD cards do not.
Neither miniSD nor microSD cards will work in a standard SD slot.

examQuestions.questionText: You are purchasing new laptops for your company. When thinking about the monitor quality, which type of backlight will produce better-quality pictures?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
There are two backlight technologies for LCD monitors: LED and fluorescent. Of the two, LED produces higher-quality images. OLED and plasma are display technologies, not backlight technologies.

examQuestions.questionText: Which component of the motherboard chipset is responsible for managing high-speed peripheral communications?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The Northbridge is responsible for managing high-speed peripheral communications. The Southbridge manages slower onboard peripherals. There is no Eastbridge or Westbridge in a motherboard chipset.

examQuestions.questionText: A graphical designer in your office needs two monitors to do her work. Which of the following should you install to set up her desktop computer for this configuration?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
To use a second monitor on a desktop computer, you need to install a second video adapter or have one video adapter with two monitor interfaces. Laptops often have an external monitor interface and are capable of providing video to the built-in screen and an external monitor at the same time.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements are true regarding buffered memory modules? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
Buffered memory modules include specialized chips that act as buffers for signals from the memory controller. By buffering these signals, the electrical load placed on the controller is reduced because the memory controller communicates in series with the register, instead of in parallel with the memory chips. The register performs the parallel communication with the chips.

answers.textAnswer: They increase the electrical load placed on the controller.
They decrease the electrical load placed on the controller.
When used, the memory controller communicates in series with the register.
When used, the memory controller communicates in parallel with the memory chips.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a desktop computer that is about five years old, with a single-channel memory architecture. You want to upgrade the memory. After checking the documentation, you purchase a higher-capacity RAM module that runs at the required bus speed. After you install it, the new RAM is not recognized, but the old RAM is. The computer store tests the RAM and it’s fine. What should you try next?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
That capacity of module might not have been in existence when the motherboard’s chipset was released. Sometimes flashing the BIOS is all that is required.

answers.textAnswer: Purchase a second memory module of the same type, and install them as a pair.
Return the memory module and purchase a lower-capacity one.

examQuestions.questionText: A client needs to connect to the Internet using telephone lines. What type of expansion card should you configure in his computer?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
A modem allows computers to connect to a remote network (such as an ISP) via telephone lines. Modems were the most common Internet connection method in the 1990s but are uncommon today. NICs are expansion cards for network connections. USB and cellular are not expansion cards. Other types of expansion cards include video cards, sound cards, storage cards, TV tuner cards, and riser cards.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following types of computer peripherals are considered input and output devices? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
Touch screens, KVM switches, smart TVs, and set-top boxes are capable of both input and output. Digitizers are input devices, and printers are output devices. Multifunctional printers that have a scanner included can be classified as input and output devices, but a plain printer is output only.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a motherboard designed to hold DDR3–1600 memory. What will happen if you attempt to install DDR2–667 memory into the motherboard?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
DDR2 and DDR3 memory slots are both keyed, but the keys are in different places. Therefore, the memory will not fit into the slots on the motherboard.

examQuestions.questionText: What happens during the transferring step of the laser printer printing process?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
During the transferring step, the positively charged paper pulls the negatively charged toner from the photosensitive drum at the line of contact between the roller and the paper.

answers.textAnswer: The image is transferred to the imaging drum.
The toner is transferred to the imaging drum.
The toner is transferred to the paper.
A strong, uniform negative charge is transferred to the imaging drum.

examQuestions.questionText: One of your users needs to print several copies of a 20-page document. She wants to ensure that all the pages print in order so she doesn’t have to reorganize the documents later. Which option does she need to set properly in her printer configuration settings?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The user wants to make sure that the collate option is set properly. It will let her select whether she wants it to print pages in order (1, 2, 3. . . 1, 2, 3. . . and so on) or multiple copies of the same page at once (1, 1, 1. . . 2, 2, 2. . . and so forth). Other options you can often set up in the printer configuration settings are duplexing (printing on the front and back), orientation (portrait or landscape), and print quality (such as draft or high resolution).

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following video resolutions is compatible with the 4:3 aspect ratio?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The term aspect ratio refers to the relationship between the horizontal and vertical pixel counts that a monitor can display. For example, for a display that supports 4:3 ratios, such as 1600×1200, if you divide the first number by 4 and multiply the result by 3, the product is equal to the second number. Additionally, if you divide the first number by the second number, the result is approximately 1.3, the same as 4 ÷ 3.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician needs to install an optical storage device as cheaply as possible. His client needs to store approximately 500MB of data at a time. Which technology is the best solution for this situation?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
CD-RW (re-writable compact disc) will be the least expensive of the optical solutions. In addition, CD-ROMs can store about 700MB to 900MB of data, depending on the standard used. This should be sufficient for the client.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician needs to install an optical disc system with capacity to burn discs storing about 12GB of data at one time. What is the minimum technology required to get him over this threshold?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
A DVD-R double-sided dual-layer (DS, DL) will provide 17.1GB of storage. BD-R single-sided dual-layer (SS, DL) will also work in this case, providing 50GB of storage. (BD-R is a one-time recordable Blu-ray disc, and BD-RE is a re-recordable disc. Both have the same capacity.) A DVD-R SS, DL provides about 8.5GB of storage, and DVD-R DS, SL provides about 9.4GB of storage.

examQuestions.questionText: You are buying a new video projector for the executive conference room. The administrative assistant tells you that the room often has bright sunlight, so the projector needs to be bright. What is the key specification you should pay attention to when selecting this projector?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Lumens is the measure of brightness for a projector. For a well-lit business setting, you probably want a projector rated at 5,000–6,000 lumens.

examQuestions.questionText: Which home and office printing technology typically employs a reservoir of ink, contained in a cartridge, as its medium to form images on paper?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Inkjet printers typically use a reservoir of ink (also known as an ink cartridge), a pump, and a nozzle to print images.

examQuestions.questionText: You have been asked to purchase new RAM for three workstations. The workstations call for DDR3–1600 chips. What throughput will these modules support?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The number designation of 1600 in DDR3–1600 indicates an FSB speed of 1600MHz. To find the throughput, multiply the FSB speed by 8.

examQuestions.questionText: Historically, which display type has been preferred to watch fast-motion programs such as sporting events?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The refresh rate for plasma displays has always been in the 600Hz range, which is 10 times the standard refresh rate of 60Hz, thus ensuring fluid video motion. The result is a display that produces the state of the art in video motion fluidity.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician needs to purchase new RAM for a motherboard. The motherboard specifications call for 400MHz DDR2 RAM. Which RAM modules should the technician use?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
DDR2, using a 100MHz actual clock, transfers data in four operations per cycle (effective 400MHz FSB) and 8 bytes per operation, for a total of 3200MBps. DDR2 calls these modules PC2–3200.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a new computer that needs to communicate with other computers on a wireless network. What type of expansion card do you need to install?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
To communicate with other computers on a network, you need a network interface card (NIC). A wireless access point (WAP) is a wireless hub that many wireless devices communicate with, and WPA is a wireless security standard. A KVM switch allows you to have multiple systems attached to the same keyboard, video, and mouse. Other types of expansion cards (that could use the same slot as a NIC) include video cards, sound cards, storage cards, TV tuner cards, and riser cards.

examQuestions.questionText: The WUXGA video standard, running at a resolution of 1920×1200, operates at what aspect ratio?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A 1920×1200 resolution is a 16:10 aspect ratio. If you take the second number (1200) and multiply it by 1.6, you get 1920.

examQuestions.questionText: When printing, which component is responsible for converting the data being printed into the format that the printer can understand?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The printer driver uses a page-description language (PDL) to convert the data being printed into the format that the printer can understand. The driver also ensures that the printer is ready to print.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements best describes the function of a typical power supply fan?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The power supply fan is used to cool the power supply. In addition, this fan draws air from inside the case into vents in the power supply. This pulls hot air through the power supply so that it can be blown out of the case.

answers.textAnswer: It cools the power supply by blowing in air from outside the case.
It cools the power supply by blowing hot air out the back of the power supply.
It cools the computer by blowing in air from outside the case, through the power supply, and into the computer.
It cools the computer by pulling hot air from inside the case, through the power supply, and blowing it out the back of the power supply.

examQuestions.questionText: Serial and Parallel ATA port communication to other components on a motherboard is managed by what?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The Northbridge is responsible for managing high-speed peripheral communications. The Southbridge manages slower onboard peripherals such as PS/2, parallel, serial, and Serial ATA and Parallel ATA.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the maximum data rate for a USB 2.0 connection?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
USB 1.0 supports 12Mbps, USB 2.0 supports 480Mbps, and USB 3.0 supports 5Gbps.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician has been asked to install and configure a RAID 5 array in a working computer that contains one hard drive. How many additional hard drives, at a minimum, does he need to bring with him to the job?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
RAID 5 arrays require a minimum of three hard drives. Since the computer already has one, he therefore needs two more.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to increase network security. A consultant suggests that you install a peripheral device to scan user fingerprints as a requirement to log in. What type of device will you install?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Any device that measures one or more physical or behavioral features of an organism is considered a biometric device. Biometric devices include fingerprint scanners, retinal and iris scanners, voice recognition devices, facial recognition devices, and others.

examQuestions.questionText: Which CPU architecture term describes a CPU with multiple physical processor dies in the same package?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A processor that exhibits a multicore architecture has multiple completely separate processor dies in the same package. The operating system and applications see multiple processors in the same way that they see multiple processors in separate sockets.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following optical disc standards provides the highest capacity?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
All are digital video disc (DVD) technologies. A single-sided, single-layer (SS, SL) DVD provides about 4.7GB of storage. A dual-sided (DS) disc will double that capacity to 9.4GB. Adding a second layer, or dual-layer (DL), adds more capacity, but the technology does not double the capacity of a single layer. A single-sided, dual-layer (SS, DL) disc has capacity of about 8.5GB.

examQuestions.questionText: Your company recently shipped five desktop computers from Germany to the United States. After switching the power cord to an American-style plug, you try to power one on and it doesn’t work. You try the others and none of them power on either. What is the most likely cause?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Many power supplies have a two-position slider switch called a dual voltage switch. It can be set for 110–120V or 220–240V, depending on what local power specifications are.

answers.textAnswer: All of the computers were damaged during shipping.
German power supplies work only with German power cords.
The power supplies won’t work because they expect 50Hz frequency from the wall outlet and the United States standard is 60Hz.
The power supply voltage switch needs to be moved.

examQuestions.questionText: What are the dimensions of a mobile-ITX motherboard?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
MicroATX motherboards are a 9.6" square, and mini-ITX motherboards are a 6.7" square. Pico-ITX motherboards are 3.9" × 2.8", and mobile-ITX motherboards are 2.4" square.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following printer types are considered impact printers? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
Daisy-wheel and dot-matrix printers use print heads that strike an ink ribbon, which presses up against the paper to make an image. Therefore, they are impact printers. Laser printers use a drum to create the image, and thermal printers use heat.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of video display technology does not require a separate display unit and light source?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
OLEDs create the image in an OLED display and supply the light source, so there is no need for a backlight with its additional power and space requirements, unlike in the case of LCD or plasma panels.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of bus architecture provides faster speeds?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Although serial might sound slower than parallel, modern technology has made the serial bus much faster than parallel bus systems.

answers.textAnswer: More information is needed to answer this question.

examQuestions.questionText: Which hardware component is responsible for prefetching data or code that the CPU will need to use and storing most recently used data or code?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Only the most recently used data and code or that which is expected to be used next is stored in cache. Cache is much smaller and faster than RAM.

examQuestions.questionText: Which two CPU sockets are capable of supporting Intel Core i7 processors? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}.
Sockets that support Intel processors are currently named starting with the letters LGA, such as LGA1156 and LGA2011. Socket names that start with AM or FM will support AMD processors and not Intel processors.

examQuestions.questionText: You are discussing data storage needs with a client who is a videographer and media producer. She stores dozens of large files and needs immediate access to them for editing. What is the most appropriate storage technology for her to use?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A standard hard disk drive (HDD) will provide her with the highest capacity of the four options and also give her immediate access. A solid-state drive (SSD) is fast but does not have as much capacity. Secure Digital (SD) is a memory card format and does not offer the capacity or immediacy she needs. BD-R is a Blu-ray Disc format. It has good storage capabilities, but not the immediacy for editing.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a client who wants to build a high-end custom home theater PC. Which two components will you suggest he install in the computer? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-3}.
A home theater PC (HTPC) needs to maximize the audio and video experience. It won’t do a lot of processing or data management, so an upgraded processor or RAM is unneeded. Install a great sound card, a video card with multiple HDMI outputs, and a TV tuner card. (HDMI is capable of supporting 7.1 surround sound, so you may choose to buy one expansion card capable of handling both functions.) Some HTPCs come in a compact form factor, which is just a small case.

examQuestions.questionText: You are searching for a new monitor on the Internet and find a used digital LCD monitor for sale. What are the two most likely types of connector you will find on this monitor? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
Digital monitors will have a digital interface, such as highlight to: DVI-D, HDMI, or miniHDMI. Composite connectors are rarely used on monitors, and VGA is analog, not digital.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician needs to purchase a new laptop for a manager. The manager has had several laptops fail and wants her new one to have as few components as possible to reduce the risk of failure. Which type of light source technology does not require an inverter and therefore is a better choice?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
There is no need for laptops with LED displays to convert the DC power coming into the laptop to the AC needed to power traditional fluorescent backlights because LEDs operate on DC power just like the rest of the laptop. Therefore, systems with LED backlights have no inverter board.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are typical formats supported by virtual printing? (Choose three.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}, {answer-4}.
The four virtual printing options are print to file, print to PDF, print to XPS, and print to image.

examQuestions.questionText: A bidirectional PCIe 1.1 x1 link provides how much data throughput?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
There are four major versions of PCIe currently specified: 1.x, 2.x, 3.0, and 4.0. For the four versions, a single omnidirectional lane operates at a data rate of 250MBps, 500MBps, approximately 1GBps, and roughly 2GBps, respectively. A bidirectional slot doubles the data rate.

examQuestions.questionText: Which component in a laser printer is responsible for heating up and melting the toner into the paper to create a permanent image?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Laser printers incorporate a fuser assembly, which uses two rollers that apply pressure and heat to fuse the plastic toner particles to the paper.

examQuestions.questionText: During which step in the laser printer printing process does a wire or roller apply a strong, uniform negative charge to the surface of the imaging drum?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
During the charging step, the charging corona uses a high voltage to apply a strong, uniform negative charge (around –600VDC) to the surface of the imaging drum.

examQuestions.questionText: You are installing two new RAM modules into a single channel of a dual-channel motherboard. Which of the following is true?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
When installing dual-channel RAM, be sure that the RAM modules both have the same parameters. In some cases, you might even need to make sure they come from the same manufacturer.

answers.textAnswer: Both RAM modules need to have the same parameters.
The RAM modules can be different sizes but must be the same speed.
The RAM modules can be different speeds but must be the same size.
The RAM modules can have different speeds and sizes, as long as they are the same type.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following printer components is not found in a laser printer?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Carriage motors are components in inkjet printers. Laser printer components include a fuser assembly, imaging drum, transfer belt, transfer roller, pickup roller, separator pads, and a duplexing assembly.

examQuestions.questionText: What type of common printer can potentially release harmful ozone into the atmosphere and therefore may contain an ozone filter?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Laser printer uses various high-voltage biases inside the case, and high voltages can create ozone.

examQuestions.questionText: There are four servers in your server closet. You need to access each of them, but not at the same time. Which device will allow you to share one set of input and output devices for all four servers?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
