The purpose of a KVM switch is to allow you to have multiple systems attached to the same keyboard, monitor, and mouse. You can use these three devices with only one system at a time, and the device will have a dial or buttons to allow you to switch between systems.

examQuestions.questionText: A user on your network has an older laser printer with no Ethernet connection. It’s connected to his computer with a parallel cable. He has shared it on the network for others to use. Now, he wants no part of the printer, but others still need to use it on the network. What would be the best upgrade to install in this printer to allow others to send print jobs to it directly over the network?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
It sounds like this printer needs to manage its own print jobs; therefore, it probably needs to be its own print server. Installing an integrated print server with a network connection will probably do the trick.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician needs to perform maintenance on an inkjet’s dirty paper pickup rollers. What should she use to clean them?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Clean pickup rollers (and other rubber rollers) with mild soap and water and not alcohol. Alcohol can dry out the rollers, making them brittle and ineffective. A dry cloth will not remove the dirt or debris, and compressed air would just blow the debris into other internal printer components.

examQuestions.questionText: You are installing and configuring a magnetic hard drive and have several models to choose from. Which hard drive is most likely to have the highest data throughput rates?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The primary factor in determining data throughput for a magnetic hard drive is the spin rate. Higher spin rates will result in faster data reads and writes and increase data throughput.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the name of the software package, typically enabled in the BIOS, that allows you to track the location of a stolen laptop or remotely lock it so it’s inaccessible?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
LoJack, made by Absolute Software, allows you to remotely lock a computer if it has been stolen or compromised. It will also allow security teams to locate stolen laptops.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to purchase RAM for a computer. Which factor determines the speed of memory you should purchase?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Motherboards support memory based on the speed of the frontside bus (or the CPU’s QPI) and the memory’s form factor. For example, if the motherboard’s FSB is rated at a maximum speed of 1333MHz, you should install memory that is rated at 1333MHz.

examQuestions.questionText: Your manager tells you to buy a high-capacity magnetic hard drive with the highest data transfer rate possible. Which hard drive parameter do manufacturers modify to increase hard drive data transfer rates?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
To make information available to the rest of the computer more quickly, hard drive manufacturers increase the speed at which the hard drive platters spin.

examQuestions.questionText: Three of these four motherboard form factors can be mounted in the same style of case. Which ones are they? (Choose three.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}, {answer-3}.
The ATX, MicroATX, and mini-ITX motherboard form factors can all be mounted inside a standard ATX case. The mini-ITX will have only three of the four mounting holes line up with the case, but the rear interfaces are placed in the same location as those on ATX motherboards.

examQuestions.questionText: Which RAM feature can detect and possibly fix errors within memory?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If memory supports ECC, check bits are generated and stored with the data. If one of the eight memory bits is in error, ECC can correct the error.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a client who needs a hot-swappable, nonvolatile, long-term storage technology that lets him conveniently carry data with him from one location to another in his pocket. Which technologies can you recommend? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-4}.
USB flash drives and SD cards are hot swappable. (In the case of USB, be sure that the flash drive does not contain key file system files needed for the computer to run!) Hybrid SSDs might or might not be hot swappable and are larger than USB and SD drives. PATA devices are generally not hot swappable.

examQuestions.questionText: You have been asked to assemble 20 new desktop PCs for a client. When you look at the first motherboard, you see four memory slots. The one closest to the CPU is colored blue. Then in order they are white, blue, and white. Which of the following statements are true? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-4}.
Dual-channel motherboards have two banks of two RAM slots. They are color coded such that the two slots of the same color belong to the same channel. Sometimes the like-colored slots are adjacent to each other, but other times they alternate. For optimal performance, fill one channel completely.

answers.textAnswer: For optimal performance, you should install RAM modules into the two slots closest to the CPU.
For optimal performance, you should install RAM modules into the two blue slots.

examQuestions.questionText: One of your Windows 8 users has a file they want to print as a .pdf file, but the application they are using does not support printing to .pdf. What would be their best option?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Install an application that provides support for printing to .pdf. Then, when the user opens the print window, they can choose the .pdf option.

answers.textAnswer: There is no way to print to .pdf if the application does not support it.
Use the Windows 8 native feature to print to .pdf.
Install a third-party app that installs support for printing to .pdf.
Use the Windows 8 native feature to print to .xps and then convert the .xps file into .pdf.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a computer running Windows 8. Every time you boot, the computer insists on trying to boot from the DVD-ROM drive. Where can you change the setting to have the system boot to the hard drive first?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The boot sequence of a computer is changed in the BIOS settings.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following types of connectors are generally found on the front or top panel of the computer? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}, {answer-4}.
Typical front- or top-panel connectors include USB, audio, power button, power light, drive activity lights, and the reset button. Hard drives and optical disk players generally connect to the motherboard.

examQuestions.questionText: Your manager is excited because he just purchased a fast USB 3.0 external hard drive for his work team. He wants to set it in the middle of the cubicles and let everyone have access to it. Some of the cubicles are about 15 feet away from each other. What is the recommended maximum cable length for this type of device?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
USB 3.0 has a cable length limitation of 3 meters. USB 2.0 cables can be up to 5 meters in length.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a desktop computer with three PCI expansion slots. What will happen when you mix cards of different speeds on the same motherboard?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
PCI is a shared-bus topology, so mixing 33MHz and 66MHz adapters in a 66MHz system will slow all adapters to 33MHz.

answers.textAnswer: The cards will operate at their original speeds.
None of the cards will function.
The cards will all operate at the faster speed.
The cards will all operate at the slower speed.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements accurately explains what happens during the exposing step in the laser printer printing process?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
In the exposing step, the image is written to the photosensitive imaging drum. Wherever the laser beam touches, the photosensitive drum’s charge is severely reduced from −600VDC to a slight negative charge (around −100VDC). As the drum rotates, a pattern of exposed areas is formed, representing the image to be printed.

answers.textAnswer: A laser reduces areas of the drum from a strong negative charge to a slight positive charge.
A laser reduces areas of the drum from a strong negative charge to a slight negative charge.
A laser increases areas of the drum from a slight negative charge to a strong negative charge.
A laser increases areas of the drum from a slight positive charge to a strong positive charge.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is the defining characteristic of a passive cooling system for a CPU?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Passive cooling systems come in a variety of models, and some are very effective. The defining characteristic is that they do not use a fan or require a power source.

answers.textAnswer: It uses liquid nitrogen or helium.
It does not require a fan or power.

examQuestions.questionText: You have an older laptop with a CD burner in it. What is the approximate capacity of the CDs you will be able to create with this device?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Compact discs have a capacity of approximately 700MB. Other CD standards support capacities of 650MB, 800MB, and 900MB.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following system settings are configurable in the BIOS? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-3}.
The BIOS configures many hardware components and settings, such as system date and time, boot sequence, enabling and disabling devices, clock speeds, virtualization support, and BIOS security.

examQuestions.questionText: 64-bit SODIMM modules come in which pin configurations? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
64-bit SODIMMs come in 144-pin SDR, 200-pin DDR and DDR2, and 204-pin DDR3 varieties. DDR DIMMs have 184 pins, and DDR2 and DDR3 DIMMS have 240 pins.

examQuestions.questionText: Which level of cache is typically the smallest and closest to the processor die in a computer?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The typical increasing order of capacity and distance from the processor die is L1 cache, L2 cache, L3 cache, RAM, and HDD/SSD. Currently, there is no L4 cache.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are types of CPU sockets? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-4}.
A pin grid array (PGA) socket has holes to receive the pins that are on the CPU. The land grid array (LGA) is a newer technology that places the delicate pins on the motherboard instead of on the CPU.

examQuestions.questionText: You just purchased several used computers from another company. They came with no documentation. When looking at the RAM, you see a sticker that says PC3–10600. What is the FSB speed of this computer?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
To calculate the FSB speed from the RAM module name, divide by 8. In this case, that makes the FSB 1333MHz (accounting for a bit of rounding).

examQuestions.questionText: Your engineering team is creating a product prototype that requires a video display. They need the display to be flexible to wrap somewhat around the prototype. What type of technology should they use?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Organic light-emitting diode (OLED) displays can be made to be flexible, whereas other displays cannot.

examQuestions.questionText: Your office has an inkjet printer, and the manager asks if it can be upgraded to print on both sides of the paper. What type of device can add this functionality?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
A duplexing assembly is used for two-sided printing. After the first page is printed, it’s fed into the duplexing assembly, turned over, and fed back into the paper feed assembly.

examQuestions.questionText: Which component in a laser printer is responsible for converting AC current into usable energy for the logic circuitry and motors?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The printer’s logic circuitry and motors require low voltages, between +5VDC and +24VDC. The DC power supply (DCPS) converts house current into three voltages: +5VDC and −5VDC for the logic circuitry and +24VDC for the paper-transport motors. This component also runs the fan that cools the internal components of the printer.

examQuestions.questionText: The Acme company has a laser printer in its Chicago office that has been used for three months. A technician needs to ship the printer to the Detroit office for use there. What, if any, preparations should be made for the toner cartridge?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Never ship a printer anywhere with a toner cartridge installed! The jostling that happens during shipping could cause toner to spill out of the cartridge and all over the inside of the printer. Remove the toner cartridge first. You can put it in a sealed, airtight bag to ship if needed.

answers.textAnswer: No preparations are needed for the toner cartridge before shipping.
Insert a toner blocker into the toner cartridge before shipping.
Seal the toner cartridge with tape before shipping.
Remove the toner cartridge from the printer before shipping.

examQuestions.questionText: Which step immediately follows the fusing step in the laser printer imaging process?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The order of steps is processing, charging, exposing, developing, transferring, fusing, and cleaning.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are services created by Apple to allow for the automatic discovery of printers on local networks? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}.
Apple created Bonjour and AirPrint.

examQuestions.questionText: After installing a new print cartridge in an inkjet printer, what process must be run before printing to the device?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Before you print to an inkjet printer, you must ensure that the device is calibrated. Calibration is the process by which a device is brought within functional specifications. For example, inkjet printers need their print heads aligned so that they print evenly and don’t print funny-looking letters and unevenly spaced lines.

examQuestions.questionText: The most common RAM slots used in desktop and laptop computers, respectively, are what?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Desktop computers use dual inline memory modules (DIMMs), and laptops most commonly use small outline DIMMs (SODIMMs). Another potential laptop memory form factor is the MicroDIMM.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of printing technology uses a heating element to make images on waxy paper?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Thermal printers use a heating element. It heats up spots on special waxy, heat-sensitive paper to form the image.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a laser printer that is displaying the message “Perform user maintenance.” What should you do to resolve this situation?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
When a laser printer requests maintenance, it’s because it has reached a certain page count. Apply a proper maintenance kit (one recommended by the manufacturer) and then clear the service message.

answers.textAnswer: Apply a maintenance kit and clear the message.
Use compressed air to blow out the inside of the printer and clear the message.
Turn the printer off and back on again to clear the message.
Replace the toner cartridge and clear the message.

examQuestions.questionText: PCI-X expansion slots are compatible with what other adapters?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
PCI-X slots are physically compatible with PCI adapters. Because all PCI-X slots support the 66MHz minimum clock rate, PCI-X slots are compatible with 66MHz PCI adapters.

examQuestions.questionText: A user wants to create the ultimate gaming PC. Which of the following peripherals would be most appropriate for this type of system?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
There are dozens of peripherals on the computer market. Joysticks are used primarily to play video games. Barcode readers will scan item barcodes, such as items you purchase at a store. Motion sensors are usually associated with security systems. Smart TVs play television. Camcorders are another type of peripheral, used to record video.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician needs to install a new hard drive for her client. Access speed is far more important to this client than disk space. What type of hard drive is best suited for this client?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A solid-state drive (SSD) is the best choice for a hard drive, when access speed is the most important characteristic. A conventional magnetic hard disk drive (HDD) is slower. Secure Digital (SD) is a memory card format, not a hard drive type. BD-R is a Blu-ray Disc format.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician is looking to buy a new LCD monitor. Which type of LCD monitor has faster response times and is less expensive than others?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The two most popular methods of manufacturing LCD panels are twisted nematic (TN) and in-plane switching (IPS). Of the two, IPS is regarded as having the best color representation in all angles, while TN is faster and less expensive. LED and plasma are not types of LCD panels.

examQuestions.questionText: The set of signal pathways on a motherboard between the CPU and RAM is called what?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The communications between the CPU and memory occur over what is known as the frontside bus (FSB), which is just a set of signal pathways connecting the CPU and main memory.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a user who needs a custom PC configuration to run common desktop applications and simply meet the recommended requirements for a selected operating system. What should you recommend?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A standard thick client is not really a custom configuration; it’s the standard configuration on which custom configurations are based. In other words, a thick client is a standard client computer system.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to share printers on your network with multiple client operating systems, such as Windows, macOS, and Linux. Which of the following services will best meet your needs?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
TCP printing allows client with different OSs to send jobs directly to printers without worrying about intra-OS conflicts. Bonjour and AirPrint are both Apple services, and virtual printing allows you to print output to documents such as PDF files. Whenever sharing printers for remote printing, be sure to set proper user authentication on the print device.

examQuestions.questionText: Which RAM feature will detect errors within memory but is not able to fix them?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Parity checking is a rudimentary RAM error-checking scheme that offers no error correction.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician needs to increase the fault tolerance of his computer’s storage system, and he has two hard drives available. Which of the following options is his best choice?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
RAID 1 is called disk mirroring; it writes data simultaneously to both drives. If one drive fails, the other still has a working copy of the data. RAID 0 is disk striping and does not provide fault tolerance. RAID 5 is striping with parity and provides fault tolerance, but it requires three hard disks.

answers.textAnswer: Install both drives and configure them as separate volumes.
Install both drives and implement RAID 0.
Install both drives and implement RAID 1.
Install both drives and implement RAID 5.

examQuestions.questionText: On your network, users want to print easily from their iPads and iPhones. Which service supports this?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
iPads and iPhones can automatically detect AirPrint-enabled printers on their local network and print to them without requiring the installation of a driver.

examQuestions.questionText: A business partner who is visiting your corporate office wants to print to a printer using a Bluetooth connection. What type of connection is this?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth can be used to connect a printer temporarily to a single computer (or mobile device), and the connection does not have permanent status. This type of configuration is known as an ad hoc network connection.

examQuestions.questionText: A single lane of PCIe 4.0 operates at what data rate?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
There are four major versions of PCIe currently specified: 1.x, 2.x, 3.0, and 4.0. For the four versions, a single omnidirectional lane operates at a data rate of 250MBps, 500MBps, approximately 1GBps, and roughly 2GBps, respectively.

examQuestions.questionText: You are using a laptop computer and the wireless network card fails. There are no wired ports nearby. You need to send a file to your boss, who is in another country, in the next ten minutes. What should you do to fix the situation?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
A USB to Wi-Fi dongle will allow your computer to use that wireless network connection to get back up and running. Once you are on the network again, you can send the file. Replacing a network card on a laptop generally means replacing the entire motherboard. You can also get USB to Ethernet adapters for wired networking.

answers.textAnswer: Remove the defective network card and install a new one.
Install a USB to RJ-45 dongle.
Install a USB to Wi-Fi dongle.
Install a USB to Bluetooth dongle.

examQuestions.questionText: You are wearing your smart watch, which allows you to make payments like a credit card. What type of connection technology does this service use?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Near field communication (NFC) is a wireless technology that uses radio frequency (RF) signals with limited range, about 4" (10cm). NFC can operate in card emulation mode, which lets the device act as a smart card. This is useful for making payments at the site of a merchant who uses NFC.

examQuestions.questionText: What type of memory goes in a laptop?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Laptop memory comes in smaller form factors known as small outline DIMMs (SoDIMMs)

examQuestions.questionText: What is the maximum transmission speed of an ExpressCard in PCIe2 mode?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The maximum transmission speeds are as follows:
280 Mbit/s effective (USB 2 mode)
1.6 Gbit/s effective (PCIe 1 mode)
3.2 Gbit/s effective (PCIe 2 or USB 3 mode)

examQuestions.questionText: If damaged which component can render the hard drive useless?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If required, remove the connector attached to the old drive’s signal pins and attach it to the new drive. Make sure it’s right side up and do not force it. Damaging the signal pins may render the drive useless.

examQuestions.questionText: Which memory type can be used in laptops?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Of the listed options the only oine that is used in laptops is MicroDIMM.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the easiest thing toil damage when removing a laptop keyboard?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
When replacing the keyboard, one of the main things you want to keep in mind is to not damage the data cable connector to the system board

examQuestions.questionText: Which is NOT an advantage of solid state drives?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The advantage of solid state drives is that there are not as susceptible to damage if the device is dropped, and they are generally speaking faster as no moving parts are involved. They are, however, more expensive, and when they fail they don’t generally give some advance symptoms like a magnetic drive will do.

examQuestions.questionText: What port type has an icon that looks like a D with one arrow pointing up and another pointing down to its left?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
DisplayPort is a digital interface primarily used to connect a video source to a display device such as a computer monitor or television set. It resembles a USB port and has an icon that looks like a D with one arrow pointing up and another pointing down to its left

examQuestions.questionText: What size hard drive goes in a laptop?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The 2.5 inch; hard drives are smaller (which makes them attractive for a laptop where space is at a minimum) but in comparison to 3.5 inch hard drives, they have less capacity and cache and they operate at a lower speed

examQuestions.questionText: What special screwdriver is typically required to work on a notebook?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Some models of notebook PCs require a special T-8 Torx screwdriver. Most PC toolkits come with a T-8 bit for a screwdriver with interchangeable bits, but you may find that the T-8 screws are countersunk in deep holes so that you can’t fit the screwdriver into them. In such cases, you need to buy a separate T-8 screwdriver, available at most hardware stores or auto parts stores.

examQuestions.questionText: Which interface is natively found only in Apple devices?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Thunderbolt ports are most likely to be found on Apple laptops, but they are now showing up on others as well

examQuestions.questionText: You are purchasing a mobile device that allows you to use your finger to input information. What type of touch screen technology does this device use?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Capacitive touch screens are a little less accurate than resistive touch screens but more responsive. They respond to changes in electrical current, and as such, the human fingertip works great as the facilitator of input.

examQuestions.questionText: You are using a public Wi-Fi hotspot and believe that someone is trying to hack into your laptop. Which laptop feature should you use to immediately turn off all wireless connections?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Airplane mode turns off all wireless connections on the mobile device. It’s common on phones and tablets, and some laptops have the feature as well.

examQuestions.questionText: You have been asked to purchase a new camera for the company photographer. Some of the cameras are marketed as “smart” cameras. What key feature does this likely mean the camera includes?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Smart cameras have built-in wireless network connectivity for easy picture and video transfers. Many will include Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and NFC.

examQuestions.questionText: A user approaches you and asks for a CPU upgrade so his Lenovo laptop will run faster. What is most likely the easiest way to meet this user’s needs?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Laptop processors generally are permanently attached to the motherboard. And motherboards are normally proprietary, meaning one from a certain model will not fit into a different case. Therefore, the best course of action is likely a laptop upgrade.

answers.textAnswer: Remove the CPU and replace it with a faster one that fits the same socket.
Replace the laptop with one with a faster CPU.
Replace the motherboard with a standard laptop motherboard with a faster processor.
Replace the motherboard with a Lenovo laptop motherboard with a faster processor.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of mobile device is known for using electrophoretic ink?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Most e-readers use a technology called electrophoretic ink, or E Ink, which is a proprietary type of electronic paper. Although E Ink is available in color, many consider its best applications to be in grayscales or pure black and white.

examQuestions.questionText: What type of connection are you using if you use a USB cable to connect your laptop to your cellular phone in order to use the cellular wireless connection from the laptop?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Tethering is connecting a device to a mobile hotspot. The term used to be reserved only for when you were connected via USB cable, as opposed to connecting via wireless. Some devices will not function as a mobile hotspot but will allow you to tether a mobile device to it with a USB cable so the mobile device can share the cellular Internet connection.

examQuestions.questionText: What characteristic was the BlackBerry smartphone most famous for?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The built-in hardware keyboard was the BlackBerry’s key defining feature; indeed, even as recently as 2014, BlackBerry was still releasing phones with physical keyboards to please their loyal buyers.

examQuestions.questionText: Which laptop accessory should you purchase if you want to protect the device against theft?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
To physically secure your laptop, use a cable lock. Essentially, a cable lock anchors your device to a physical structure, making it nearly impossible for someone to walk off with it. LoJack is software that can help secure data but does not prevent physical theft. A protective cover will help protect your device from damage if it gets dropped (and some are waterproof too), but it won't stop someone from stealing it.

examQuestions.questionText: The hard drive in your manager’s hard drive has failed, and you need to replace it. Your manager asks about the benefits of replacing it with an SSD instead of an HDD. What should you tell her? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}, {answer-4}.
SSDs have several advantages over magnetic HDDs. They include faster startup and read times, less power consumption and heat produced, silent operation, and higher reliability because of lack of moving parts, and they are less susceptible to damage from physical shock and heat production.

answers.textAnswer: They consume less power and generate less heat.

examQuestions.questionText: Which laptop expansion port was designed as an industry standard to replace VGA and DVI ports and is backward compatible with both standards?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The Video Electronics Standards Association (VESA) introduced DisplayPort in 2008. It was designed to be an industry standard and to replace VGA and DVI. It’s also backward compatible with VGA and DVI by using adapters. A display port is intended to be for video devices only, but like HDMI and USB, it can transmit audio and video simultaneously.

examQuestions.questionText: You have recently purchased a laptop computer with a touch screen. It allows you to draw images on the screen and save them on the computer. Which device is responsible for converting the input into the image that you are able to save?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
A digitizer is a device that can be written or drawn on, and the content will be converted from analog input to digital images on the computer. Digitizers take input from a user’s finger or a writing utensil, such as a stylus. Many touch screen devices have a digitizer built in to them.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician has a failed Lenovo laptop, and he suspects the motherboard is bad. He has several other laptops available from which he can harvest parts. Which of the following statements is most likely true regarding the replacement motherboard he selects?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Laptop motherboards are nearly always proprietary, meaning they are not interchangeable between manufacturers or even between models from the same manufacturer. When a laptop motherboard needs to be replaced, you most likely need a laptop motherboard from the same make and model.

answers.textAnswer: He can choose a motherboard from any other laptop.
He can choose a motherboard from any other Lenovo laptop.
He must choose a motherboard from that same model of Lenovo laptop.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician needs to replace a failed laptop hard drive. The user stores a large amount of video on her computer and needs the largest capacity drive possible. What type of hard drive should you install?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Traditional magnetic hard drives will have greater capacity than SSD (which are a type of flash memory) or hybrid drives.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following wireless communication types has a maximum distance of about 4"?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Near field communication (NFC) is a wireless technology that uses radio frequency (RF) signals with limited range, about 4" (10cm).

examQuestions.questionText: Which two components of a laptop are the most useful when making a video conference call? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
Webcams are nearly universal on laptops today. The most common placement is right above the display on the laptop. Microphones are also often built into the display, next to the webcam.

examQuestions.questionText: Which mobile connection type allows you to share your cellular Internet connection with a Wi-Fi enabled device?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
If you have a cellular-enabled device such as a smartphone, you may be able to turn that phone into a mobile hotspot. By doing so, you can share your cellular Internet connection with Wi-Fi enabled devices such as a laptop or tablet.

examQuestions.questionText: In a laptop computer, which component is responsible for providing light to the display?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
LCD displays do not produce light, so to generate brightness, LCD displays have a backlight. A backlight is a small lamp placed behind, above, or to the side of an LCD display.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to purchase a memory card reader and removable memory for your mobile device. You need to transfer approximately 1TB of data at a time. Which technology should you invest in?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Mobile devices often make use of small form factor memory cards, such as Secure Digital (SD), miniSD, or microSD cards. Higher-capacity versions of these cards are SDHC, SDXC, miniSDHC, microSDHC, and microSDXC. The standard versions can hold up to 4GB in storage, HC up to 32GB, and XC up to 2TB.

examQuestions.questionText: You are replacing a motherboard in a laptop computer. When you open the case, you notice that there is a small circuit board attached to the motherboard that appears to have video and network circuitry built in to it. What is the name of this small circuit board?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
To save space, components of the video circuitry (and possibly other circuits as well) are placed on a thin circuit board that connects directly to the motherboard. This circuit board is often known as a riser card or a daughterboard.

examQuestions.questionText: You are visiting a remote office and need to print some documents. Your host tells you that the printer you need is configured on a piconet. What type of expansion option should you use to connect to this printer?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
A piconet is the name for a wireless Bluetooth network. Therefore, you need a USB to Bluetooth adapter.

examQuestions.questionText: You will be traveling to another country for work and will have a 10-hour airplane flight. You need to work on your laptop while on the flight, but your battery won’t last that long. What should you buy to allow you to use the auxiliary power outlets on the airplane?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A DC power adapter allows a user to plug the laptop into the DC power source (usually called an auxiliary power outlet) inside a car or on an airplane. AC power adapters are for plugging into standard wall outlets.

examQuestions.questionText: Of the laptop components listed, which one is least likely to be built into the display?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Common components to include in the display are the screen, Wi-Fi antenna, webcam, microphone, inverter, and digitizer.

examQuestions.questionText: A defining characteristic of a phablet is a screen of approximately what size?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A phablet is a device that blurs the line between a smartphone and a tablet. The term is not used much, but technically, a phablet is a smartphone with a display size between 5" and 7".

examQuestions.questionText: You are interested in buying a smart watch that has an OS compatible with your Android-based smart phone. Which brand of smart watch uses the Android Wear OS?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The Apple Watch uses Apple’s WatchOS. Samsung watches use Tizen, Sony watches use Android Wear, and Pebble watches use Pebble OS.

examQuestions.questionText: The AC adapter for your Dell laptop is not working properly, and you are searching for a replacement. Which two factors should be most important when selecting a new AC adapter? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}.
You should choose an AC adapter rated for the same or higher wattage than the original. You must also pay special attention to the polarity of the plug that interfaces with the laptop. If the laptop requires the positive lead to be the center conductor, for instance, then you must take care not to reverse the polarity.

answers.textAnswer: Same or higher wattage than the original

examQuestions.questionText: A laptop user wants to have a full-sized monitor and keyboard, as well as an external hard drive, available to him when he is at his desk. Which accessory can he purchase so that he doesn’t need to plug in each of these devices separately to his laptop every time he returns to his desk?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A docking station often replicates the functions of the ports on the back of a laptop so that peripherals such as monitors, keyboards, printers, and so on, that don’t travel with the laptop can remain connected to the dock and don’t all have to be unplugged physically each time the laptop is taken away.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to replace a failed hard drive in a user’s laptop, and it’s a model you are unfamiliar with. You look at the bottom of the laptop and see no obvious entrance points. Which component will you most likely need to remove to access the hard drive bay?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
As a rule of thumb, either you can access components from the bottom of a laptop, such as the memory and Mini PCIe card, or you’re going to need to remove the keyboard to access the components from the top.

examQuestions.questionText: A new laptop user asks you to explain airplane mode to them. Which of the following statements best describes what airplane mode does?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Airplane mode turns off all wireless connections on the mobile device. It’s common on phones and tablets, and some laptops have the feature as well.

answers.textAnswer: It turns off all your wireless connections.
It turns off your Wi-Fi connection.
It turns off your Wi-Fi and cellular connections.
It turns off your Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connections.

examQuestions.questionText: Which memory cards have a capacity of up to 32GB? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}.
Mobile devices often make use of small form factor memory cards, such as Secure Digital (SD), miniSD, or microSD cards. Higher-capacity versions of these cards are SDHC, SDXC, miniSDHC, microSDHC, and microSDXC. The standard versions can hold up to 4GB in storage, HC up to 32GB, and XC up to 2TB.

examQuestions.questionText: The iPhone 5 and iPhone 6 use what type of connector for charging?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The iPhone 5 series and iPhone 6 series use a proprietary connector called the Lightning connector.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a laptop with an ExpressCard/34 slot. Which type of device or devices are you unlikely to be able to use as an expansion option in that slot?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
ExpressCard/34 cards can have a variety of functions. However, they are too small to support expansion options such as 1.8² disk drives, card readers, and CompactFlash readers. For those devices, you will need ExpressCard/54.

answers.textAnswer: Hard drive, sound card, or network card
Hard drive, sound card, network card, or eSATA adapter

examQuestions.questionText: You are investigating new laptops for your company. You want the laptop displays to have a wide viewing angle. Which technology is best suited for your needs?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
There are two types of LCD technologies listed in the exam objectives: TN and IPS. Twisted Nematic (TN) is the older of the two, and it is relatively inexpensive and low power. The issue with TN LCD screens is that when you start viewing them at wider angles, the picture quality suffers greatly. In-Plane Switching (IPS) LCD monitors provide better color representation as well as wider-angle viewing, but they tend to be a bit more expensive and have somewhat slower response times.

examQuestions.questionText: You are using a USB flash drive to transfer files from a laptop. You plug the USB drive in and then copy the files to it. What is the recommended way to remove the drive?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
You need to stop the device first (this is good policy even for USB devices) using the Safely Remove Hardware icon in the system tray (it looks like a card with a green arrow or green check over it, depending on your version of Windows). Highlight the device and click Stop. Once it’s stopped, you can unplug it.

answers.textAnswer: Use the Safely Remove Hardware icon in the system tray, stop the drive, and then unplug it.
Close the drive’s window in Windows Explorer and unplug it.
Use the Shut Down Hardware icon in the system tray, stop the drive, and then unplug it.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the name of the OS used by the Apple Watch, which was designed specifically for the watch?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The Apple Watch uses WatchOS. It’s similar to iOS (used on iPads and iPhones) but was developed specifically for the watch. Its features are similar to iOS, but it includes features more tailored toward a smaller device.

examQuestions.questionText: The new model of laptop just purchased by your company has a Universal ExpressCard slot. Which of the following types of cards can you install into that slot?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A Universal ExpressCard host slot is wide enough to fit either an ExpressCard/54 or an ExpressCard/34 adapter; both of them have 26-pin connectors. (Slots designed for an ExpressCard/34 device cannot accommodate its wider cousins.) Universal ExpressCard slots also appear to be able to accept a CardBus adapter, but the card inserts not even an inch before stopping on the internal guide that ensures correct ExpressCard/34 insertion.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a MacBook Pro computer with a Thunderbolt 2 port. What is the maximum throughput of a device plugged into this port?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The first version of Thunderbolt supported 10Gbps data rates, which is fast. Thunderbolt 2.0 joins two 10Gbps channels together for 20Gbps throughput.

examQuestions.questionText: A technician needs to replace a failed laptop hard drive. What are the possible form factors of this hard drive? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
Laptop hard drives will be one of two form factors (sizes): 1.8" or 2.5". Desktop computers have historically used 3.5" hard drives.

examQuestions.questionText: Which laptop component can take input from a stylus and convert it into an image on the computer?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A digitizer is a device that can be written or drawn on, and the content will be converted from analog input to digital images on the computer. Digitizers take input from a user’s finger or a writing utensil, such as a stylus.

examQuestions.questionText: What type of wearable technology device is specifically designed to track a user’s movement and heart rate and may include features such as GPS?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A fitness monitor is normally worn on the wrist, and it tracks a user’s movements and heart rate. Some fitness monitors will be able to track sleep patterns and have a clock, alarm, and other features such as GPS. All fitness monitors have the ability to sync to a device such as a smartphone, laptop, or desktop.

examQuestions.questionText: Your company is producing posters for an upcoming public relations campaign. The project leader wants to embed information into an NFC tag in the poster. How much information can this tag hold?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Near field communication (NFC) is a wireless technology that uses radio frequency (RF) signals with limited range, about 4" (10cm). To read an NFC tag in a poster, you would move your phone close to the tag, and the phone would generate a small RF field that would power the target. Data could then be read from the tag, which currently holds up to 8KB of data.

examQuestions.questionText: You want to play video games on your tablet computer. Which accessory would you purchase if you wanted to play the game much like you would on a gaming console?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A good game controller can make your mobile device feel a bit more like a gaming console. Most of the game pads will look like standard console controllers and connect via Bluetooth.

examQuestions.questionText: Which laptop expansion port technology was developed by Apple and supports a wide variety of peripheral devices?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Thunderbolt was developed by Apple as an offshoot of the DisplayPort technology. Apple added support for PCIe and launched it in 2011. In terms of versatility, it’s really second only to USB. You will find video devices, hard drives (both HDD and SSD), printers, laptop docking stations, audio devices, and PCIe expansion enclosures that use Thunderbolt.

examQuestions.questionText: You have a laptop with an ExpressCard/34 slot. Which of the following statements are true regarding installing expansion cards?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
An ExpressCard/34 slot is only 34mm wide and will only accept a /34 card. There are no ExpressCard/22 cards or ExpressCard Universal cards (there is a universal slot), and the /54 card will be too wide to fit into the slot.

answers.textAnswer: You can only plug in an ExpressCard/34 card.
You can plug in an ExpressCard/34 card or an ExpressCard/22 card.
You can plug in an ExpressCard/34 card or an ExpressCard/54 card.
You can plug in an ExpressCard/34 card or an ExpressCard Universal card.

examQuestions.questionText: Which laptop display component is capable of discharging energy and causing severe injuries to technicians?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The job of the inverter is to store and convert energy; they have the potential to discharge that energy. They can be dangerous to technicians, so be careful when working with them.

examQuestions.questionText: Your new laptop has 4GB system RAM and an integrated video card. The default setting specifies 512MB of video memory. How much RAM is available for the processor to use?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Many laptops use shared video memory, meaning that system RAM is divided up for use between the processor and the video card. On these types of systems, the amount of RAM available for video is configured in the BIOS. Anything reserved for the video card is unavailable to the processor. In this case, subtracting half a gigabyte from 4GB leaves the CPU with 3.5GB.

examQuestions.questionText: Polar and Jawbone are manufacturers of what type of wearable technology devices?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Fitbit, Jawbone, Polar, Garmin, Basis, Misfit, Nike, and Withings are all popular fitness monitors. A fitness monitor is normally worn on the wrist, and it tracks a user’s movements and heart rate. Some fitness monitors will be able to track sleep patterns and have a clock, alarm, and other features such as GPS. All fitness monitors have the ability to sync to a device such as a smartphone, laptop, or desktop.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to install a memory upgrade in a laptop computer. The computer’s documentation says that the laptop uses DDR3 SODIMMs. How many pins will be on the SODIMM?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
DDR3 SODIMMs have 204 pins. DDR and DDR2 SODIMMS have 200 pins each, and older SDDRAM has 144 pins.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to replace a failed laptop hard drive. The user has asked that the new hard drive be as fast as possible, regardless of disk space or cost. What type of drive should you install?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A solid-state drive (SSD) uses the same memory technology found in other forms of flash memory. They are much faster than traditional magnetic drives or hybrid drives but generally don’t have as much capacity.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of mobile connection uses a process called pairing to logically connect two devices?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
When setting up a Bluetooth connection between a mobile device and an accessory, you will most often be required to connect the two devices logically in a process called pairing. Pairing is basically a discovery and authentication process that validates the communication link.

examQuestions.questionText: Tablet computers feature touch screens that are approximately what size?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Tablet screen sizes typically fall anywhere between 7" and 12", although you can find much larger ones with 24" displays.

examQuestions.questionText: Which mobile technology device makes use of an augmented reality display?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Google Glass is a mobile technology that uses augmented reality. It projects a display onto a lens a few inches from the user’s face that is equivalent to looking at a 25"screen from about 8 feet away.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of laptop backlight generally does not require the use of an inverter?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Laptops use either a fluorescent backlight (CCFL) or an LED backlight. LED backlights typically do not need an inverter.

examQuestions.questionText: You have traveled to the office of one of your suppliers. They do not have wireless networking, and your laptop does not have a wired network connection. If you need to get on their network, what is the best solution?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A USB to RJ-45 dongle will allow your computer to participate on a wired network, provided that the network uses twisted-pair cabling. You can also get USB to Ethernet adapters for wireless networking.

answers.textAnswer: Install a Mini PCIe network card with an RJ-45 port.
Install a USB to RJ-45 dongle.
Install a USB to Bluetooth dongle.
Install a USB to Wi-Fi dongle.

examQuestions.questionText: You are on the phone talking to a technician who is trying to upgrade a laptop. He is having trouble identifying the Mini PCIe card. How wide should you tell the technician that the card is?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Mini PCIe cards come in two sizes. The full-size cards are similar in size to ExpressCard devices without the external cover, measuring 30mm wide and 51mm long. Half-size cards are 30mm wide and 27mm long.

examQuestions.questionText: You have been asked to burn a DVD with several videos on it, but your laptop does not have an internal optical drive. You are certain that this request will be made several times. Which option is the best for you to install or replace a DVD burner?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Most laptops don’t have internal expansion room, so it will be impossible to install an internal component where one never existed. The best bet is to use an external DVD burner and attach it via a USB port. A DB-15 port is for VGA (video monitor) connections.

answers.textAnswer: Remove the secondary hard drive bay and install an internal DVD burner.
Remove the battery pack and install a DVD burner in its place.
Install an external DVD burner using a USB port.
Install an external DVD burner using the DB-15 port.

examQuestions.questionText: Which type of network connection is least likely to be found on a tablet computer?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Tablets are designed for mobile communication. As such, all tablets come equipped with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, and many have cellular capabilities as well.

examQuestions.questionText: A Lightning connector would be used with what type of device?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The iPhone 5 series and iPhone 6 series use a proprietary connector called the Lightning connector.

examQuestions.questionText: You have decided to start playing video-intensive games on your laptop computer. The video appears jumpy and slow to respond. What should you do first to try to increase the performance during game play?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Many laptops use shared video memory, meaning that system RAM is divided up for use between the processor and the video card. On these types of systems, the amount of RAM available for video is configured in the BIOS.

answers.textAnswer: Use Windows Control Panel to increase the amount of video memory available.
Use the system BIOS to increase the amount of video memory available.

examQuestions.questionText: A guest presenter plugs an external projector into her laptop, using the VGA port on the back of the laptop. He then uses the Fn key and his video toggle switch; the projector displays his presentation, but his laptop screen goes dark. What should he do if he wants to see the presentation on both the projector and his laptop?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Because of the much smaller space available for keys, some laptop keys are consolidated into special multifunction keys. These keys are accessed through the standard keys by using a special function (Fn) key. Nearly every laptop has a video connector on the back or the side to plug in an external monitor or a projector. You will need to use the video toggle key to get this external port to work. Usually there are three or four states: laptop only, external output only, duplicate, or extend the desktop (some models won’t have extend the desktop).

answers.textAnswer: Install a second video driver and then use the video toggle key to switch the video output to both screens.
Unplug the projector and plug it back in to synchronize it with the laptop.
Unplug the projector, use the video toggle key to switch the video output, and then plug the projector back in.
Press the video toggle key again until the presentation is shown on both screens.

examQuestions.questionText: You need to replace a failed motherboard in a laptop computer. Which of the following components are most likely integrated into the motherboard? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}.
Most laptop motherboards have integrated components to provide different functions. It is common to have video, audio, and wireless networking circuitry built into the motherboard. Hard drives and memory are generally replaceable.

examQuestions.questionText: A user has a laptop that is intermittently locking up. Initial diagnostics indicate that the processor is overheating. What can you do to try to remediate the issue? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
To combat heat, you can either slow the processor down (run it at a lower speed) or give it less juice (run it at a lower voltage). Most of the time, this is configured in the system BIOS. For example, many Intel processors have SpeedStep technology to slow the processor down to produce less heat, and they may also have adaptive thermal management.

answers.textAnswer: Leave the case open while the system is running to allow for better airflow and cooling.
Lower the CPU voltage in the system BIOS.
Lower the CPU clock speed in the system BIOS.
Run the laptop on AC power instead of battery power.

examQuestions.questionText: A client has an older Windows 7 laptop with an integrated video card. The system seems to boot but produces no video, even with an external monitor hooked up. What can you do to fix this?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If the integrated video card fails, you’re looking at a motherboard replacement. Some laptops do have a replaceable video card. If it fails or if you choose to upgrade it, the procedure will probably resemble replacing system memory.

answers.textAnswer: Add an external USB video card and connect the monitor to it.
Remove the old video card, and replace it with a new internal video card.
Leave the old card in the system, and add an internal mini-PCIe video card.

examQuestions.questionText: You are upgrading a laptop with a Mini PCIe card. What type of connector does Mini PCIe use?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Mini PCIe cards use a 52-pin connector. Cards are 30mm wide.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are ways to input information or commands into Google Glass? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
Google Glass has a touchpad on the side of the device that lets users scroll through menus and make selections. Other inputs can be made by voice command through a microphone or other built-in sensors such as the accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, proximity sensor, and ambient light sensor.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following wireless communication methods are the least susceptible to hacking? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-4}.
Of the wireless communication methods, infrared (IR) and near field communication (NFC) are the hardest to hack. IR communication is limited to about 1 meter, with a viewing angle of about 30 degrees. You would know if someone was trying to intercept the signal. NFC is limited to about 4" (10cm). It would be pretty obvious if someone were trying to intercept that signal.

examQuestions.questionText: What types of networking will smart cameras often have built into them? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-4}.
Smart cameras have built-in wireless network connectivity for easy picture and video transfers. Many will include Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and NFC.

examQuestions.questionText: A user has brought his laptop to you because the screen is intermittently flickering. Which display component is most likely causing this?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
If you are having problems with flickering screens or dimness, it’s more likely that the inverter is the problem and not the backlight itself.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following wireless communication types has a maximum distance of 1 meter and requires line of sight?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Infrared (IR) is a short-distance, line-of-sight, point-to-point communication method. It’s usually used to transfer small amounts of data from one device to another. The maximum functional distance of IR in mobile devices is about 1 meter, with a viewing angle of about 30 degrees.

examQuestions.questionText: You want to enable hands-free cellular conversations for when you are driving, so you purchase a wireless headset. Which wireless technology does the headset most likely use?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Headsets are used for hands-free phone conversations and listening to music. Headsets can either plug into the speaker/headphone jack or be wireless. Most wireless headsets are Bluetooth.

examQuestions.questionText: Your laptop has an internal Mini PCIe expansion slot. The documentation for an expansion card says that it supports Mini PCIe 2.0 x1 functionality. What speed does the expansion card run at?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Mini PCIe cards running in PCIe 1.0 x1 mode have a maximum speed of 2.5Gbps. Mini PCIe cards running in USB 2.0 mode have a maximum speed of 480Mbps, and those running in USB 3.0 or PCIe 2.0 x1 mode have a maximum speed of 5.0Gbps.

examQuestions.questionText: You have enabled the GPS service in your tablet. What is the minimum number of GPS satellites your tablet needs to be in contact with to determine its location?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
GPS systems were designed to require multiple satellites. Receivers use a process called triangulation, which they use to calculate the distance between themselves and the satellites (based on the time it takes to receive a signal) to determine their location. They require input from four satellites to provide location and elevation or three to provide location.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the maximum data speed of an ExpressCard 2.0 card running in USB 3.0 mode?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
ExpressCard version 2.0 devices have a maximum speed of 5.0Gbps, regardless of if they run in PCIe 2.0 or USB 3.0 mode.

examQuestions.questionText: Your laptop has an internal Mini PCIe expansion slot. The documentation for an expansion card says that it supports Mini PCIe USB 2.0 functionality. What speed does the expansion card run at?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Mini PCIe cards running in PCIe 1.0 x1 mode have a maximum speed of 2.5Gbps. Mini PCIe cards running in USB 2.0 mode have a maximum speed of 480Mbps, and those running in USB 3.0 or PCIe 2.0 x1 mode have a maximum speed of 5.0Gbps.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is not controlled by the Northbridge?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The Northbridge is in control of the local-bus components that share the clock of the frontside bus. SATA and all other drive interfaces do not share this clock and are controlled by the Southbridge.

examQuestions.questionText: You find out that a disgruntled ex-employee’s computer has a boot password that must be entered before the operating system is ever loaded. There is also a password preventing your access to the BIOS utility. Which of the following motherboard components can most likely be used to return the computer to a state that will allow you to boot the system without knowing the password?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Most motherboards have a jumper or similar momentary closure mechanism that will allow you to clear the CMOS memory of any user settings and cause the BIOS to use factory defaults, including no user or supervisor passwords.

examQuestions.questionText: Which computer component contains all of the circuitry necessary for other components or devices to communicate with one another?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The spine of the computer is the system board, otherwise known as the motherboard. On the motherboard, you will find the CPU, underlying circuitry, expansion slots, video components, RAM slots, and various other chips.

examQuestions.questionText: Which packaging is used for DDR SDRAM memory?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
DDR SDRAM is manufactured on a 184-pin DIMM. DIMMs with 168 pins were used for SDR SDRAM. The SIMM is the predecessor to the DIMM, on which SDRAM was never deployed. DIMMs with 240 pins are used for DDR2 and DDR3 SDRAM.

examQuestions.questionText: What memory chips would you find on a stick of PC3-16000?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Remember the 8:1 rule. Modules greater than but not including SDR SDRAM are named with a number eight times larger than the number used to name the chips on the module. The initials PC are used to describe the module, the initials DDR are used for the chips, and a single-digit number after PC and DDR is used to represent the level of DDR. The lack of a single-digit number represents DDR as long as the number that is present is greater than 133 (such as PC1600). Otherwise, you’re dealing with SDR (such as PC133). This means that PC3-16000 modules are DDR3 modules and are populated with chips named DDR3 and a number that is one-eighth of the module’s numeric code: 2000.

examQuestions.questionText: Which motherboard design style features smaller size and lower power consumption?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The ITX motherboard family consists of smaller boards that fit in standard or miniature cases and use less power than their larger counterparts.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following socket types is required for the Intel Core i7-9xx desktop series?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The lower-end Core i7 desktop (nonmobile) processors call for the LGA 1156 socket, but the 9xx series requires the LGA 1366 socket.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a socket technology that is designed to ease insertion of modern CPUs?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
ZIF sockets are designed with a locking mechanism that, when released, alleviates the resistance of the socket to receiving the pins of the chip being inserted. Make sure that you know your socket types so that the appearance of a specific model, such as Socket 1366, in a question like this does not distract you from the correct answer. Only LGA would be another acceptable answer to this question because with a lack of pin receptacles, there is no insertion resistance. However, no other pin-layout format, such as SPGA, addresses issues with inserting chips. LPGA might have evoked an image of LGA, leading you to that answer, but that term means nothing outside of the golfing community.

examQuestions.questionText: Which socket type is required for an AMD Phenom II that uses DDR3 RAM?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
This processor requires an AM3 socket. The only other version of Phenom II was for the AM2+, and it is not compatible with DDR3 RAM.

examQuestions.questionText: You press the front power button on a computer and the system boots. Later, you press it briefly and the system hibernates. When you press it again, the system resumes. You press and hold the button and the system shuts down. What is this feature called?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Soft power is the feature whereby the front power button acts as a relay to initiate various system power changes, depending on the duration that the button is held.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are the numbers of pins that can be found on DIMM modules used in desktop motherboards? (Choose two.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-6}.
DIMMs used in desktop motherboard applications have one of three possible pin counts. SDR SDRAM is implemented on 168-pin modules. DDR SDRAM and 16-bit RIMMs are implemented on 184-pin modules. DDR2 and DDR3 are implemented on 240-pin modules with different keying. Dual-channel RIMM modules have 232 pins. Modules with 200 and 204 pins are used in the SODIMM line, and there are no modules with 180 pins.

examQuestions.questionText: To avoid software-based virtualization, which two components need to support hardware-based virtualization?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}, {answer-4}.
Both the CPU and BIOS have to be designed to support virtualization in hardware.

examQuestions.questionText: Your Core i5 fan has a four-pin connector, but your motherboard only has a single three-pin header with the CPU_FAN label. Which of the following will be the easiest solution to get the necessary cooling for your CPU?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The easiest solution that works to cool your CPU is to connect the four-pin connector into the three-pin header. The missing pin allows you to control the speed of the fan. Without it, the fan will run at top speed, which is fine, albeit a little noisier. The heat sink alone should not be relied upon for proper cooling of modern CPUs.

answers.textAnswer: Plug the four-pin connector into the three-pin header.
Leave the plug disconnected and just use the heat sink.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the combined total speed of a PCIe 2.0 x16 slot?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The PCIe 1.1 specification provided 250MBps of throughput per lane per direction. With the 2.x versions of PCIe, this rate was doubled to 500MBps. As a result, each v2.0 lane is capable of a combined 1GBps. A x16 slot consists of 16 lanes, for a total bidirectional throughput of 16GBps.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following allows you to perform the most complete restart of the computer without removing power?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The reset button causes the computer to return to nearly the same point it is in when you power it on, but without the need for power cycling. Using Restart in the Start menu does not reboot as deeply as the reset button. Hibernation is a power state that completely removes power after saving the contents of RAM to the hard drive; pressing the power button is required to resume the session in the same manner as starting the computer after a complete shutdown. The power button cannot be used as a method of restarting the system.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is most helpful when flashing the BIOS on a desktop computer system?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
None of the options are required, but a UPS is by far the most helpful among the answers in that loss of power during this procedure can range from annoying to devastating.

examQuestions.questionText: Intel and AMD have integrated which of the following into their Atom and APU processor lines that had not been integrated before?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
These CPUs integrate the graphics-processing unit. The Core i7 before them integrated the memory controller, eliminating the FSB. Math coprocessors have been integrated since the 80486DX.

examQuestions.questionText: You have just purchased a motherboard that has an LGA775 socket for an Intel Pentium 4 processor. What type of memory modules will you most likely need for this motherboard?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Pentium 4 processors are always mated with memory mounted on DIMMs.

examQuestions.questionText: What type of expansion slot is preferred today for high-performance graphics adapters?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Although technically all of the slots listed could be used for video adapters, PCIe excels when compared to the other options and offers technologies such as SLI, which only make PCIe’s advantage more noticeable.

examQuestions.questionText: What does the e stand for in eMMC?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The e in eMMC stands for embedded. MultiMediaCard memory cards were modified to be able to be embedded on circuit boards in small or inexpensive devices. The eMMC module acts as solid-state form of secondary storage, performing similar functions to the HDDs and SSDs of larger or more expensive systems.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the physical component where data is stored in a HDD?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A conventional HDD contains discs called platters, on which data is stored magnetically through read/write heads by way of a magnetic coating.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is not one of the three major components of a hard disk drive system?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A conventional hard disk drive system consists of the hard disk and its often-integrated controller as well as a host adapter to gain access to the rest of the computer system. The drive interface is a common component of the controller and host adapter.

examQuestions.questionText: What is the largest NTFS volume size supported, assuming a 64KB cluster size as maximum?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A fixed number of clusters is supported by each operating system, leading to a corresponding maximum volume size. If the maximum NTFS cluster size of 64KB is used, NTFS can support a single-volume size of 64KB less than 256TB. When a cluster size of one sector, or 512 bytes (1⁄2KB), is used, the maximum volume size reduces to 2TB.

examQuestions.questionText: Which technology is based on flash memory and is intended eventually to replace conventional hard disk drives that have moving discs and other mechanisms?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Solid-state disks (SSDs) are capable of replacing conventional HDDs, contingent upon cheaper components and higher capacities.

examQuestions.questionText: A client is looking for a desktop drive technology that saves money over SSDs but offers performance increases over HDDs and can be used to house the operating system. Which of the following is the best to recommend?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A solid-state hybrid drive incorporates the features of both conventional magnetic-only hard drives and solid-state drives. As a result, the performance of an SSHD exceeds that of a hard drive but costs less than the equivalent-sized SSD. A dual-drive option still requires the purchase of a full-sized SSD. Adding the cost of the SSD and the HDD, the dual-drive solution does not satisfy the requirement of an affordable technology.

examQuestions.questionText: Which optical disc format supports a data capacity of 25GB?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Blu-ray discs have a single-sided, single-layer capacity of 25GB. The best the other options achieve is no more than roughly 17GB.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following best describes the concept of hot-swappable devices?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Hot-swappable devices can be removed while the power to the system is still on. Warm-swappable devices need to be stopped in the operating system before being removed. The term has nothing to do with the heat level of the device.

answers.textAnswer: Power does not need to be turned off before the device is inserted or removed.
The device can be removed with power applied after it is properly stopped in the operating system.
Care must be taken when swapping the device because it can be hot to the touch.
The device can be swapped while still hot, immediately after powering down the system.

examQuestions.questionText: Of the following voltage pairings, which one accurately represents the input and output, respectively, of power supplies and AC adapters?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Power supplies and AC adapters use standard wall outlets for an input of AC voltage, which they convert to the DC voltages required by the components to which they supply power.

examQuestions.questionText: What are the output voltages that have been commonly produced by PC power supplies over the years? (Choose five.)
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-3},{answer-4},{answer-5},{answer-6}.
A PC’s power supply produces +3.3VDC, +5VDC, –5VDC, +12VDC, and –12VDC from a 110VAC input.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements about power supplies is true?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
PC power supplies accept alternating current as input and produce direct current for the internal components. Europe requires the voltage selector switch be set at the higher setting. SATA drives most often use a specific power connector that is not compatible with the Molex connector used by PATA drives. Legacy AT-based motherboards called for P8 and P9 connectors; ATX motherboards have a newer 20- or 24-pin single power connector.

answers.textAnswer: You must make sure that the voltage selector switch on the back of the power supply is switched to the lower setting if the computer is going to be used in Europe.
SATA hard drives most often use the same type of power connector that PATA hard drives use.
Power supplies supply power to ATX-based motherboards with connectors known commonly as P8 and P9.
Power supplies convert AC input to DC output.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is not a consideration when installing an internal storage device?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Today’s hard drives, regardless of their rpm, have standard internal power connections. Each of the other options are valid concerns when installing an internal drive.

answers.textAnswer: You should match the form factor of the drive or adapt it to an available drive bay or slot.
You should secure the drive with at least two screws on one side and preferably two on each side.
Due to the high revolutions at which modern hard drives spin, you must secure an external power source because the internal power supplies do not have the capacity.
You need to be sure that the routing of the drive’s ribbon cable, if applicable, does not obstruct the engineered flow of air across internal components.

examQuestions.questionText: What kind of media is most commonly used when large amounts of data need to be archived on a regular basis?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Although inefficient as an interactive medium, sequential tape-based storage continues to be developed in increasing capacities. Tape remains the best choice for frequently backing up large amounts of data for redundancy and archival purposes.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following platter spin rates is not commonly associated with conventional magnetic hard disk drives?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
12,000 rpm HDDs were once produced in low quantities but were never common.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is not a consideration when upgrading power supplies?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Personal computers do not have permanently installed power supplies. Like other electrical and electronic components, power supplies can and do fail on a regular basis. Permanently mounting a power supply to a chassis would be a disservice to the consumer. You should consider the cumulative power needs of your installed components, and you might have to obtain adapters and splitters if you do not have enough or you have the wrong types of connectors coming from the power supply.

answers.textAnswer: You might find that you do not have a matching motherboard connector on your new power supply.
You might find that your case has a nonremovable power supply.
You might find that your power rating is not adequate on the new power supply.
You might find that you do not have enough of the appropriate connectors coming from the power supply for the devices that you have installed.

examQuestions.questionText: What does the red stripe on a ribbon cable indicate?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The red stripe on the cable indicates pin 1.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements about dual-rail power supplies is LEAST true?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
One drawback to dual-rail power supplies is that despite the fact that they supply more cumulative power, they offer less power on each individual rail than the single rail of other power supplies. As a result, it is easier to overdraw one of the two rails than it is to overdraw a single-rail power supply’s rail because the two rails do not combine their power but instead offer it separately, thus reducing the relative output of each individual rail.

answers.textAnswer: Dual-rail power supplies have electrically separate 12VDC connections.
Dual-rail power supplies typically support more cumulative amperage than single-rail supplies.
Dual-rail power supplies are less likely to be overdrawn by connected components.
Dual-rail power supplies feature most of the same connections as a single-rail supply.

examQuestions.questionText: Which of the following best describes a hybrid drive?
examQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
