unsortedQuestions.questionText: What should you do to attain optimal image quality with an LCD monitor?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Using the monitor’s native resolution results in the highest-quality image. The monitor must support the refresh rate chosen. Contrast should be adjusted until the image looks best. Setting it to maximum or minimum does not tend to produce the desired effect.

answers.textAnswer: Choose the highest refresh rate supported by the graphics adapter.
Adjust the contrast to the highest setting.
Set the resolution to the native resolution.
Adjust the contrast to the lowest setting.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: The service that formats print jobs to get them ready for the printer is called the __________.
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The print spooler formats the jobs and gets them ready for the printer. Print jobs are stored in the print queue, which is located on the print server. There is no print line.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following components in a laser printer charges the drum after it has been cleaned?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The primary corona wire applies a negative charge to the drum after it has gone through the cleaning phase.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: How is a resolution with a 16:10 denoted in the names of the specifications?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The letter W stands for widescreen. The 16:10 aspect ratio denotes widescreen viewing.

answers.textAnswer: By the letter Q somewhere in the name
By the letter H somewhere in the name
By the letter W at the beginning of the name
By the word Super being added to the name

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Why is a RAID array required for a home server PC?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
RAID arrays are expandable and start as multiple drives that can offer the benefits of fault tolerance and capacity. RAID 1, however, despite the fault-tolerance it offers, does not improve write performance or expandability. RAID arrays can be used to back up all network systems, but they do not do so automatically by default. Home server PCs are not required to be small like home theater PCs.

answers.textAnswer: Single drives have trouble growing with the server.
It backs up all of the client machines automatically.
RAID always makes disk access faster.
There is no room for internal drives in such a small PC.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which service is designed to allow wireless-aware client computers and devices to join a wireless network automatically and discover other devices?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Universal Plug and Play (UPnP) is designed to allow wireless-aware devices to connect to a network automatically, declare themselves to other devices, and discover other devices on the network.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: How many devices are allowed to be networked together on a single FireWire 400 bus?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Unlike USB, FireWire devices can communicate directly without going back to the computer. Up to 1,023 buses of 63 devices each can be bridged together. Daisy chains and tree topologies can be formed within and among buses.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a wireless technology that is based on the transmission of light versus radio frequencies?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Infrared ports, such as those based on IrDA, use the frequency of light just below the visible spectrum, resulting in the same behavior as visible light, such as line-of-sight and lack of penetration through opaque objects.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: How can you explain an LCD monitor that does not light evenly when a uniform field is displayed and that does not exhibit as high a contrast ratio as more modern LCD monitors?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
LCDs backlit with fluorescent bulb(s) do not always exhibit the same even lighting pattern as those backlit with individual LEDs per pixel. Lack of backlighting would not lead to uneven lighting. OLEDs are used for coloring and lighting in one, not for backlighting. Resolution has no effect on the evenness of the screen lighting.

answers.textAnswer: The monitor has no backlight and must be lighted from the front.
The monitor uses a fluorescent bulb as a backlight.
The resolution that the graphics adapter is using is not the monitor’s native resolution.
The monitor is based on OLED technology.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following elements can damage your laser printer? (Choose all that apply.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-2},{answer-3},{answer-4}.
Heat, light, ozone, and ammonia can all damage laser printers.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: If a CPU is overheating, which of the following might be the cause?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The heat sink must be kept clear of dust so that the CPU fan can push air through the heat sink and dissipate the heat it has collected from the surface of the CPU. Thermal compound (or thermal grease) is often quite necessary between the CPU and heat sink in order to facilitate the transfer of heat to the heat sink. If the power supply fails, or if the CPU is not seated at all, the computer will not function to the point where the CPU could overheat.

answers.textAnswer: The power supply has stopped working.
The heat sink is clogged with dust.
There is grease between the CPU and heat sink.
The CPU has crept out of its socket.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following technologies would you not expect to find in a fitness monitor?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Fitness monitors are usually wrist-based devices that may look and act a lot like a smartwatch. They are not able to make cellular calls though, so you would not expect to find LTE built-in.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following devices can be used in place of a keyboard so that large amounts of information do not need to be entered by hand?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Barcode readers can scan UPC symbols, almost immediately inputting the corresponding data into the system without using a keyboard.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What should you do if the real-time clock is slow in a computer?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A computer system that does not maintain the correct date and time is likely suffering from a dying CMOS battery. You should replace it as soon as the problem is noticed to avoid losing the CMOS settings and the need to reconfigure the BIOS settings after the battery is replaced.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of these is not a standalone motherboard form factor?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The ITX “form factor” is really a family of form factors, comprising mini-ITX, nano-ITX, pico-ITX, and mobile-ITX.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You need to equip a user buying a home theater PC with the ability to watch live TV as well as streaming content. Which of the following components common in HTPCs should you recommend?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The TV tuner card allows the decoding and demodulation (choosing of channels) of a television signal, allowing the user to tune to the channel of interest. A video capture card allows the recording of one or more live TV streams but not the ability to decode the signal. DVRs are not part of an HTPC but rather a competing device. The HTPC obviates the need for the DVR unless special decoding only offered by the DVR is required for certain channels, in which case the DVR can be placed ahead of the HTPC. Fast NICs don’t enhance the home theater experience.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which utility works like ping but returns the different IP addresses through which the packet was routed to reach the final destination?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Tracert works like ping but returns the different IP addresses through which the packet was routed to reach the final destination.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following processors requires an LGA-1366 socket?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The Intel Core i7-9xx series of processors require the LGA 1366 socket (Socket B). The Phenom II is an AMD CPU and requires the Socket AM3. The other two Intel processors fit in lesser LGA sockets.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: After physical installation of a new hard drive, you notice that the drive is not recognized at any point during boot, nor is it recognized in the operating system. What should you do first to get the drive recognized by the computer?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A drive that is not recognized at all indicates that the BIOS is not aware of its existence. Very often editing the configuration settings in the BIOS is necessary to get a new hard drive recognized by the system. This does not mean changing the boot order but instead changing the drive’s position in the BIOS from Disabled to Auto or Enabled. Partitioning and formatting are not possible until the physical drive’s existence is recognized. Disk Management will not show the drive until the BIOS recognizes it.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What type of printer uses special waxy paper that gets darker as heat passes over it, exposing an image?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A thermal printer uses special waxy paper that darkens when exposed to heat. The most popular use of this was in older fax machines.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the lowest grade of cable required to run 100BaseFX?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
In order to run 100BaseFX, you need fiber-optic cable. The {answer-6} in 100BaseFX means fiber.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the maximum indoor range of 802.11g?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
802.11g has a maximum indoor range of about 40 meters and a maximum outdoor range of about 140 meters.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following technologies has a maximum storage capacity of 32GB?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Micro SDHC can store up to 32GB. Micro SD can store up to 4GB, and Micro SDXC can store up to 2TB. There is no Micro SDGC.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following Internet connection types is generally the least expensive?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
One of the few advantages to using dial-up is that it is usually less expensive than broadband Internet access.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When upgrading the system BIOS, what is one way you may be able to change the boot sequence?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Pressing F2 on many laptops during the system boot will take you into the BIOS. Pressing F1 while in Windows will open Windows Help. Inserting a boot CD will not change the boot sequence. There is no BIOS key on the laptop.

answers.textAnswer: By pressing F1 while in Windows
By pressing F2 while the system is booting up
By holding down the BIOS key as the system is booting up

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following protocols can be used by a client to retrieve email from an email server? (Choose all that apply.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-3}.
The IMAP and POP3 protocols can be used to retrieve email from mail servers. SMTP is for sending email to an email server. FTP is for file downloads.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is an IPv6 multicast address?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Multicast addresses in IPv6 start with ff00. The ::1 address is the loopback address, global addresses start with 2000, and link-local (APIPA) addresses start with fe80.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When might an eMMC drive be used?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
An embedded MultiMediaCard (eMMC) drive is simpler than the classic MMCs upon which they are based, which in turn, are simpler than the newer SDs that were derived from the MMC specification and fit in the same slots. These “drives” are not removable and are commonly attached internally to circuit boards of mobile devices.

answers.textAnswer: When flash storage that performs better than SSDs is required
When simple, removable storage is required
When complex, SD-compatible storage is required
When speed is not as important as simple, embedded storage

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When should the voltage selector switch on a power supply be set to the higher of the two settings?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Setting the voltage selector switch to the higher of the two selections, usually 220, 230, or 240 (VAC), is necessary when using the computer in a country that has a power grid that supplies such a voltage with a frequency of 50Hz.

answers.textAnswer: When using the computer system in Europe
When plugging the computer system into the same outlet designed for a clothes dryer or range
When using dual PCIe graphics adapters

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A network that is confined to a college campus is defined as what?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A network that spans a college campus or a metropolitan area is known as a metropolitan area network (MAN). A LAN is a small-scale local area network, and a wide area network (WAN) consists of multiple LANs connected together. A personal area network (PAN) is for a very small-scale network, such as one designed for one person. There is no CAN type of network.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is being measured at 30 per second when the refresh rate is known to be 120 cycles per second (Hz)?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The number of frames per second (fps) is the measure of unique screens of information in a single second. The refresh rate of 120Hz is accomplished by displaying four copies each of 30 unique screens of information.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the result of an absent or broken static-eliminator strip in either an EP process or HP LaserJet printer?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
If the static-eliminator strip is absent (or broken) in either an EP process or HP LaserJet printer, the paper will maintain its positive charge. Should this occur, paper jams might result due to the paper curling around the photosensitive drum.

answers.textAnswer: Nothing. Both printers will continue to function normally.
Nothing will happen in EP process printers, but HP LaserJet printers will flash a “−671 error” message.
Nothing will happen in HP LaserJet printers, but EP process printers will flash a “−671 error” message.
Paper jams may occur in both types of printers because the paper may curl around the photosensitive drum.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following standards is backward compatible with both 802.11a and 802.11b?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The 802.11n standard utilizes both the 2.4GHz and 5GHz spectrums, and it is backward compatible with both 802.11a (5GHz) and 802.11b (2.4GHz). 802.11g operates at 2.4GHz, and it is only backward compatible with 802.11b. 802.11i is a security specification.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the term for one of the segments of a track on the platter of a magnetic disk?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Tracks are segmented into sectors, each of which routinely stores up to 512 bytes of data. Sectors are created in the factory or during low-level formatting. Cluster and allocation unit are two terms for a collection of one or more sectors. Clusters are formed during high-level formatting by an operating system.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: In which step of the laser printing process is a laser used to reduce the charge to &#8211;100VDC on areas of the photosensitive drum?
unsortedQuestions.explanation: During the writing process, a laser shines on the photosensitive drum and reduces the charge from &#8211;600VDC to &#8211;100DVC. The areas where the charge is reduced will form the image.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: DDR2 modules insert into which of the following?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
RAM modules insert into slots mated to the module’s form factor. DDR2 modules insert into 240-pin slots with a keying structure different from DDR3’s 240-pin slots.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What are the most common causes of crinkled paper coming out of a laser printer? (Choose all that apply.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2},{answer-3}.
The printer is probably obstructed by something, or its gears have been stripped by paper feeding incorrectly. Obstructions are usually caused by paper from a previous jam. When cleaning out a paper jam, make sure you get all of the paper.

answers.textAnswer: The printer is out of toner.
The printer has an obstructed paper path.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What produces the light in OLED monitors?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Organic LEDs create their own light, as do inorganic LEDs. They require no separate backlight, whether LED or bulb of any sort.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the most basic printer type?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Of the types listed here, the impact printer is the most basic. All of the other technologies were developed after the impact printer.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are at a command prompt. Which command can you use to see whether you have a network connection to another computer?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The PING command tests to see whether you can reach a remote host on the network.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You plugged in an external projector but no image appears when you turn the projector on. What do you need to do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Laptops can be configured to display on external devices such as projectors and external monitors. To toggle the display, use the function (Fn) key on the laptop along with the key for the appropriate function (such as F4 or F8).

answers.textAnswer: Toggle the laptop display with the video function key.
Toggle the laptop display with the display button on the back of the laptop case.
Toggle the laptop display with the display button on the side of the laptop case.
Reboot the laptop, and choose Display On Projector on the Windows boot screen.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following motherboard form factors is the smallest?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The ITX family of motherboard form factors is the smallest. Despite the name, the micro ATX motherboard is larger than the ITX motherboards. ATX and AT are larger still.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have a computer with the IP address 222.18.171.1. What class is this address?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Class A addresses have a first octet in the 1–126 range, Class B in the 128–191 range, and Class C in the 192–223 range. With a first octet of 222, this is a Class C address.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: The _________ is the measurement of the difference between the darkest color and the lightest color an LCD screen can display.
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The contrast ratio is the measurement between the darkest color and the lightest color that an LCD screen can display. The native resolution refers to how many pixels an LCD screen can display (across and down) without distortion.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: The 5Gbps data rate of USB 3.0 is also known by which name?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
USB is capable of all the options listed, but its 5Gbps rate is known by the trade name SuperSpeed.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You need to recommend a wireless cellular service to a client. She only works in the United States and needs the fastest data speed possible. Which type of service should you recommend?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth are not cellular standards. Of the two cellular standards, GSM is used worldwide and CDMA is only used in the United States. CDMA provides higher data throughput than GSM.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What are the chips on a PC3-12800 module called?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The 8:1 ratio between the numerical portion of the names of memory chips and the modules on which they are mounted results in chips having the lower number of the two. Therefore, DDR3-1600 chips are found on PC3-12800 modules. Furthermore, the names of the modules and chips share the numeric level of DDR being used—3 for DDR3, 2 for DDR2, and no number for DDR.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which speakers are used in 7.1 surround sound but not in 5.1 surround sound?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Six-channel (5.1) surround sound does not include side speakers, but eight-channel (7.1) surround sound does.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: From where should the BIOS flashing utility and firmware be obtained?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
You should consult the system manufacturer’s website to check for later BIOS versions and the issues they address. The system manufacturer will also supply the appropriate utility to be used to flash the BIOS. The BIOS manufacturer does not have the specific modified BIOS firmware for your machine.

answers.textAnswer: Downloaded from the website of the BIOS manufacturer
Downloaded from the website of the system/motherboard manufacturer
Ordered on disc from the BIOS manufacturer

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following functions is typical of a home theater PC?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Home theater PCs store a large amount of entertainment media and stream it to output devices but do not field file-sharing requests from clients. Home server PCs tend to do that and offer data fault tolerance. CAD/CAM workstations are used in design and manufacturing.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: How much data can a single layer of a standard DVD hold?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
A single-sided, single-layer DVD holds 4.7GB of data.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following custom configurations do not benefit from enhanced graphics? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2},{answer-5}.
Home server PCs are designed to share media and other resources with clients, not output high-end graphics. Thin clients obtain images and applications from servers and are not intended to support enhanced graphics.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which laptop input device is a flat surface that you can slide across with your finger to control the cursor?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The touchpad is an input device usually built into the laptop. It allows you to control the mouse pointer by dragging your finger across the surface.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: The ___________________ in a laser printer provides voltages to the corona wires.
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The high-voltage power supply provides power to the corona wires in most laser printers.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following graphics interface connectors produces an analog signal?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The VGA DE15 connector produces an analog signal from the graphics adapter to the monitor. The DVI-D and HDMI connectors produce digital signals, as do YCbCr connectors, the digital form of YPbPr component video connectors.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following components in a laser printer is responsible for transferring toner from the drum to the paper?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The transfer corona in the laser printer puts a positive charge on the paper, forcing the toner on a negatively charged drum to transfer to the paper.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What type of display technology do e-Readers use to conserve battery power?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
e-Readers use electrophoretic ink, or E Ink. It helps them conserve battery power and makes them easier to read in bright light conditions.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What type of power does the inverter provide to the backlight?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The inverter provides high-voltage, high-frequency power to the backlight.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are working with a printer that has a failed transfer corona. For which of the following functions is the transfer corona responsible?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The transfer corona in the laser printer puts a positive charge on the paper, forcing the toner on a negatively charged drum to transfer to the paper.

answers.textAnswer: Transferring toner from the paper to the drum
Transferring toner from the drum to the paper

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are valid methods to connect an inkjet printer? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-4}.
A common method for connecting printers today is using a USB connection. USB speeds are high and configuration is relatively easy. You might also be able to connect your printer to an Ethernet cable if it has an Ethernet port.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which Wi-Fi standard was the first to introduce beamforming?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Beamforming was introduced with 802.11ac. It allows the signal distance to be extended by focusing the signal in a specific direction.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a reason for using thermal compound on a CPU?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Thermal compound has become mandatory in creating a uniform heat-transfer layer between the CPU and heat sink.

answers.textAnswer: To promote the uniform transfer of heat from the CPU to the heat sink
To use the Peltier effect to cool the CPU to below ambient temperatures
To seal the heat sink to the CPU
To create a liquid barrier, protecting against condensation

unsortedQuestions.questionText: By default, on which port does Telnet run?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Telnet uses port 23 by default. POP3 uses port 110, HTTP uses port 80, and DNS uses port 57.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are sending print jobs to the printer, but nothing is printing. The printer is connected properly and online. What should you do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
If print jobs are seemingly getting “stuck” in the printer queue, you should stop and restart the print spooler service. There is no Printer Troubleshooting utility that will diagnose printer problems. Deleting and reinstalling is not necessary.

answers.textAnswer: Open Printer Troubleshooting and have it diagnose the problem.
Stop and restart the print spooler.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are working on a laser printer. The client explains that the toner is not clearly pressed on the paper or staying on the paper. Which of the following components might you suspect as the cause of the problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The fuser is responsible for permanently pressing the toner onto the paper. The fuser assembly presses and melts the toner right into the paper. The transfer corona transfers the toner from the drum to the paper. The printer controller circuitry converts signals from the PC into signals for the various printer assemblies. The paper transport assembly controls the movement of the paper through the printer.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which laser printer component formats the print job for the type of printer being used?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The printer controller assembly is responsible for formatting the print job for the type of printer being used. It formats the information into a page’s worth of line-by-line commands for the laser scanner.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What does FRU stand for?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The acronym FRU stands for field replaceable unit, which means that the component can be replaced by a technician while at the user’s location.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a characteristic of traditional hard disk drives?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Conventional HDDs store data by creating magnetic domains on the surface of a platter that is most commonly metal or glass, but not exclusively so. Platters spin, and read/write heads are moved by an armature. Although a HDD writes faster than an SSD, assuming no adjustments, such as caching, it does not read faster.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following devices takes advantage of Plug and Play while power is applied to the system?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
USB-attached devices without a file system are considered Plug and Play and hot swappable because they can be removed while the computer system to which they are attached is powered on.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What type of physical topology does a network have if all of the cables are connected to a hub but clients gain access to the network when they receive a token that allows them to talk?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Regardless of the logical access method (a token in this case), the physical topology is that of a star since all devices are connected to a hub.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the term for the concentric magnetic rings on the surface of a disk platter?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Tracks are concentric rings formed magnetically in the factory or through low-level formatting. Tracks form the boundaries within which data is written to the surface of a platter.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the most common size for laptop hard drives?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Conventional hard drives are 3.5 inches. Laptop hard drives are generally 2.5 inches.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What differentiates a solid-state drive from a conventional hard disk drive?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Solid-state drives have no moving parts like conventional hard disk drives. They rival smaller conventional drives in capacity but are not yet offered in as large capacities overall. They tend to be more expensive than conventional drives per byte of capacity, but they use the same drive interfaces, such as SATA interfaces, for example.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following interfaces offers the highest data rate?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
S3200 is FireWire800’s 3.2Gbps variant. The closest competitor in this list of options is USB 2.0, which tops out at 480Mbps. You have to employ USB 3.0 at 5Gbps to challenge FireWire 800 (IEEE 1394b).

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which wireless security protocol uses AES-CCMP?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The most advanced wireless security protocol currently available is WPA2, which uses AES-CCMP. WEP and WPA are inferior to WPA2 and do not support it. TKIP was a predecessor to AES and is used by WPA.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: On a network, printers, servers, and workstations can all be categorized as ____________.
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Resources are any items that can be used on a network by multiple people. Therefore, printers, files, and email are all considered resources when they are available on a network.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following operating systems is used by the Sony SmartWatch 3 and Motorola Moto 360 smartwatch?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Many non-Apple watches use Android Wear as their OS. The Samsung Gear S uses Tizen.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the name of the service that translates between public IP addresses and private, nonroutable IP addresses?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Network Address Translation (NAT) translates between public and private IP addresses. DNS resolves hostnames to IP addresses. ARP resolves IP addresses to MAC addresses. APIPA is an automatic IP configuration mechanism that’s used if a DHCP server is unavailable.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a computer system featuring a custom configuration?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Gaming PCs require high-end CPUs, graphics adapters, sound cards, and cooling. This is considered a custom configuration. The other configurations are not examples of custom configurations and standard systems doing extraordinary work (the A/V editor) or their normal job.

answers.textAnswer: A laptop with a BD-RE burner
A computer with a fast processor and high-end graphics adapter used for gaming
A standard thick client used for A/V editing
An enterprise server with 100 concurrent client sessions

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are configuring a network and need to connect a local LAN segment to an external network. Which device will connect multiple networks together and determine the best path for sending data?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Routers are highly intelligent devices that connect multiple network types and determine the best path for sending data. They can route packets across multiple networks and use routing tables to store network addresses to determine the best destination. Routers operate at the Network layer of the OSI model.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following options allows you to gain access to the BIOS configuration when an unknown password prevents such access?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Most motherboards have a Clear CMOS or Reset CMOS jumper that immediately resets the CMOS memory to its default state. Clearing the CMOS removes any BIOS supervisor and user passwords that might be set, along with many other user-configured BIOS settings, returning the BIOS to factory defaults.

answers.textAnswer: Repositioning a jumper on the motherboard to clear the CMOS memory
Holding down a BIOS-specific key or key sequence while booting the machine
Unplugging the computer for at least two minutes
Pressing F8 early in the boot sequence and selecting the option to clear the password from the resulting menu

unsortedQuestions.questionText: How many pins does a SODIMM memory module have?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
SODIMM memory chips have 144, 200, or 204 pins. MicroDIMM chips have 172 or 214 pins.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What type of printer can use ink that comes in a wax form?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Thermal printers use either heat only or heat along with a ribbon that contains a wax-based ink. Inkjet and dot-matrix printers use liquid ink; laser printers use toner.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the lowest grade of cable required to run 100BaseT?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
In order to run 100BaseT, you need Category 5 or better. The T in 1000BaseT indicates twisted-pair and not fiber-optic cable.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: To test the basic TCP/IP functionality in your network card, which command should you use?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
To test basic functionality, ping the loopback address, 127.0.0.1.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following pin counts have been used in the primary power supply connectors going to ATX and later motherboards? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4} and {answer-5}.
ATX motherboards have used 20- and 24-pin connectors as their primary power leads to the motherboard. All pin counts listed have been used in connectors coming from the power supply, and even the P8/P9 primary AT motherboard connectors had only 6 pins each. However, only 20- and 24-pin connectors have been used for the same purpose in ATX and later motherboards.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is a valid power option for Mini PCIe cards?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Mini PCIe cards can use either 1.5V or 3.3V, just like ExpressCard.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a digital connector for video that you may find on video cards?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A DVI connector is for digital video. A VGA connector is for analog video. LCD and CRT are monitor types.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Your laptop has 1GB of installed memory, and it uses shared video memory. If the video card is using 128MB, how much is left for the rest of the system?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If the laptop is using shared video memory, then the system memory is shared with the video card. If the video card is using 128MB, then there are 896MB left for the system.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements about projection-system brightness is true?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The correct option is a double-whammy. Both video and 3D require more lumens of brightness than their alternatives. Lux is okay to use when comparing two projectors in the same setting, but it cannot be used appropriately to compare projectors on a shelf. For that, the lumen is the unit of measure to which you must pay attention. In any given scenario, projectors rated at a higher number of lumens should produce more lux. The brightness of a projection system is not related to the resolution you choose, but instead it is related to the brightness in lumens of the projector bulb, which remains the same across resolutions. The use of a metal halide is precisely why projector bulbs can burn more brightly as well as stay cleaner.

answers.textAnswer: Projector brightness should be compared in units of lux during the purchasing process.
Operating a projection system at a higher resolution will not produce as much brightness as when you run it at lower resolutions.
Projector bulbs can shine more brightly than standard light bulbs because projector bulbs do not use halogens.
It takes more lumens of brightness to display 3D video than it does to display 2D still images.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following devices are shared when using a KVM switch? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2} and {answer-3}.
KVM stands for keyboard, video, mouse.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following 802.11x standards provides data transmission speeds up to 54Mbps and is backward compatible with a slower technology?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Both 802.11a and 802.11g provide data transmission speeds of up to 54Mbps, but only 802.11g is backward compatible with 802.11b. 802.11b only goes up to 11Mbps. 802.11i is a security standard.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the name for the successor to the system BIOS that expands on classic features by allowing modular extensions to the basic code?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI) enhances the classic BIOS concept by starting with a base configuration and allowing its extension through UEFI partitions on attached storage devices.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Increasing which of the following allows running more applications simultaneously?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Applications and their data must reside in RAM during execution. Increasing anything but RAM, despite various benefits, does not lead directly to being able to run more applications simultaneously. Virtual memory, or using the hard drive to assist RAM, can delay error messages that indicate memory exhaustion, but you should not need to increase HDD space to optimize virtual memory. If so, then running multiple applications is not your biggest concern.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the function of a loopback plug?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Loopback plugs take the signal going out on the transmit path and connect it back to the receive path. This allows you to test certain legacy ports as well as Ethernet NICs to make certain that they are working correctly.

answers.textAnswer: It’s used to test a telephone line.
It tests the functionality of a NIC.
It measures the signal strength of an Ethernet cable.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have just set up a network that will use TCP/IP, and you want client computers to be able to search for and communicate with other computers by using hostnames. Which type of server will help with this?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A Domain Name Service (DNS) server resolves hostnames to IP addresses. A Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) server provides IP configuration information to hosts when they join the network. A domain controller may provide login authentication, but it does not provide IP configuration information. There is no such thing as a host name server.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following descriptions characterizes an A/V editing workstation?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Audio/video editing workstations are characterized by their enhanced graphics adapters, audio features, and fast hard drives.

answers.textAnswer: A computer with a RAID array and liquid cooling
A computer with advanced graphics and processing power
A computer with a fast hard drive and surround sound

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a technology that is dependent on UEFI and that will load files at startup, but only if the files have not been tampered with?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Secure Boot loads boot files only if their digital signatures are valid. The boot files checked include option ROMs, the boot loader, and other operating-system boot files.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: In the United States, military applications of GPS use which type(s) of data?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Military applications use Precise (P) code as well as encrypted Precise (Y) code. Using both makes it more accurate than using civilian Coarse Acquisition (C/A) code.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: One of your users spilled soda on their laptop. While the laptop still appears to work relatively well, many of the keys stick. The user needs the laptop for an important presentation that starts in 15 minutes. What is the best solution to the problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If the laptop seems to work, there is no sense in replacing it. Besides, there’s no time to replace the device or the keyboard. For a temporary solution, have the user connect an external USB keyboard to avoid the problem of sticky keys.

answers.textAnswer: Spray the laptop with demineralized water.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have just installed a new printer. After it is installed, it prints only garbled text. Which of the following is likely the problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If a printer is using out-of-date or incorrect printer drivers, the printer may produce pages of garbled text. The solution is to ensure that the most recent printer drivers are downloaded from the manufacturer’s website.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A user calls to complain that his computer sometimes makes a horrible grinding sound. When you investigate, he says it only happens when he uses his DVD-ROM drive. What should you do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
If the drive is grinding whenever you put a DVD into it, it’s likely that the drive needs to be replaced. If it won’t read properly or consistently, then it might need to be cleaned.

answers.textAnswer: Check the user manual for a solution.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is not an NFC communication mode?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
There is no NFC host mode. All of the others are valid NFC modes.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are parallel computing architectures designed to break larger graphics-processing tasks into components that can be processed simultaneously? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1} and {answer-3}.
CUDA, by Nvidia, and OpenCL, its open-standard counterpart, are graphics-centric parallel-computing architectures designed to speed up graphics processing on video cards.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which RAID type offers no redundancy or fault tolerance?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
RAID 0 offers larger volumes and read/write-speed improvement, but no redundancy—if one drive is lost, so is all data in the array—hence, no fault tolerance.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following rates of rotation could be considered the optimal speed for a magnetic hard disk drive?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The faster a hard disk drive spins its platters, the faster that data can be read or written. Hard drives are manufactured to spin at a certain speed, most of which are given as options here. Therefore, the fastest speed listed, 10,000 rpm, could be considered optimal, at least in terms of performance.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the primary difference between an LCD monitor and what some call an LED monitor?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
An LED monitor actually is an LCD monitor. The only difference is that LEDs, not a fluorescent bulb, create the light that shines through the LCD panel. LED monitors are newer than LCD monitors and use DC power to light the LEDs. Fluorescent bulbs require AC power. Organic LED subpixels in an OLED monitor create the colors of their images, but LEDs in a LED monitor simply create the backlight.

answers.textAnswer: LCD subpixels create the colors of the image instead of LED subpixels.
The LCD monitor commonly uses a fluorescent bulb as a backlight.
LED monitors use AC power for their backlight.
LCD monitors are newer to the market than are LED monitors.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: With EP process laser printers, the laser discharges the charged photosensitive drum to _______ VDC.
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
With EP process laser printers, the laser discharges the charged photosensitive drum to –100VDC

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A user calls complaining of a strong odor coming from her computer. What should you tell her to do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}
If you or anyone else smells burning computer parts, shut the computer off! Then, after you give it a chance to cool down a bit, you can get into the case and inspect for visible damage.

answers.textAnswer: Open the case and see if there is visible damage.
Touch the side of the case to see if it’s hot to the touch.
Smell the back of the monitor case to ensure that it’s not the monitor.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which type of touchscreen is responsive to pressure and generally requires a stylus to operate?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The two major classifications of touchscreens are capacitive and resistive. Capacitive touchscreens are responsive to slight changes in electricity, and resistive are responsive to pressure. Resistive touchscreens usually require the use of a hard object such as a stylus.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Two typical backlight technologies are ___________________ . (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2} and {answer-4}.
Laptops use either a cold cathode fluorescent lamp (CCFL) or an LED strip as a backlight.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have been using your laser printer for just over five months. Recently, you noticed that the printed characters on the left side of your documents are faint compared to the letters on the right. How can you quickly resolve this problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Most documents have more characters printed on the left side of the paper than on the right side. Therefore, the toner from the left side of the cartridge runs out sooner, and the print on the left side of the documents will be faint. Shaking the toner cartridge redistributes the toner evenly on both sides.

answers.textAnswer: Blow the excess dust out of the cartridge.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following addresses is a nonroutable IP address?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Private, nonroutable addresses are 10.0.0.0–10.255.255.255, 172.16.0.0–172.31.255.255, and 192.168.0.0–192.168.255.255

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are wireless security protocols? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3} and {answer-4}.
WEP and WPA are wireless security standards. The SSID is the name of the wireless network. A MAC address is the hardware address built into network cards.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are possible causes of paper jams in a laser printer? (Choose three.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2} and {answer-4}.
Worn pickup or exit rollers can definitely cause paper jams because they fail to feed paper through the system properly. Paper that is too moist can also cause paper jams.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following custom configurations benefit most from a RAID array? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1} and {answer-3}.
A/V editing workstations need fast drives. Even the non-fault-tolerant RAID 0 benefits these computers by increasing the speed of drive access. Home server PCs store a large amount of information that would be devastating to lose. CAD/CAM and graphic design workstations need fast machines and video, but not drive access. The home theater PC is a tiny device that has no room or need for large drive arrays. Thin clients usually have no drives at all.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What kind of cables use either a BNC connector or an RJ-45 connector?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Both connectors are used for network cables; RJ-45 is used for twisted-pair Ethernet networks, and BNC connectors are used in 10Base2 networks. Telephone cables use RJ-11 connectors.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following standards would you want to use if you need high-bandwidth wireless network communications?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Wi-Fi is the best of the four wireless communication methods for networking, and it has the highest bandwidth of all four options.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a feature of USB 3.0 that differentiates it from USB 2.0?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
USB 2.0 tops out at 500mA; USB 3.0 supports up to 900mA of current.

answers.textAnswer: Inability to connect to USB 1.x devices
Recommends only gray cables and interfaces

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are differences between DVI-D and DVI-A interfaces? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3} and {answer-5}.
Despite the analog pins that DVI-D does not use, DVI-A interfaces use two fewer pins than DVI-D interfaces. The interfaces are the same size and both use an off-white color code, not the blue VGA color code.

answers.textAnswer: DVI-A interfaces have more pins than DVI-D interfaces.
DVI-A interfaces are larger than DVI-D interfaces.
DVI-D interfaces have more pins than DVI-A interfaces.
DVI-A interfaces have the same color code as VGA interfaces.
DVI-A interfaces use pins that DVI-D interfaces do not use.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the maximum speed provided by dial-up Internet access?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Dial-up connections are limited to 56Kbps.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is the primary reason that passive-matrix displays are not optimal for displaying video?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The response rate of passive matrix; that is, the time it takes to change a given pixel, can be less than a 10th of the response rate of active-matrix displays. This slow reaction time leads to an inability to display quality motion. Passive-matrix displays can certainly be made in high resolutions, but there is almost no market for such devices. They can be backlit like other displays. Their narrow viewing angle should certainly be acknowledged, but there is no reason to assume that there would be more than one viewer, and they would normally be centered with the display, reducing the reduced angle’s negative impact.

answers.textAnswer: They have a poor response rate.
They cannot be manufactured in resolutions higher than SVGA.
They require a front light because they have no backlight.
Crowding everyone around the center of the display is inconvenient.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a reason that a motherboard might feature a riser?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Manufacturers have used risers to build low-profile systems and to reclaim valuable space on the motherboard for other components by reducing the number of slots.

answers.textAnswer: To place a second motherboard on top of the first
To get the CPU off of the motherboard
To get the RAM off of the motherboard

unsortedQuestions.questionText: After documents are printed, the toner smears on the output pages whenever you touch it. Otherwise, things appear to be working properly. What is the most likely cause of the problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
If the fuser does not heat properly, toner will not bond to the paper and you will have smearing. Toner on the transfer corona wire most likely causes white streaks on printouts. A scratch or a groove in the EP drum causes vertical black lines. Faulty print drivers will cause garbage to print, or there will be no printing at all.

answers.textAnswer: The fuser is not heating properly.
There is toner on the transfer corona wire.
There is a scratch on the EP drum.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is true for computers configured with APIPA?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Computers configured with APIPA will have an IP address in the 169.254.0.0 range with a subnet mask of 255.255.0.0. They will be able to communicate with other computers on the local network that have the same network address.

answers.textAnswer: They will be able to communicate with other APIPA-configured computers on their local network.
They will not be able to communicate with other APIPA-configured computers on their local network.
They will be able to communicate with any computer on their local network
They will not be able to communicate with any computer on their local network

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is the term for a collection of same-numbered tracks on all writable surfaces of all platters within a hard disk drive system?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The total number of tracks in a hard drive system can be found by multiplying the number of cylinders by the number of read/write heads in the assembly. The cylinder count is equivalent to the number of tracks on any one writable surface of any one platter.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You currently have an AT-style motherboard. Your power supply has failed. Your new power supply has a rectangular 24-pin connector coming from it. Which one of the following is true?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Device connectors for hard drives and floppy drives are the same as they have been since each one was introduced. It’s the motherboard power header that changes from time to time. Adapters exist to bridge the discrepancy, which means that there is a way to use the 24-pin ATX power supply with the P8/P9 connectors on the AT motherboard.

answers.textAnswer: You need an adapter to connect to your motherboard.
You need an adapter to connect to your hard drives.
You need an adapter to connect to your floppy drive.
That’s exactly the same connector your old power supply had. There is no problem.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following would not be used to connect a printer to a system?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
PATA is an internal interface used to connect hard drives, CD devices, and DVD devices. Parallel ports were traditionally used as a printer port because they supported faster speeds than serial ports. USB is popular today because it is even faster than a parallel port and easy to configure. Shared network access is used to share a printer among many networked users.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which TCP/IP protocol uses port 110?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
POP3 uses port 110. HTTP uses port 80, HTTPS uses port 443, and SMTP uses port 25.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When setting up a gaming PC, which of the following qualifies as an enhanced cooling method?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Phase-change cooling is an advanced cooling method, essentially using refrigeration to cool components. Convection cooling is the standard method of cooling, with or without heat sinks and fans.

answers.textAnswer: Both a front intake fan and a rear exhaust fan

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following terms refers to a single memory module playing the role of two separate modules?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Double-sided memory uses additional pins on the modules to allow access to only half the memory locations at a time. The memory controller switches to whichever side it needs to access at any given moment.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What power-supply feature supports two independent sources of 12VDC for internal components?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The dual-rail feature of modern power supplies provides independent 12VDC rails, which allow dedication of power to specific components, but which do not allow a single component to access the collective power from both rails.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a reason manufacturers might choose to employ risers in their systems?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Manufacturers have used risers to build low-profile systems and to reclaim valuable space on the motherboard for other components by reducing the number of slots.

answers.textAnswer: To be able to build a low-profile system
Because the case is two or more stories high
To fit more drives into the case
To have a modular method for adding functions to adapter cards

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is an error-checking scheme that is not capable of error correction and sometimes implemented in main memory?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Parity checking stores an extra bit with each byte in memory. When a byte is received by the CPU or a device that supports DMA, the validity of the parity bit is checked. If the check shows an error, the byte is rejected because there is no way to determine the nature of the error. ECC works differently, and it is capable of correcting single-bit errors. Dual-channel and Rambus are not error-checking schemes.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have a user who needs to connect to an external projector for a presentation. After he plugs the projector in, there is no display coming from it even though the power is on. What should you advise him to do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Laptops have three or four video output settings (laptop only, duplicate, external monitor only, or extend the desktop). You can toggle through them using the Function key in combination with another key, such as F4.

answers.textAnswer: Toggle the projector to the laptop input setting.
Toggle the display output on the laptop using the Function key.
Toggle the display output on the laptop using Windows Control Panel.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is definitely an analog video technology?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
VGA is an analog video technology; the others are older digital technologies Although specific models of VGA monitors display only shades of gray, they are not considered monochrome. Monochrome monitors are digital and display only text, which is in a single color on a black background.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which TCP/IP protocol uses port 23?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Telnet uses port 23. HTTP uses port 80, SMTP 25, and POP3 110.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following display technologies can be fashioned into the thinnest display units?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
OLED panels consist only of LEDs. There are no other supporting layers or thick spaces, as with the other technologies.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is the best way to ensure that only clients with the correct hardware addresses access your wireless router?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Enabling MAC filtering allows only specific computers to use the wireless router. Changing the SSID from the default is always a good idea, and you should use some sort of wireless security, but WPA is more secure than WEP.

answers.textAnswer: Leave the SSID as the default.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A user is having difficulty printing to a network printer. Other users are using the printer without a problem. What should you try first?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Printing a test page is the best place to start. If that does not work, you may want to delete and reinstall the printer. Printing a test page using the printer’s self-test will only tell you if the printer is printing fine, not if that one user is having a problem. Always use the test page feature from the printer properties, not from an application, to test printing.

answers.textAnswer: Print a test page from the user’s computer.
Print a test page by using the printer’s self-test.
Open up Microsoft Word, and try to print a document.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following network standards will not work with Category 5 cable?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
100BaseFX is a standard that uses fiber-optic cables. Therefore, Category 5 cabling will not work.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a difference between USB 2.0 and USB 3.0?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
USB 3.0 connectors are different from the connectors used with USB 1.x and 2.0. However, the older connectors still interface with the new ones, just at reduced performance when compared with all new connectors and devices. USB 3.0 is 10 times faster than USB 2.0, which actually supports the longer cable lengths. The two standards support the same number of hubs—five.

answers.textAnswer: USB 3.0 connectors have five additional pins.
USB 3.0 is 100 times faster than USB 2.0.
USB 3.0 cables can be longer than USB 2.0 cables.
USB 3.0 supports more hubs between host and devices than does USB 2.0.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following communication technologies is designed for a network known as a PAN?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Bluetooth was made to work as a wireless personal area network (WPAN). As such, it’s perfect for computer peripherals such as keyboards, mice, and wireless headsets.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the name of the Chinese-managed GNSS?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
BDS is the Chinese version of GPS. GLONASS is Russian, Galileo is European, and IRNSS is Indian.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: On which memory modules would you find DDR400 chips?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The 8:1 ratio between the numerical portion of the names of memory chips and the modules on which they are mounted results in chips having the lower number of the two. Therefore, DDR400 chips are found on PC3200 modules, not PC50 modules. Even if they existed, PC50 modules would be a form of SDR SDRAM module, not DDR SDRAM. PC2-3200 modules are DDR2 modules and have DDR2-400 chips mounted on them.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which device, when introduced into the market, caused a large number of privacy concerns?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Google Glass caused a great deal of controversy because of its camera.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are laptop memory form factor standards? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2},{answer-4}.
The two laptop memory form factor standards are the SODIMM and MicroDIMM.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have been asked to install a network cable that offers the greatest level of resistance to electromagnetic interference (EMI). Which of the following network media would you select?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Because fiber-optic cables use light pulses over a glass fiber as opposed to electrical signals over a copper conductor, fiber-optic cable is not susceptible to EMI.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following CPU-cooling methods requires a pump in order to function?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Liquid cooling and phase-change cooling methods use pumps to circulate the cooling medium. The other technologies use physics that do not require pumps to function.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What would be the first step to perform if you are getting garbled print jobs?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Garbled print usually indicates an invalid or out-of-date print driver. If there were a cabling issue, the printer would not print at all. Bad toner would tend to produce faint or blurry print jobs.

answers.textAnswer: Change the font used in the print job.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which component has a switch that might need to be changed when moving a computer from one country to another?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Power supplies have voltage selector switches that allow the power supply to be used in regions, such as North America, that have power grids based on voltages in the 110–120 range with a 60Hz phase but then be moved to other regions, such as Europe, where voltages in the range of 220–240 and a phase of 50Hz are used.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following resolutions is that of standard VGA?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Standard VGA is capable of a resolution of 640×480. CGA’s resolution was 320×200. EGA’s was 640×350. SVGA is capable of an 800×600 resolution.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following optical-disc suffixes indicates that the disc can be written to multiple times?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Of the options given, only rewritable (-RW or +RW) optical discs can be written to, erased (or formatted), and written to again multiple times.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which layer of the OSI model describes how data is transmitted over a physical medium?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The Physical layer is responsible for formatting the final packet of data for transmission over a physical medium.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which stage of a laser printer process melts the toner onto the paper?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The drum is first charged to prepare for the writing stage, which charges the print pattern onto the drum. After toner is applied to the drum, the toner is transferred to paper. At this point, the toner is melted and fused to the paper by using heat.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following display technologies places electrodes that align particles suspended in a fluid on the same side of the layer that contains the particles?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
IPS and TN are LCD-panel construction technologies that place the electrodes in differing orientations: IPS in parallel and TN in opposition.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following standards supports communications up to 54Mbps?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The 802.11g standard supports speeds up to 54Mbps. 802.11i is a set of security standards, and 802.11b supports only up to 11Mbps. Bluetooth is limited to 3Mbps.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which physical network topology uses the least amount of cabling?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Because of its design, which includes a central trunk that runs the distance between the two most distant computers (as long as it does not exceed the maximum distance allowed for the cabling), a bus topology requires the least amount of cable.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are types of broadband access? (Choose all that apply.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2},{answer-3},{answer-4}.
Dial-up is the predecessor to broadband access. Available broadband methods include DSL, cable, fiber-optic, and satellite.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements about interlaced refresh rates is most accurate?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Interlacing is a method of decreasing the cost of video circuitry while reducing the overall quality of the displayed image. In many cases, interlacing results in an average refresh rate that is half the configured rate. The user often perceives this as an annoying flicker.

answers.textAnswer: Two separate images are combined on the screen at the same time.
Video quality is poorer than that of noninterlaced refresh rates.
The odd-numbered rows are displayed, but the even-numbered rows are not.
All video adapters employ interlacing all the time.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You support an old dot-matrix printer at work. When the printer prints, the text always goes from darker to lighter as it moves across the page. What is the most likely cause of the problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
If a dot-matrix printer outputs dark to light across a page, that means the printer ribbon is not advancing properly; the gear likely needs to be replaced. If the output were consistently faded, then you would replace the ribbon.

answers.textAnswer: The print ribbon is old and needs to be replaced.
The print ribbon is not advancing properly.
The print head needs to be replaced.
The wrong print driver is installed.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which benefits of a USB connection make it a popular choice for printers? (Choose all that apply.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-2},{answer-3}.
The rate of transfer and the ability to recognize new devices automatically are two of the major advantages that make USB a popular type of printer interface. However, it is the network printer interface that allows the printer to communicate with networks, servers, and workstations.

answers.textAnswer: It has a higher transfer rate than a parallel connection.
It has a higher transfer rate than a serial connection.
It allows the printer to communicate with networks, servers, and workstations.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Concerning the specialized drives recommended for an A/V editing workstation, which of the following statements is true?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
With nonlinear encoding (NLE) software, fast drives are a must. Furthermore, the hard drive housing the application that is being used for editing should not be the same as the one where the operating system resides. Uncoupling the two leads to the ability for concurrent access and lack of contention, thus avoiding performance degradation. Although it is true that SATA 6Gbps is a wise choice for the drive interface, there is no such PATA (IDE) standard.

answers.textAnswer: The spin rate should be slower than 15,000 rpm.
The spin rate should be 7,200 rpm or faster.
You must make sure that the application being used resides on the same drive as the operating system to ensure seamless access.
PATA drives with transfer rates of at least 6Gbps should be used.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Tablet computers generally have screens of what size?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Most tablets are between 7" and 12" in size.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: In which step of the laser printer printing process does a uniform &#8211;600VDC charge get applied to the EP drum?
unsortedQuestions.explanation: During the charging phase, the charging corona applies a uniform &#8211;600VDC charge to the photosensitive drum. The drum is then ready for the image to be written on it.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which impact printer has a print head that contains a row of pins that are triggered in patterns that form letters and numbers as the print head moves across the paper?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The dot-matrix impact printer’s print head contains a row of pins that are triggered in patterns that form letters and numbers as the print head moves across the paper.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is the most common paper feed mechanism associated with a dot-matrix printer?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Dot-matrix printers often use tractor feed paper feed mechanisms. These are designed to pull or weave the paper through the printer. Some can use regular printer paper.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following custom configurations most prominently includes file and print sharing?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The home server is a computer that is designed to share resources, such as files for streaming and printers for centralized printing.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following does not contribute to the cooling of system components?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Motherboards do not aid in the cooling process. Heat sinks draw heat away from components and radiate it via fins. Fans on the heat sinks flush them with cooler air, and system fans help in removing warmer air from the system or introducing cooler air into the system. Slot covers ensure that the original airflow design of the system case is not compromised.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: While configuring your firewall, you inadvertently block port 443. Which of the following will be unavailable?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure is a combination of HTTP and Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) to make for a secure connection. It uses port 443 by default, and the beginning of the site address becomes https://.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have a computer with the IP address 226.18.171.1. What class is this address?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Class A addresses have a first octet from 1–126, Class B from 128–191, and class C from 192–223. With a first octet of 226, this address is not valid for use by hosts on your network (it’s technically a Class D address).

answers.textAnswer: This is a Class A address.
This is a Class B address.
This is a Class C address.
This is not a valid IP address.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is needed to be able to display local television broadcasts from the same type of cable used with standard TVs?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
TV tuner cards can decode the same signal used by televisions. Video capture cards can store the resulting video stream, but they cannot help with deciding the signal for display.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which kind of laptop was designed to look and function like a paper notebook?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The tablet PC is a small notebook that allows a user to hold it like a large notebook and write notes directly on the screen.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the difference between OpenCL and CUDA?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
CUDA, a proprietary architecture from Nvidia, and OpenCL, an open architecture, are both graphics-based parallel-processing architectures.

answers.textAnswer: OpenCL is a Microsoft specification, and CUDA is an ATI specification.
OpenCL is a parallel processing architecture, and CUDA is serial.
CUDA is proprietary, and OpenCL is not.
OpenCL is for graphics processing, and CUDA is for regular CPU processing.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You need to configure the IP address of your new laser printer. Which of the following are ways that you may be able to do this? (Choose all that apply.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2},{answer-3},{answer-4}.
The IP address of your printer can be configured in several ways. They include through the printer’s control panel, through web interfaces, and using the printer management software from your workstation.

answers.textAnswer: Use a web browser interface to get to the printer’s management software.
Use the printer’s management software that you installed on your workstation.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which 802.11ac feature allows the router to increase the functional range of its transmissions?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Beamforming allows the router to concentrate its signal in one specific direction as opposed to sending it out in an omnidirectional pattern. This provides greater transmission distance.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What type of connector does a Mini PCIe card have?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Mini PCIe cards have 52-pin card edge connectors. Legacy mini PCI cards have either a 100-pin stacking connector or a 124-pin card edge connector.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are working with an older laser printer. Customers are complaining of printer problems. Upon investigation, you notice that the printer has worn pickup rollers. What problem could this cause?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The worn rollers may not be gripping and advancing the paper correctly. If this occurs, the paper can bunch up inside the printer and create a paper jam.

answers.textAnswer: Light and dark patches on the paper

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are investigating computer specifications for a new desktop workstation. If the specifications include 256KB of L2 cache, approximately how much L1 cache would it be reasonable to expect the computer to have?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
L1 cache is generally the smallest and fastest cache. Therefore, it’s reasonable to expect that the computer will have less L1 cache than L2.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have installed a printer on your Windows 10 computer using TCP printing and configured it to use the RAW protocol. Which port number will you need to open in Windows Firewall for this to work successfully?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
TCP printing’s RAW protocol uses TCP port 9100 by default. The alternative, LPR, uses source ports 721–731 and the destination port 515.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A user reports that his iPhone will not make any sounds. He has turned the phone off and back on, and the problem is still there. You check his settings, and the phone is not on silent mode and the volume is set to maximum. What can you to fix this problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
If the device does not produce sound, first make sure that it’s not set to silent operation. Most mobile devices will have a switch on the side that sets them to silent or vibrate mode, which will mute the device from making noises. Also check the volume settings. If the speakers have failed on a mobile device, it’s time for a new device.

answers.textAnswer: Reset the phone to factory specifications.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have a laptop with a dead hard drive. You want to replace it with a newer SSD but have a few concerns. What disadvantages do SSDs have versus HDDs? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-4}.
SSDs have many advantages over HDDs, including producing less heat and being less susceptible to damage from shock or overheating. However, they are more expensive per byte and have less capacity.

answers.textAnswer: They are more susceptible to damage.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You purchased a new monitor that has a native resolution of 1920x1080. What aspect ratio is this, and is it compatible with widescreen television aspect ratios?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
