The /A parameter is used to abort a shutdown.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following tools provides comprehensive information about the system’s resource usage, hardware, and software environments?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
MSINFO32 provides comprehensive information about the system’s resource usage, hardware, and software environments.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which versions of Windows Vista offer offline file support? (Choose all that apply.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}, {answer-3}.
In Windows Vista, offline file support is limited to the Business, Enterprise, and Ultimate versions.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following parameters is used with the TASKLIST utility to display services with each process? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The /SVC parameter is used to display services with each process.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: While troubleshooting a customer’s LAN, you determine that the server must be rebooted to restore the network to full functionality. What should you do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
You should be courteous to all workers and inform them that a reboot is needed and coming soon. You should not reboot without first informing them, and you should not leave it up to the customer to do in your absence because this is a part of your responsibility and a problem could occur in your absence.

answers.textAnswer: Broadcast a message to all users telling them that a reboot is coming.
Reboot as quickly as you can.
Suggest the customer do the reboot while you are at lunch.
Recommend that the reboot be bypassed now and done by the customer after hours.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which type of operating system installation keeps the same data as was previously on the machine? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.

While image deployment could keep data values, an upgrade will keep data values and is the better choice.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following groups has read/write permission to the system?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Only members of the Administrators group have read and write permission to the system.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You’ve been told to “destroy” a hard drive for one of the old servers. What are the platters made of?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
While the platters resemble CDs or DVDs, they are not made of plastic and are much more difficult to destroy. They are made of an aluminum alloy.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which file system is primarily used on Unix-based systems?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Network File System (NFS) is a distributed file system protocol originally developed by Sun Microsystems. While is supported on some Windows systems, it is primarily used on Unix-based systems.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which NTFS permission allows the user to navigate the entire directory structure, view the contents of the directory, view the contents of any files in the directory, and see ownership and attributes?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The Read permission allows the user to navigate the entire directory structure, view the contents of the directory, view the contents of any files in the directory, and see ownership and attributes.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which Windows 7 edition is available only in a 32-bit version?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Windows 7 Starter is available only in a 32-bit version and supports a single processor with a maximum of 2 GB of RAM.

answers.textAnswer: None. All are available in both 32-bit and 54-bit versions.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Within Linux, a file with permissions of rwxr—r—is ___________________.
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The file is readable by everyone.

answers.textAnswer: Readable only by members of the file’s group
Readable only by the owner of the file
Readable only by the owner of the file or a member of the file’s group

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which type of virus is designed to make itself difficult to detect or analyze?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
An armored virus is designed to make itself difficult to detect or analyze.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a command that can be used to troubleshoot DNS issues?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The [code]NSLOOKUP[code] command is used to troubleshoot DNS issues on a device.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are trying to find the MAC address of a host running Windows. You run[code] ipconfig /all [code]and see numerous entries. Which entry is the MAC address?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If you don’t know a workstation’s MAC address, use [code]ipconfig /all [code]to find it in the Windows-based world. It will appear as the physical address.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following operating systems can participate in a HomeGroup?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
All computers participating in the HomeGroup must be running Windows 7, and the network can never grow beyond a limited size. While all editions of Windows 7 can join a HomeGroup, not all can create a HomeGroup.

answers.textAnswer: Only Windows 8, Windows Vista, and Windows 7
Only Windows 8.1, Windows Vista, and Windows 7

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the minimum RAM requirement for Windows Vista Home Basic?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The minimum RAM requirement for Windows Vista Home Basic is 512 MB, and it is 1 GB for all other versions of Windows Vista.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: On a SOHO network, which service should you avoid using to keep from issuing IP addresses to hosts other than those you recognize and want on the network?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
A.
Static IP addresses should be used (avoiding issue by DHCP) on small office/home office networks to keep from issuing them to hosts other than those you recognize and want on the network.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the minimum video requirement for Windows Vista?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The minimum video requirement for Windows Vista is SuperVGA.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which tool can be used to configure the size of the Security log file in Windows 7?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
You can set maximum log size by right-clicking the log in the Event Viewer and selecting Properties. By default, when a log fills to its maximum size, old entries are deleted in FIFO order.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is used instead of the Control panel to make direct changes to the system?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Regedit is used to change the configuration directly rather than using the Control Panel applets.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which option is used with SFC to verify integrity but not repair anything?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The /VERIFYONLY option is used to verify integrity, but not perform any repair operations.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following commands can be used to set network-related configuration?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
[code]NET CONFIG[code] is used to see network-related configuration. [code]NET ACCOUNTS[code] is used to set account options (password age, length, and so on). The[code] NET COMPUTER [code]command can be used to add and delete computer accounts. [code]NET FILES[code] can be used to close open files.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is WinPE?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Windows Preinstallation Environment (WinPE) was designed as a pre-installation platform to be used for deploying Microsoft Windows operating systems.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which Windows feature allows you to use drive encryption to protect files, including those needed for startup and logon?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
BitLocker allows you to use drive encryption to protect files, including those needed for startup and logon.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following entails ensuring that data expected to remain private is seen only by those who should see it?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Confidentiality entails ensuring that data expected to remain private is seen only by those who should see it. Confidentiality is implemented through authentication and access controls.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have been called to a site to clean a plethora of computers. Doing so will take cartons of compressed air, and you are looking for another solution. Which of the following can you use?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
It’s possible to use an air compressor instead of compressed-air cans when you need a lot of air. If you take this approach, make sure you keep the pounds per square inch (PSI) at or below 40 and include measures on the air compressor to remove moisture.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which switch is used with CHKDSK to recover readable information in bad sectors?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The /R switch allows CHKDSK to recover readable information in bad sectors.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following options is used with TASKKILL to specify the computer on which to kill a task?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The /S switch is used to specify the computer on which to kill a task.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which type of backup backs up only files for which the archive bit is currently turned on and leaves the archive bit in its current state?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A differential backup backs up only files for which the archive bit is currently turned on and leaves the archive bit in its current state.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following occurs when the breaker on a device such as a power supply, surge protector, or UPS turns off the device because it received a spike?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Electrical tripping occurs when the breaker on a device such as a power supply, surge protector, or UPS turns off the device because it received a spike.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You need to manually assign an IP address to a Windows 8.1 computer. What should you access to make this change?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The Network Connections page is accessible from the Network And Sharing Center and shows all adapters on the computer. The Network page from the Settings charm allows you to turn sharing on or off, but it doesn’t give direct access to the network adapter. The PC Settings page does not have a Network Adapters page. The Control Panel does not include an Ethernet adapter.

answers.textAnswer: The Network page from the Settings charm
The Network Adapters from the PC Settings page
The Ethernet applet in the Control Panel
The Network Connections page from the Network And Sharing Center

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is another name for MAC filtering?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
On a number of wireless devices, the term network lock is used in place of MAC filtering, and the two are synonymous.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which switch is used with the COPY command to tell it that you are working with an ASCII text file?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The [code]/A[code] switch tells [code]COPY [code]that you are working with an ASCII text file.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When a loud noise comes from a PC, which of the following is most likely the source?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The case fan can make a noise when the fan begins to malfunction.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which switch is used to indicate PING should continue to ping the host without stopping until you break out of it (using Ctrl+C)?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
You can use the[code] /T[code] switch to indicate[code] PING [code]should continue to ping the host without stopping until you break out of it.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are currently working at the command line in the directory [code]C:\Novell\Messenger\LogFiles[code] and type [code]CD[code] .. Where will this move you to?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The command [code]CD[code] .. would move you to[code] C:\Novell\Messenger[code], while [code]CD .[code] would not move you to any other directory but simply signify the existing directory.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a type of badge or card that gives you access to resources?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A smart card is a type of badge or card that gives you access to resources, including buildings, parking lots, and computers. It contains information about your identity and access privileges.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: How can you test if Bluetooth connectivity has been established between a mobile device and a vehicle’s audio system? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2},{answer-3}.
The reason for making the Bluetooth connection was to be able to place calls over the vehicle’s sound system or to play media from the mobile device over the sound system or both. Other controls are not dependent on Bluetooth.

answers.textAnswer: Start the car with the mobile device.
Play the radio over the mobile device.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Where enabled, AutoRun will work on newly installed media by looking for and running which file?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Where enabled, AutoRun will work on newly installed media by looking for and running the [code]autorun.inf[code] file.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Many of the newer SOHO router solutions, and some of the personal firewall solutions on end-user workstations, close down which port (or ports) by default?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Many of the newer SOHO router solutions (and some of the personal firewall solutions on end-user workstations) close down the ICMP ports by default.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are configuring two email servers on your company’s network, and they are on opposite sides of a router. Which port do you need to make sure is open to traffic for the servers to be able to transfer mail to each other?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) is used to transfer email between servers, and it uses port 25. Telnet uses port 23, POP3 uses port 110, IMAP4 uses port 143, and HTTPS uses port 443.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: According to CompTIA, what is the first step in the troubleshooting theory?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The first step is to identify the problem. One way of so doing is to question the user and identify user changes to the computer.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which option can you use with the SFC command to have it scan an offline boot directory? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The option to use with the System File Checker (SFC) to have it scan an offline boot directory is /OFFBOOTDIR.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which image includes all the drives required for Windows to run as well as default system settings, programs, and files?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A recovery image is an image that includes all the drives required for Windows to run as well as default system settings, programs, and files.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which wireless technology is also known as WiMax?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
802.16 or WiMax can transmit up to 10 miles and is often used to cover parts of a city.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which NTFS permission allows the user to view the contents of a directory and to navigate to its subdirectories?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The List Folder Contents permission (known simply as List in previous versions) allows the user to view the contents of a directory and to navigate to its subdirectories. It does not grant the user access to the files in these directories unless that is specified in file permissions.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A customer stresses to you how important her company’s operations are, and she asks how she can get ahold of you after hours if there is a problem. What should you provide her?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
As a representative of your company, you must always follow company policy. Most likely there is a protocol for handling after-hours calls, and typically they are routed through a service that can document the call and make sure someone responds even when a well-liked technician is on vacation and unavailable (a downfall of relying on home phone and cell phone numbers).

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which switch is used with [code]DEFRAG[code] to print the progress of the operation on the screen?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The [code]/U[code] switch is used with [code]DEFRAG[code] to print the progress of the operation on the screen.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Your network uses IPv6 addresses. Of the following choices, what is a valid IPv6 address?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
An IPv6 address includes eight groups of four hexadecimal characters but can be shortened by eliminating leading zeroes and using zero compression with a single set of double colons. Only seven sets of hexadecimal characters without double colons are not valid. Nine sets of characters are not valid. An IPv6 address cannot use two double colons.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which switch is used with [code]DEFRAG[code] to force defragmentation even when disk space is low?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The[code] /F [code]switch is used with [code]DEFRAG [code]to force defragmentation even when disk space is low.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When computer systems are retired, the disk drives should be zeroed out, and all magnetic media should be:
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
When computer systems are retired, the disk drives should be zeroed out, and all magnetic media should be degaussed.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What kind of mobile app is being used when the owner’s phone displays a message on the screen and emits an extremely loud tone?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Locator apps can find the phone and then display a message that can be read even while the phone is locked. Locator apps also often give the user the option to make the phone blare a noise to aid in finding the device if someone is nearby. Remotely wiping the mobile device is a feature of locator apps, but it is not itself an app that displays messages and produces noises.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which switch can be used with [code]IPCONFIG[code] to obtain a new IP address?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The [code]/RENEW[code] switch can be used with the [code]IPCONFIG[code] command to obtain a new IP address.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: As you are disassembling a computer, what should you use to protect sensitive electronic devices from stray static charges?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Antistatic bags protect sensitive electronic devices from stray static charges.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following DISKPART commands can be used on a basic disk to mark a partition as active?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The ACTIVE command is used to mark the partition as active.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is not a type of wireless encryption that can be used on a SOHO wireless network?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The available types of wireless encryption available include WEP, WPA, and WPA2. TFTP is an unsecure form of FTP.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a recommended physical security method?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Locking doors is a recommended physical security method. The other choices are digital.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: By default, Notepad will open files with what filename extension? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
In Windows, Notepad defaults to files with the .TXT extension.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following comes after verifying full system functionality?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-5}.
The final step in the troubleshooting theory is to document findings, actions, and outcomes.

answers.textAnswer: Establish a theory of probable cause.
Test the theory to determine cause.
Establish a plan of action to resolve the problem and implement the solution.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is not a valid way to make a payment using a mobile payment service?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Voicemail is not a legitimate method to make a payment using a mobile payment service. Correct ways are by SMS or MMS text, direct mobile billing, mobile web payments, and near field communication (NFC).

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are good measures to take to help prevent ESD? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-4}.
Long hair or neckties can very easily hold a static charge and damage computer parts. In addition, if you don’t have an ESD strap or mat, you should perform self-grounding before you touch sensitive computer equipment. Lower humidity actually increases the risk of ESD.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is the name of the location from where applications for Apple devices can be downloaded?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The Apple App Store is the online location for purchasing and downloading apps for iOS devices. The Apple Store is a brick-and-mortar store. Market and Play are partial forms of past and present Google app stores.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following partitions could be defined as a device that provides an area of usable storage space on one or more physical drives? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A logical partition can be defined as a device that provides an area of usable storage space on one or more physical drives.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Your manager wants you to install an Internet appliance that will detect potential attacks on the network and take action to stop them. Which one should you install?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
An IPS will detect network attacks and take actions to stop them. If you want a device that works for the entire network, it should be network based, so you want a NIPS.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Permissions on directories are governed by which of the following?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Permissions on directories are governed by NTFS and share permissions.

answers.textAnswer: NTFS permissions unless share permissions are set

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Your company has decided to host its own web server. With that decision, how many DNS server(s) is the company expected to maintain?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
When managing DNS for its own website, a company is expected to maintain two DNS servers for redundancy.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the single best thing that you can do to protect your company from prohibited content?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The most important thing that you can do is to create an appropriate use policy. The policy should clearly define what is and what is not allowed, and it should stipulate the penalties for violating the policy. If you disabled the Internet connection, users could still bring prohibited content in on flash drives or discs.

answers.textAnswer: Install security cameras to monitor employee computer usage.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following utilities is used for DirectX diagnostics in Windows? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
In Windows, DXDIAG is used for DirectX Diagnostics.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Many modern ________ require a password or PIN to activate and employ encryption to protect their contents.
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
A password or PIN is required to activate many modern smart cards, and encryption is employed to protect the card’s contents.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following should be done immediately before entering the code to pair a mobile device to another device?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The code needs to be entered on the mobile device, not the other device, after allowing the mobile device to find the other device. Leaving Wi-Fi on and not power cycling should be fine.

answers.textAnswer: Find the other device for pairing.
Enter the code on the other device.
Turn off Wi-Fi on the mobile device.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What type of malware is able to conceal itself from many parts of the operating system and will obtain/retain elevated privileges?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Rootkits are software programs that have the ability to hide certain things from the operating system.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following edition(s) of Windows Vista include BitLocker? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Of the editions listed, BitLocker is included only in Ultimate. Of those not listed, it also is included with Enterprise.

answers.textAnswer: Ultimate, Business, Home Premium, and Home Basic

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following contains the login information for a user, including their groups and privileges? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The token, in Windows, contains the login information for a user, including their groups and privileges.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which Linux command can be used to rename a file at the command line?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The mv command is used at the Linux shell to change the name of a file to a new name.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which protocols and associated ports are most commonly used to download email from mail servers?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
SMTP (25) is used to upload mail to a mail server and to transfer mail between servers. It’s a push protocol. POP3 (110) and IMAP4 (143) are pull protocols that download mail from mail servers.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When you export a portion of the Registry using REGEDIT, what is the filename extension of the file created?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
When you export a portion of the Registry using REGEDIT, a file with the filename extension [code].REG[code] is created.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is the most current service pack for Windows Vista? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The most current service pack for Windows Vista is SP2.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following types of batteries are not considered environmental hazards?
unsortedQuestions.explanation: Nickel metal hydride batteries are not considered environmental hazards. Alkaline batteries used to contain mercury, which is an environmental hazard, but they no longer do. All of the other battery types include harmful elements, such as mercury or lead. Even though they're not considered environmental hazards, it's still a good idea to recycle NiMH batteries.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Within Windows, which technology allows you to power a device remotely using only the network connection? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Power over Ethernet (PoE) allows you to power a device remotely using only the network connection.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is not an NTFS permission? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation: Change is a share permission; the similar permission in NTFS is Modify.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Why might you connect a mobile device to a Wi-Fi network? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4},{answer-5}.
Connecting to a Wi-Fi network saves the cost of sending data over the cellular network. Some devices, such as iPhones, can synchronize to a computer when they are plugged into power and on the same Wi-Fi network as the computer. The devices can probably connect using USB, which is usually faster than Wi-Fi, or Bluetooth, which is not as fast as Wi-Fi.

answers.textAnswer: An ad hoc connection between the device and a computer is the only way the two can connect.
The device has no Bluetooth capability.
Wi-Fi is always faster than USB.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Evan fancies himself the data destruction expert at your company. He starts talking about a particular type of formatting that is a factory-only process for IDE drives. Which type is he talking about?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Controllers are integrated into IDE drives. Low-level formatting is a factory process with these drives.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which tab in the Internet Options applet is used to configure the default web browser? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The Programs tab holds the configuration options for the default web browser.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements is true?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A unique application-level proxy server must exist for each protocol supported.

answers.textAnswer: An application-level proxy server provides better security than packet filtering.
An application-level proxy server is considered a weak form of security.
An application-level proxy server must handle all protocols supported.
A unique application-level proxy server must exist for each protocol supported.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which form of social engineering involves sorting through trash to find information?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Dumpster diving is the act of sorting through trash to find information.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have been sent to a remote office to solve a problem on a desktop computer. When you arrive, the user is nowhere to be found. What should you do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The situation is serious enough that you were called. You should now have the user summoned and wait for her before proceeding. You don’t have enough information to proceed, and it is unreasonable to expect a user who has asked for assistance to stay at their desk until you arrive (unless a specific time has been arranged beforehand).

answers.textAnswer: Have someone text or call the user.
Sit and wait for the user.
Use the phone to call your manager and check in on other jobs.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When you choose to boot to Safe Mode, which of the following is not loaded?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Safe Mode provides the standard VGA drivers, Microsoft mouse drivers, basic drivers for the keyboard, and storage system services, but no networking.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following operations rewrites files so that the data appears contiguously?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Defragmentation rewrites files so that the data appears contiguously on the media.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements about POP3 is true?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
POP3 uses TCP port 110, and secure POP3 uses port 995 with SSL/TLS.

answers.textAnswer: POP3 over TLS uses TCP port 995, and POP3 over SSL uses TCP port 993.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which mobile devices are allowed to make use of the Wi-Fi calling service?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Not every mobile device can use Wi-Fi calling. Only devices that have been authorized by the mobile provider can use the service.

answers.textAnswer: All mobile phones, but not tablets
All tablets, but no mobile phones
Mobile phones and tablets that have been authorized by the mobile provider

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following types of file systems lacks assignable access permissions?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
CDFS lacks assignable access permissions.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which ports does DHCP use?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
DHCP uses UDP ports 67 and 68. FTP uses TCP ports 20 and 21. HTTP and HTTPS use ports 80 and 443, respectively. DNS uses port 53.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A RADIUS server is an example of what type of server?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Remote Authentication Dial-in User Service (RADIUS) servers are authentication servers.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following would be the best way to show the customer that you are listening to her description of a complicated problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Taking notes will indicate that you are paying attention to the details and attempting to comprehend them fully. Nodding is also a sign of listening, but if the problem is complicated, taking notes is probably more useful to you and your customer.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which edition(s) of Windows 7 allow the user to run Windows XP business programs in Windows XP Mode?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
This is available with Windows 7 in the Professional, Enterprise, and Ultimate editions. It is not available in Windows Home Premium (making options {answer-3} and {answer-4} incorrect).

answers.textAnswer: Home Premium, Professional, Enterprise, and Ultimate

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Within Linux, what is the result of running the chmod&#160;a+x&#160;emmett command?
unsortedQuestions.explanation: The file emmett is now executable (and other permissions that were associated with it remain).

answers.textAnswer: The file named a+x is now owned by user emmett.
The file emmett is now owned by users a and x.
The file emmett is now executable.
The file chmod is now accessible by user emmett.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: By default, which of the following are connection methods that allow the connection of an iPhone to a computer for synchronization? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-2}.
Synchronization of an iOS device can occur over wired USB connections or over Wi-Fi connections.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: While fixing a printer problem for a customer, you notice that a network switch is behaving erratically and is likely to fail soon. How should you respond?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Since the switch has not yet failed, and since it is not the problem you were called to work on, you should bring it to the attention of the customer and let them decide what to do next. Under no circumstances should you simply start working on it or demand that it be done—perhaps the customer is aware of the situation and has ordered a replacement that will arrive the next day.

answers.textAnswer: Focus only on the printer you were called in to fix.
Inform the customer of the pending switch problem.
Tell the customer that he needs to fix the other problem now as well.
Start working on the switch, and add the charge to the bill for the printer.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a hard drive sanitation method? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Overwriting and drive wiping are the two methods of hard drive sanitation.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which edition(s) of Windows 7 allow the user to join a domain?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
This is available with Windows 7 in the Enterprise, Professional, and Ultimate editions. It is not available in Windows Home Premium.

answers.textAnswer: Home Premium, Enterprise, Professional, and Ultimate

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following should you use to actuate a resistive touchscreen?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Resistive touchscreens require pressure and not a soft touch, but using the wrong source of pressure can have a negative impact. The graphite from pencils can also short out electronics and should be kept away from mobile devices.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What can be used to isolate one portion of your internal network from others?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Although firewalls are often associated with outside traffic, you can place a firewall anywhere. For example, if you want to isolate one portion of your internal network from others, you can place a firewall between them.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is a method for stopping tailgating?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Using mantraps, which are devices such as small rooms that limit access to one or a few individuals, is a great way to stop tailgating.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Madonna is interested in securing her SOHO network. What can she add to MAC filtering to take security for the network down to the switch port level?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Adding port authentication to MAC filtering takes security for the network down to the switch port level and increases your security exponentially.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: In the absence of a gyroscope, what could be used in a mobile device to detect a change in screen orientation?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The accelerometer was used for the detection of screen orientation before gyroscopes were included in mobile devices. Their ability to monitor the force of gravity allows accelerometers to detect a change in screen orientation.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Ian wants to manage folder access on a shared resource by using NTFS permissions exclusively. To accomplish this, which permission should he set for the Everyone group?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
To manage the resource exclusively with NTFS permissions, he should set the share permissions on Everyone to Full Control.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following Windows recovery options restores Windows to an earlier point in time?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The System Restore recovery option restores Windows to an earlier point in time.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following Control Panel applets is unique to Windows Vista?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The Pen And Input Devices applet is unique to Windows Vista.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which Recovery Console command shows the contents of an ASCII text file?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
TYPE shows the contents of an ASCII text file.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following types of firewalls blocks traffic to specific addresses based on the type of application associated with the data?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A firewall operating as a packet filter passes or blocks traffic to specific addresses based on the type of application.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are usually contained on an MSDS? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2},{answer-3}.
Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDSs) contain a wealth of information on a product, including accident procedures and safety information.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are handling a service call in the field. When should you close this call?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Close the incident only when the customer is satisfied that the solution you have given is the correct one and the problem has gone away.

answers.textAnswer: When you are handed the ticket
When you have solved the problem

unsortedQuestions.questionText: In Windows 7, what is the default status of the Wake on LAN feature? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
In Windows 7, the Wake on LAN feature is enabled by default for desktops but not for laptops.

answers.textAnswer: It is enabled for desktops and laptops.
It is enabled for desktops but not for laptops.
It is enabled for laptops but not for desktops.
It is not enabled for desktops or laptops.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What is the recommended use policy on magnetic-tipped screwdrivers inside computers?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
A good rule of thumb when it comes to magnetic-tipped screwdrivers is to avoid using them inside a computer case. Magnetic tools can damage data on disks that use a magnetic storage scheme.

answers.textAnswer: It’s okay to use them, but keep them away from the processor.
It’s okay to use them, but keep them away from the RAM.
It’s okay to use them, but only if they’re of the powered variety.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following types of partitions are limited to there being only one?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-5}.
There can be up to four primary partitions or three primary partitions and one extended partition.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following command-line utilities starts a command prompt in Windows? (Choose the best answer.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
In Windows, CMD.EXE starts a command prompt.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: To find the next occurrence of a searched string in REGEDIT, which key should you press?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
F3 is used to find the next occurrence.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When you are providing phone support, a user suddenly asks for your name. What should you do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Names are often used to establish rapport and put both parties in the conversation at ease. When answering the phone and providing support, you should always give your name, but if you don’t and a user asks it, offer him your first name and continue diagnosing and solving the problem.

answers.textAnswer: Ask him why he wants to know.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a feature in Windows 7 that allows making automatic backups of data and reverting back to previous versions?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The Shadow Copy feature in Windows allows you to take “snapshots” of data and revert back to previous versions.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which Linux command can be used at the command line to see in which directory you are currently working?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The pwd command is used at the Linux shell to see the present working directory.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which cloud term refers to the process by which a provider charges for resources used?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Providers typically measure the amount of resources used by clients and charge them for what has been used. This is called a measured service, and it functions much like utilities.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following server names does Google use for POP3 access to its public mail service?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Google does not include the number 3 in the name of its POP3 server. It uses the names pop.gmail.com, imap.gmail.com, and smtp.gmail.com.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Microsoft recommends that all network shares be established with which of the following file systems?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Microsoft strongly recommends that all network shares be established using NTFS.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When a theory cannot be confirmed, which two of the following are options to consider?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-2}.
When a theory is not confirmed, you must reestablish a new theory or escalate.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: The electrical contacts on your video card are starting to become dirty. Which of the following should you use to clean those contacts?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
To clean electrical contacts, use denatured isopropyl alcohol and a cotton swab. Water should never touch electrical components. A pencil eraser could leave traces of acids behind, and your fingers have oils on them that will damage the contacts.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a small device that often fits on a key chain?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
A key fob is a small device that often fits on a key chain.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Chelsea is worried about the threat of malware on the network. She wants every workstation to have installed software that will detect worms and Trojan horses. What type software should she install?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Antivirus software is an application that is installed on a system to protect it and to scan for viruses as well as worms and Trojan horses.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which Linux command can be used to download software packages at the command line?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The apt -get command can be used at the Linux shell to download software packages.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following types of installation would most likely use an answer file?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
An unattended installation would likely use an answer file.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You recently installed a DHCP server on your network, and you noticed that network performance has slowed down considerably. When monitoring network traffic, you see excessive amounts of DHCP packets. What should you do to resolve this issue?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
DHCP clients broadcast to get an IP address from the server. When their lease is close to expiration, they will broadcast again to renew the lease. Increasing the lease time will resolve this issue. Uninstalling the DHCP server would too, but that also eliminates the benefit of using DHCP.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is a requirement for installing the latest version of iTunes on a Mac?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The Mac needs to have a later version of Safari loaded before you can install iTunes. The most RAM required is only 2GB, allowing 1080p video to be played. Depending on the version of iTunes, some version of Mac OS X is required. Mac OS 9 will not support the latest version of iTunes. You can install iTunes on the Mac with only 400MB of available disk space.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which port number is used for SMTP when SSL is used to secure the connection?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) uses port 465 when secured with SSL. Port 25 is used with SMTP when an insecure connection is used. SMTP uses port 587 when secured with TLS. Port 993 is used by secure IMAP.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: If a DNS server is unable to resolve a name, what will it do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If a DNS server is unable to resolve a name (and it checks its cache after it checks its zone file), it will query the root DNS server.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following mobile phone components is responsible for managing wireless communications?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
All wireless communications are handled by the baseband system in the phone, sometimes referred to as the radio or the modem. The baseband OS manages the baseband system and communicates to the phone’s primary OS.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What type of filters can be placed over a monitor to prevent the data on the screen from being readable when viewed from the side.
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Privacy filters are either film or glass add-ons that are placed over a monitor, and they prevent the data on the screen from being readable when viewed from the sides.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are in a location with no Wi-Fi connectivity, but you have cellular reception. You need to have your Wi-Fi enabled laptop send an urgent email. How can you have the laptop use Wi-Fi to send the email?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
By creating a mobile hotspot, the cell phone will allow the laptop to connect to it using Wi-Fi. Then use the cellular connection on the phone to get on the Internet.

answers.textAnswer: Use the cell phone to create a mobile hotspot
Use the cell phone to create a Wi-Fi hotspot
Use the laptop to create a mobile hotspot
Use the laptop to create a Wi-Fi hotspot
There is no Wi-Fi connectivity, so there is no way to send the email.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which editions of Windows 8 include BitLocker technology?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
This is available only with Windows 8 in the Enterprise and Pro editions.

answers.textAnswer: Home Premium, Pro, Enterprise, and Ultimate only

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which class of fire extinguisher is recommended for use in a wood and paper fire?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Wood and paper fires can be put out by a class A fire extinguisher. If you have a combination class ABC extinguisher, that will work fine.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Your network has two subnets separated by a router. To make network administration easier, you install a DHCP server on subnet A. Clients on subnet B are not getting IP addresses automatically. What is the best way to resolve this?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
DHCP requests are made via broadcast and will not travel through the router. It’s never a good idea to allow routers to forward broadcasts. You could install a second DHCP server, but that’s inefficient. The best solution is to install a DHCP relay agent on subnet B.

answers.textAnswer: Install a DHCP relay agent on subnet A.
Install a DHCP relay agent on subnet B.
Install a second DHCP server on subnet B.
Configure the router to forward broadcast messages.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: As a best practice, after a set period of inactivity on a Windows workstation, what should happen?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
A screensaver should automatically start after a short period of idle time, and that screensaver should require a password before the user can begin the session again.

answers.textAnswer: A password-enabled screensaver should automatically start.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which tab in the MSCONFIG utility on a Windows Vista workstation allows you to choose a diagnostic startup on the next boot?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
This option can be chosen on the General tab.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You want to follow the rules of good security administration as set by CompTIA and vendors. To do so, which account should be disabled on most Windows operating systems for security reasons?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The Guest account should be disabled and not used.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which tool can be used to defragment a hard drive without data loss?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
DEFRAG (the disk defragmenter) can be used to defragment a hard drive without data loss.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A user on the phone does not seem to be able to explain her problem to you without using profanity. That profanity is making you unable to understand her problem. What should you do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
While likely the profanity is linked to frustration, it hinders the communication and should be eliminated. There may be circumstances where it is necessary to overlook the profanity if your request is likely to make the already upset customer even angrier, as long as you can understand what is being said. The customer is not always right, but she is always your customer.

answers.textAnswer: Ask the user to refrain from the offensive language.
Show her that you know just as many expletives as she does.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is an Internet mail protocol used to send email from a mobile device?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) is used for sending Internet (TCP/IP-based) mail from a client to a recipient’s server. IMAP4 and POP3 are used for retrieving mail, and Exchange is a proprietary messaging system, not an Internet protocol.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are elements of a good workplace safety plan? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},{answer-2}.
Good safety plans protect the interests of the workers and also help keep company costs down. Periodic workplace inspections and a training program are good components to implement. Employees cannot be punished in any way for reporting safety violations. Third-party auditing of safety programs is not necessary, but there are organizations that will do this for you.

answers.textAnswer: Retribution for employees who report violations
An independent third-party auditor of the safety plan

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What utility is often included with SATA (Serial ATA) drives and can be used to erase data before exchanging a PC for a new one?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
SATA drives include HDDERASE.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following can be used at the command line to see the running processes and their PID number?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
TASKLIST can be used at the command line to see the running processes and their PID number.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements about MAC filtering and wireless access points is true?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Most APs offer the ability to turn on MAC filtering, but it is off by default.

answers.textAnswer: Most APs offer the ability to turn on MAC filtering, but it is off by default.
Most APs have the ability to turn on MAC filtering, and it is on by default.
APs automatically perform MAC filtering, and it cannot be turned on or off.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Sierra is concerned that her old laptop may not support Windows 7. What utility can she use to see if the hardware in the laptop will support this operating system?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The Windows 7 Upgrade Advisor can be used to see if the hardware will support the operating system.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following are common types of screwdrivers? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2},{answer-3}.
The three common types of screwdrivers are flat-blade, Phillips, and Torx. There are no circular or helix screwdrivers.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What two types of protection does FAT allow?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1},B
FAT allows only two types of protection: share-level and filesystem-level access privileges.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Mark is a new IT manager, and he is enforcing the principle of least privilege for all users. How many accounts should users who need administrative-level permissions now have?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Users who need administrative-level permissions should be assigned two accounts: one for performing nonadministrative, day-to-day tasks and the other to be used only when performing administrative tasks that specifically require an administrative-level user account.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A user reports that a workstation has two significant problems that do not seem related. How should you approach these problems?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
If the problems do not appear to be related, then deal with them separately.

answers.textAnswer: Look for what the two would have in common.
Assume that a virus is involved.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which Linux command can be used to change the password at the command line?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The passwd command is used at the Linux shell to change the password.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Stopping a wireless router from sending out a name for all to see stops it from broadcasting what entity?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Many networks will regularly broadcast their name (known as an SSID broadcast) to announce their presence.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: When a new app is developed for the Android platform, what extension does the filename have?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Android apps have an .apk (application package file) extension. Apps are developed with a software development kit (SDK). Apple iOS apps will have an .ipa extension.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following technologies can be used to limit bandwidth and packet loss parameters on a network?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Quality of Service (QoS) can be used to limit bandwidth and packet loss parameters on a network.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A user wants to ensure that all contacts from her mobile device are copied onto her computer before migrating to a new device. Which of the following processes can accomplish this?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Synchronization can copy all contacts, programs, email messages, pictures, music, and videos between a mobile device and a computer. Mirroring is a term reserved for when devices replicate themselves to similar devices. Calling the contacts won’t achieve the desired result, and emailing contacts is inefficient and does not immediately result in placing the contacts on the computer.

answers.textAnswer: Attaching the contacts to an e-mail

unsortedQuestions.questionText: What can disabling cellular data networking on a mobile device accomplish?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Use of the cellular data network counts against the subscriber’s monthly data plan. Disabling the cellular data connection does not change how calls are processed or presented. Updates will not occur over the cellular network when cellular data is disabled but can still occur over Wi-Fi.

answers.textAnswer: Prevent overages in the subscriber’s data plan
Force calls to go out over Wi-Fi
Allow use of caller ID to reject unwanted incoming calls

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are onsite fixing a client’s laptop that will not load Windows 7. You are waiting to hear about your friend’s awesome party that they are hosting this weekend, and your phone starts to vibrate. And it keeps vibrating. You’re sure that all of your friends are texting information about the party. What should you do? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}, {answer-2}.
When working with customers, you need to avoid personal interruptions such as phone calls or texts. Exceptions can be made if it’s an emergency situation, but in those cases notify the client that you might get a call or text and explain that you will deal with it only if it’s the emergency. Otherwise, ignore the personal interruption until you are not working with a client.

answers.textAnswer: Turn your phone off, and apologize to the client. Tell them that the phone was distracting you from your job, but it won’t be a problem now.
Text your friends back and tell them that you are working.
Call your friend and tell him to wait until after this job before planning all of the details because you want to help.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A user is running an application that requires complex calculations and takes a lot of CPU power. He wants to set his Windows 7 workstation so that it gives the application priority over all non-system-critical programs. Which tool can he use to do this?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
You can change the priority of a process in Task Manager’s Processes tab for Windows Vista and Windows 7 (or on the Details tab in Windows 8) by right-clicking the name of the process and choosing Set Priority. The six priorities, from lowest to highest, are low, below normal, normal, above normal, high, and realtime. Only an administrator can set a process to run at realtime priority. Task Manager changes the priority only for that instance of the running application. The next time the process is started, priorities revert to that of the base (typically normal).

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are planning on formatting a hard drive with NTFS to install Windows 8.1. Which of the following features are present in NTFS? (Choose two.)
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}, {answer-3}.
The New Technology File System (NTFS) is available with all current versions of Windows. NTFS is an advanced file system that includes such features as individual file security, compression, and RAID support as well as support for extremely large file and partition sizes and disk transaction monitoring.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have a computer running Windows 7 Professional, and you want to upgrade to Windows 8 Enterprise. What should you run to determine whether your computer can support the new operating system?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
The easiest way to see whether your current hardware can run another version of Windows is to download the utility that Microsoft creates for checking what you have. For Windows 7, this was called Upgrade Advisor. For Windows 8 and Windows 8.1, it has been renamed Upgrade Assistant.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements best describes the purpose of a virtual private network?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
A virtual private network (VPN) is a private network connection that occurs through a public network. A private network provides security over an otherwise unsecure environment. VPNs can be used to connect LANs together across the Internet or other public networks. With a VPN, the remote end appears to be connected to the network as if it were connected locally.

answers.textAnswer: It walls off one network from another, making it inaccessible.
It examines incoming network packets and forwards only those that match criteria in an access control list.
It makes network requests on behalf of a user, effectively masking the user’s identity from the computer receiving the request.
It creates a private, secure network connection through a public network.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are at a client’s office and need to replace faulty memory but do not have an ESD strap. Which of the following describes the best way to practice self-grounding while replacing the RAM?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Self-grounding is not as effective as using proper anti-ESD gear, but it makes up for that with its simplicity. To self-ground, make sure the computer is turned off but plugged in. Then touch an exposed (but not hot or sharp!) metal part of the case. That will drain an electrical charge from you. Better yet is if you can maintain constant contact with that metal part. That should keep you at the same bias as the case.

answers.textAnswer: Leave the computer plugged in but powered off, and stay in contact with the plastic part of the case.
Leave the computer plugged in but powered off, and stay in contact with the metal part of the case.
Unplug the computer, and stay in contact with the plastic part of the case.
Unplug the computer, and stay in contact with the metal part of the case.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have a Windows 7 workstation with an 802.11n network adapter. When you establish a network connection, which type of connection should you choose?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
802.11n is a wireless networking standard. Therefore, choose wireless as the network connection type.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: The police have come to you with a request for help. They have recovered a suspected criminal’s iPhone and want to get information off of it, and they have a warrant. The suspected criminal will not give them the passcode, and therefore the system is locked out. What advice can you give them on how to retrieve data from the device?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
Unfortunately, the only solution to a locked phone (or system lockout) is to perform a reset to factory specifications. That means that all of the data on the phone is gone. There is no backdoor. In 2016, there was a publicized case of law enforcement wanting to do this in California, and there was even some discussion of the case going to the U.S. Supreme Court. But Apple was steadfast that there is no backdoor, and they do not believe it’s appropriate to create one, which would also create a potential security hole.

answers.textAnswer: They can perform a reset to factory defaults, which will reset the passcode. Then they can retrieve the data.
They can perform a hard reset, which will reset the passcode. Then they can retrieve the data.
There is no way to unlock the device and get the data without the appropriate passcode.
They can crack the phone using backdoor code from Apple.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are logged into a Linux workstation with a regular user account. You need to execute a command with root permissions. Which command do you need to use?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
The sudo (“substitute user do” or “superuser do”) command is used to run a command with a different privilege level than the current user logged in. Typically this means running a command with superuser or root permissions.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A Linux user on your network has received an error message during boot that GRUB is missing, as well as an error number. What can you do to solve this problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
In Linux, there are two common boot loaders used. LILO (LInux LOader) is the older one but has been replaced by GRUB (GRand Unified Bootloader) in most instances. The most likely cause of a GRUB/LILO error is a missing or corrupt master boot record (MBR). The method to fix it depends on the version of Linux you are running, but generally speaking, you need to boot to the Linux installation CD/DVD, go into Linux rescue mode, and re-create the MBR.

answers.textAnswer: Boot to the Linux installation CD or DVD, enter Linux rescue mode, and re-create the MBR.
Boot to the Linux installation CD or DVD, and reinstall Linux.
Boot to the Linux installation CD or DVD, enter Linux rescue mode, and mount the hard drive.
Boot to the Linux installation CD or DVD, enter Linux rescue mode, and overwrite the contents of the GRUB file.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are looking online to find pictures to use as part of promotional materials your company wants to make. Which of the following statements is true regarding online content?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Many companies rely upon digital rights management (DRM) to protect digital assets such as online photos or videos. DRM is not as established as licensing agreements are, but you should still respect the property of the owners of digital content.

answers.textAnswer: Online content is considered open source; therefore, you may use whatever you find.
Online content is protected through the use of DRM.
Online content is protected through the use of EULA.
Online content is protected through terms established in the Geneva Conventions.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: In which type of security threat will someone try to gain access to a secure area without credentials by following someone else, who used their access rights, into the secured area?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Tailgating refers to being so close to someone when they enter a building, you are able to come in right behind them without needing to use a key, a card, or any other security device. Using mantraps, which are devices such as small rooms that limit access to one or a few individuals, is a great way to stop tailgating.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A new law requires that you keep hard copies of all your workstations’ system configurations. Which command can you use to easily gather this information for remote workstations and save a report as a text file?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
The MSINFO32 tool displays a thorough list of settings on the machine. You cannot change any values from here, but you can search, export, and save reports. When run from a command prompt, the /computer option allows you to specify a remote computer on which to run the utility, and the /report option saves the report as a .txt file.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are going to install Windows 8 Pro on a workstation that is currently running Windows 7 Professional. If you want to keep user accounts, data, and apps that are currently on the workstation, which type of installation should you perform?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The two primary methods of installing Windows 8 (and most versions of Windows) are either a clean install or an upgrade. With a clean install, no traces of any previous operating system are kept. With an upgrade, the focus is on keeping something from the previous operating system that was installed earlier on the machine. That “something” can be user accounts, data, apps, or almost anything else. When the upgrade is done without removing the existing operating system (the norm), this is known as an in-place upgrade. A custom installation implies a clean installation.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are configuring a wireless router for a home office. Which of the following changes will have the least impact on improving security of the network?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Even if you disable the SSID broadcast, potential attackers still have many simple tools available to see your wireless network traffic and get the SSID anyway. It is a weak form of security that will keep out only the most casual intruders. Enabling MAC filtering can help you allow access only to certain hosts, but MAC addresses can be spoofed. WPA is a good encryption method, but WPA2 is stronger. Changing the default username and password is always recommended.

answers.textAnswer: Changing the default username and password

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Mobile device users on your network report unusually slow network access speeds when they use Wi-Fi. However, when they are using a cellular connection, the speeds seem fine. Which of the following is the least likely cause of slow data speeds in this case?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Slow data speeds can be caused by too much interference, a weak signal, or an oversaturated wireless access point. If there is too much interference, try changing the channel on Wi-Fi routers to less-used channels and performance should increase. Solve weak signals by installing more access points or by moving closer to an existing access point. More access points can also help the oversaturation problem. If it was just one user, a low battery could cause problems, but that seems unlikely if the problem is widespread.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have just installed a second and third hard drive into a Windows 8.1 workstation. Each drive is 500GB. The user wants to combine their space into one 1TB volume. What should you create to accomplish this and also give the user a disk read and write performance boost?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
To combine both hard drives into one volume, you need to create a spanned, striped, or mirrored volume. A mirrored volume, like a RAID 1 array, will make one of the disks redundant, so in this case it would not give the user 1TB of storage. A striped volume is like RAID 0 and will give you a slight performance boost.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which feature of Windows 7 is designed to encrypt storage volumes, must be activated by an administrator, and can encrypt operating system startup files?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
Referenced by CompTIA as “Bit-Locker,” Microsoft calls it BitLocker, and it allows you to use drive encryption to protect files, including those needed for startup and logon. BitLocker can be turned on only by administrators.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You want to set up your mobile phone to be able to pay for items at convenience stores simply by moving it close to the merchant’s receiver. What type of mobile payment service is this?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
Using near field communication (NFC), a user will simply move their device within range (about 4" or 10cm) of the merchant’s receiver, and the payment will be processed. In most cases, a PIN is required. This method is of course used when the customer and merchant are in the same physical location. Charges are usually linked to a bank account, credit card, or online payment service.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements best describes the functionality of privacy filters?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Privacy filters are either film or glass add-ons that are placed over a monitor or laptop screen to prevent the data on the screen from being readable when viewed from the sides. Only the user sitting directly in front of the screen is able to read the data.

answers.textAnswer: To keep people from seeing inside the server room
To keep a user from accessing another user’s data on the server
To help prevent the accidental release of personally identifiable information (PII)
To keep people from seeing information on your computer screen

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Your iPhone has been stolen. To ensure that the thief does not have access to your data, what should you do?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The best way to remove data from the device is to perform a remote wipe. Ideally you have backed up or synced the device before then or you will lose data. Full device encryption is a good security practice, but that should have been completed prior to the phone being stolen.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You have installed a second hard drive in a Windows 8.1 workstation. In Disk Management, what type of partition can you create that will allow you to create an unlimited number of logical partitions in it?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
When you create a partition in Windows 8 or newer, it will ask if you want to create a Master Boot Record (MBR) or GUID Partition Table (GPT) one. GPT is newer and has far more features. One of those features is that you can create an unlimited number of logical partitions on it. Only the operating system will limit you; Windows will only allow 128 partitions on one drive.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You intend to recycle some older magnetic hard drives. You want to set all data on the drive to be nothing but 0s. What should you use to accomplish this?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
An overwrite, also frequently called a drive wipe, replaces all data on a hard drive with 0s. This effectively makes it so that people can’t recover old data from the drive and makes the drive safe to recycle.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Your Windows 8.1 workstation just crashed, displaying a blue screen of death. You have not recently made any changes to the computer. What is the best way to restart Windows to see whether you can isolate the issue?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
If this is a first-time error, just reboot and see whether it goes away. Windows is pretty stable, but every once in a while it coughs up a hairball (not a technical term, just like blue screen of death is not a technical term) and you need to reboot. If it doesn’t happen again, it’s not a problem. If it continues to happen, boot into Safe Mode.

answers.textAnswer: Boot to the Windows installation CD and start the Recovery Console.
Boot to the Last Known Good configuration.
Boot normally and see whether the error happens again.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A user reports that his Android phone will not turn on. When he hands you his phone, it is almost hot to the touch. He then admits that the phone had been in his locked car for most of the day, and it’s summertime. What is the most likely cause of the problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-1}.
One of the best ways to avoid overheating is to avoid ambient temperatures that are too hot or too cold: avoid having the device in direct sunlight for extended time periods, in a hot car on a summer day, or on top of a heat source. When the device does overheat, you can often help it cool down quicker by removing any protective case that may be there—and putting it back on later.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: The floor of a machine shop has several thin client computers on it. You want them to be able to boot a Windows 8 OS from a boot server on the network. What process will the thin clients need to use?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-4}.
Netboot is the process of booting the OS from the network, such as from a thin client. This can be done with Windows 8 using Microsoft Desktop Virtualization. This is a useful option for environments where hardware is kept to a minimum. After using DHCP to obtain network configuration parameters from a server, the thin client can locate a PXE boot server to send it the files that it needs to boot.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: You are at a Windows Vista command prompt. You need to terminate a process on a remote system named Sparky, and the process identifier is 14456. What is the right syntax to use to kill this process and any child processes started by it?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The taskkill command is used to terminate processes, just like you can do in Task Manager in Windows. To kill a process by its name, use the /IM switch. If you know the process ID, use the /PID switch. The /S switch is used to specify a remote system, and the /FI switch applies a filter to a set of tasks. The /T switch terminates child processes, and /F terminates the process forcefully.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A workstation on your network is configured to dual boot between Windows Vista and Windows 8.1. Previously, the user would get a menu asking him which OS to choose. He has not made any configuration changes, but now that menu no longer appears. Which file is responsible for presenting the user with this menu?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-2}.
During the Windows 8/7/Vista boot process, WINLOAD.EXE processes a file that resides in the root directory specifying what OSs are installed on the computer and where they reside on the disk. During this step of the boot process, you may be presented with a list of the installed OSs (depending on how your startup options are configured and whether you have multiple OSs installed). In Windows 8/7/Vista, WINLOAD.EXE replaces NTLDR from the Windows XP days.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: A small business with two servers in a server closet wants you to find a solution to a problem. The business frequently has power outages and has lost important data on the servers as a result. The business wants some type of battery backup. What type of device should you install to protect against this problem?
unsortedQuestions.explanation:
{answer-3}.
The best device for power protection is an uninterruptible power supply (UPS). These devices can be as small as a brick or as large as an entire server rack. Inside the UPS is one or more batteries and fuses. Much like a surge suppressor, a UPS is designed to protect everything that’s plugged into it from power surges. UPSs are also designed to protect against power sags and even power outages. Energy is stored in the batteries, and if the power fails, the batteries can power the computer for a period of time so that the administrator can then safely power it down.

unsortedQuestions.questionText: Which type of server on a network will be configured with a scope, which contains information the server will provide to clients who request it?
